<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is the total cost for all four of the family to go to the concert?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is the total cost for all four of the family to go to the concert?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total cost} &= \text{Cost of} \  2  \ \text{adults} + \text{Cost of} \  2 \ \text{children } \\\\
                  &= 2 \times 45 + 2 \times 30.5 \\\\
                  &= 90 + 61 \\\\
                  &= \pounds 151 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

To see the mid-week show there is a special offer where a family ticket, for $2$ adults and $2$ children, costs only $\pounds 125$.

How much would this ticket save the family?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>

<emptyline>

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Savings} &= \text{Full price} - \text{Special offer}  \\\\
               &= 151 - 125 \\\\
               &= \pounds 26 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$17600$ people attended the concert.

Given that $40 \%$ of these were adults, how many people were adults?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$17600$ people attended the concert.
<emptyline>
Given that $40 \%$ of these were adults, how many people were adults?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Adults}   &= 40 \% \ \text{of} \ 17600  \\\\
                &= \dfrac {40} {100} \times 17600 \\\\
                &= \dfrac {40 \times 17600} {100} \\\\
                &= \dfrac {40 \times 176 \times 1\cancel{00}} {1\cancel{00}} \\\\
                &= {40 \times 176} \\\\
                &= 7040 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$7040$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Mrs Prince wishes to buy each member of her class a photo frame as a present.

There are $24$ pupils in her class and each photo frame costs $\pounds 3.75$.

Find the total cost of all $24$ frames. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Mrs Prince wishes to buy each member of her class a photo frame as a present.
<emptyline>
There are $24$ pupils in her class and each photo frame costs $\pounds 3.75$.
<emptyline>
Find the total cost of all $24$ frames. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total cost}            &= \text{Count of pupils} \times \text{Cost per frame} \\\\\
                             &= 24 \times 3.75 \\\\
                             &= \pounds  90
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds  90$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The water cooler in the staff room contains $5 \ \text{litres}$ of water.

How many $200 \ \text{ml}$ glasses of water can it fill before it needs replacing? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The water cooler in the staff room contains $5 \ \text{litres}$ of water.
<emptyline>
How many $200 \ \text{ml}$ glasses of water can it fill before it needs replacing? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

The capacity of cooler is given in litres and capacity of glasses is given ml. Let's convert capacity of cooler in ml.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total water}       &= 5 \ \text{litres} \\\\
                         &= 5 \times 1000 \ \text{ml} \\\\
                         &= 5000 \ \text{ml}
\end{aligned}
$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of glasses} &= \dfrac {\text{Total Water in cooler}} {\text{Water in a glass}} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {5000} {200} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {200 \times 25} {200} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {\cancel {200} \times 25} {\cancel {200}} \\\\
                         &= 25
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$25$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">- rtq_abbr_note_md_unit_no_dot
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="formulacodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="formulacodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Formulas Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The capacity of cooler is given in litres and capacity of glasses is given ml. Let's convert capacity of cooler in ml.
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total water}       &= 5 \ \text{litres} \\\\
                         &= 5 \times 1000 \ \text{ml} \\\\
                         &= 5000 \ \text{ml}
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
As per the question,
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of glasses} &= \dfrac {\text{Total Water in cooler}} {\text{Water in a glass}} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {5000} {200} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {200 \times 25} {200} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {\cancel {200} \times 25} {\cancel {200}} \\\\
                         &= 25
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$28450$ people attended a hockey match.

If $8217$ wore red and $11750$ wore blue, how many wore neither blue nor red?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$28450$ people attended a hockey match.
<emptyline>
If $8217$ wore red and $11750$ wore blue, how many wore neither blue nor red?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{People who wore neither blue nor red}     &= 28450 - (8217 + 11750) \\\\
                                                &= 28450 - 19967 \\\\
                                                &= 8483
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$8483$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a year group of $180$ students, the students all studied one language.

$\dfrac{2}{5}$ of the students studied French, $\dfrac{1}{4}$ studied Latin and the rest studied Spanish.

How many students studied Spanish?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a year group of $180$ students, the students all studied one language.
<emptyline>
$\dfrac{2}{5}$ of the students studied French, $\dfrac{1}{4}$ studied Latin and the rest studied Spanish.
<emptyline>
How many students studied Spanish?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Spanish students}        &=  \text {Total students} - \text {French students} - \text {Latin students} \\\\
                                &=  180 -  \dfrac {2} {5} \times 180 - \dfrac {1} {4} \times 180 \\\\
                                &=  180 -  \dfrac {2 \times 180} {5} - \dfrac {180} {4} \\\\
                                &=  180 -  \dfrac {2 \times 36 \times 5} {5} - \dfrac {45 \times 4} {4} \\\\
                                &=  180 -  \dfrac {2 \times 36 \times \cancel{5}} {\cancel{5}} - \dfrac {45 \times \cancel{4}} {\cancel{4}} \\\\
                                &=  180 -  2 \times 36 - 45 \\\\
                                &=  180 -  72 - 45 \\\\
                                &=  63
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$63$

</div>
</div>

\begin{aligned}
\text {Spanish students}        &=  \text {Total students} - \text {French students} - \text {Latin students} \\\\
                                &=  180 -  \dfrac {2} {5} \times 180 - \dfrac {1} {4} \times 180 \\\\
                                &=  180 -  \dfrac {2 \times 180} {5} - \dfrac {180} {4} \\\\
                                &=  180 -  \dfrac {2 \times 36 \times 5} {5} - \dfrac {45 \times 4} {4} \\\\
                                &=  180 -  \dfrac {2 \times 36 \times \cancel{5}} {\cancel{5}} - \dfrac {45 \times \cancel{4}} {\cancel{4}} \\\\
                                &=  180 -  2 \times 36 - 45 \\\\
                                &=  180 -  72 - 45 \\\\
                                &=  63
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

George plants a tree in his garden which is initially $180 \ \text{cm}$ high.

After the first year it has increased in height by $30\%$. During the following year its height increased by $25\%$.

How tall is the tree at the end of the second year?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">George plants a tree in his garden which is initially $180 \ \text{cm}$ high.
<emptyline>
After the first year it has increased in height by $30\%$. During the following year its height increased by $25\%$.
<emptyline>
How tall is the tree at the end of the second year?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If the height increased by $30 \%$, then the new height will be $100 + 30 = 130 \%$ of the previous height. Using that, we get

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Tree height after first year}  &= \dfrac {130} {100} \times 180 \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac {130 \times 180} {100} \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac {13\cancel{0} \times 18\cancel{0}} {1\cancel{0}\cancel{0}} \\\\
                                      &= 13 \times 18 \\\\
                                      &= 234 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$

If the height increased by $25 \%$, then the new height will be $100 + 25 = 125 \%$ of the previous height. Using that, we get

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Tree height after second year} &= \dfrac {125} {100} \times 234 \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac {125 \times 234} {100} \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac {29250} {100} \\\\
                                      &= 292.5 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$

Tree height at the end of the second year $= 292.5$ cm.
</div>
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>

                                       &= \dfrac {125 \times 130 \times 180} {100 \times 100} \\\\
                                       &= \dfrac {125 \times 13\cancel{0} \times 18\cancel{0}} {100 \times 1\cancel{0}\cancel{0}} \\\\
                                       &= \dfrac {125 \times 13 \times 18} {100} \\\\
                                       &= \dfrac {29250} {100} \\\\
                                       &= 292.5 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$

Tree height at the end of the second year $= 292.5$ cm.
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The Palladium can hold $2175$ spectators.

If $305$ of the seats are empty how many of the seats are taken?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The Palladium can hold $2175$ spectators.
<emptyline>
If $305$ of the seats are empty how many of the seats are taken?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Seats taken}     &= \text{Total seats} - \text{Empty seats} \\\\
                        &=  2175 - 305 \\\\
                        &=  1870
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">

**Answer**

$1870$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A bottle of fizzy pop holds $750 \ \text{ml}$.

How many $150 \ \text{ml}$ glasses can be filled from this bottle?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A bottle of fizzy pop holds $750 \ \text{ml}$.
<emptyline>
How many $150 \ \text{ml}$ glasses can be filled from this bottle?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of glasses} &= \dfrac { \text{Total drink in the bottle} } { \text{Capacity of a glass} } \\\\
                        &= \dfrac { 750 } { 150 } \\\\
                        &= \dfrac { 5 \times 150 } { 150 } \\\\
                        &= \dfrac { 5 \times \cancel{150} } { \cancel{150} } \\\\
                        &= 5
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$5$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

George had a bag full of $24$ apples.

-  He gave half of them to his Granny to make an apple pie.
-  He gave two thirds of what was left to his friends and then put the rest in the fruit bowl.

How many did he put in the fruit bowl?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">George had a bag full of $24$ apples.
<emptyline>
-  He gave half of them to his Granny to make an apple pie.
-  He gave two thirds of what was left to his friends and then put the rest in the fruit bowl.
<emptyline>
How many did he put in the fruit bowl?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If George gave $\dfrac {1} {2}$ to his Granny, then he is left with $1 - \dfrac {1} {2} = \dfrac {1} {2}$ of the apples. Using that, we get

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Apples left}     &= \dfrac {1} {2} \times 24 \\\\
                        &= 12
\end{aligned}
$

If George gave $\dfrac {2} {3}$ to his friends, then he is left with $1 - \dfrac {2} {3} = \dfrac {1} {3}$ of the remaining apples. Using that, we get

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Apples left in the fruit bowl}     &= \dfrac {1} {3} \times 12 \\\\
                                          &= 4
\end{aligned}
$

Number of apples left in his fruit bowl $= 4$
</div>
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Alternate solution
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Apples left in the fruit bowl} &= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \dfrac {1} {3} \times 24 \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac {24} {2 \times 3} \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac {4 \times 2 \times 3} {2 \times 3} \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac {4 \times \cancel{2} \times \cancel{3}} {\cancel{2} \times \cancel{3}} \\\\
                                      &= 4
\end{aligned}
$

Number of apples left in the fruit bowl $= 4$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$4$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Freya scored $16$ out of $20$ in her spelling test. Hannah scored $85 \%$ in her spelling test.

Who did better? You must explain your answer.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Freya scored $16$ out of $20$ in her spelling test. Hannah scored $85 \%$ in her spelling test.
<emptyline>
Who did better? You must explain your answer.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let's calculate the percentage score for both.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Freya's score}      &= \dfrac {16} {20} \times 100 \\\\
                           &= \dfrac {16 \times 100} {20} \\\\
                           &= \dfrac {16 \times 5 \times 20} {20} \\\\
                           &= \dfrac {16 \times 5 \times \cancel{20}} {\cancel{20}} \\\\
                           &= 16 \times 5 \\\\
                           &= 80 \% \\\\
\text {Hannah's score}     &= 85 \%
\end{aligned}
$

From the calculation above, Hannah did better than Freya.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\text {Hannah}$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A bridge is built across a river. One quarter of the bridge is over the left bank of the river and one third of the bridge is over the right bank.

The river is $84 \ \text{m}$ wide. 

How long is the bridge?


</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A bridge is built across a river. One quarter of the bridge is over the left bank of the river and one third of the bridge is over the right bank.
<emptyline>
The river is $84 \ \text{m}$ wide. 
<emptyline>
How long is the bridge?
<emptyline>
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the length of the bridge $= L \ \text{m}$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Portions over banks}  &= \dfrac{L}{4} + \dfrac{L}{3} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{3L}{4 \times 3} + \dfrac{4L}{3 \times 4} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{3L}{12} + \dfrac{4L}{12} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{7L}{12} \\\\
\text{Portion over river}   &= L - \dfrac{7L}{12} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{12L}{12} - \dfrac{7L}{12} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{5L}{12} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{5 \times 84}{12}  \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{5 \times 7 \times 12}{12}  \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{5 \times 7 \times \cancel{12}}{\cancel{12}}  \\\\
                            &= 35 \ \text{m}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$35 \ \text{m}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A box contains bags of crisps.

Each bag of crisps weighs $25 \ \text{grams}$.

Altogether, the bags of crisps inside weigh $1 \ \text{kg}$.

How many bags of crisps are inside the box?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A box contains bags of crisps.
<emptyline>
Each bag of crisps weighs $25 \ \text{grams}$.
<emptyline>
Altogether, the bags of crisps inside weigh $1 \ \text{kg}$.
<emptyline>
How many bags of crisps are inside the box?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of bags of crisps $= b$

The weight of box is given in kg and weight of crisp bag is given in grams. Lets convert weight of box in grams.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total weight of the bags}         &= 1 \ \text{kg} \\\\
                                        &= 1 \times 1000 \ \text{grams} \\\\
                                        &= 1000 \ \text{grams}
\end{aligned}
$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
b \times 25                 &= 1000 \\\\
b                           &= \dfrac {1000} {25} \\\\
b                           &= \dfrac {25 \times 40} {25} \\\\
b                           &= \dfrac {\cancel {25} \times 40} {\cancel {25}} \\\\
b                           &= 40
\end{aligned}
$

Number of bags of crisps inside the box $= 40$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$40$

</div>
</div>

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Let the number of bags of crisps $= b$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Mel has 27 marbles. She gives $\dfrac{1}{3}$ of them to Vix 
and a half of the rest to Sarah. How many are left?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Mel has 27 marbles. She gives $\dfrac{1}{3}$ of them to Vix 
and a half of the rest to Sarah. How many are left?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Marbles left}            &=  \text {Total Marbles} -  \text {Marbles Vix got} - \text {Marbles Sarah got} \\\\
                                &=  27 -  \dfrac {1} {3} \times 27 - \dfrac {1} {4} \times 180 \\\\
                                &=  180 -  \dfrac {2 \times 180} {5}  - \dfrac {180} {4}  \\\\
                                &=  180 -  \dfrac {2 \times 36 \times 5} {5}  - \dfrac {45 \times 4} {4}  \\\\
                                &=  180 -  \dfrac {2 \times 36 \times \cancel{5}} {\cancel{5}}  - \dfrac{45 \times \cancel{4}} {\cancel{4}}  \\\\
                                &=  180 -  2 \times 36 - 45  \\\\
                                &=  180 -  72 - 45  \\\\
                                &=  63
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9$

</div>
</div>

                                &=  180 -  \dfrac {2 \times 180} {5}  - \dfrac {180} {4}  \\\\

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many $6 \ \text{cm}$ pieces of string can be 
cut from a piece of string $50 \ \text{cm}$ long? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many $6 \ \text{cm}$ pieces of string can be 
cut from a piece of string $50 \ \text{cm}$ long? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {No. of pieces}   &= \dfrac {\text {Total length of the string}} {\text {Length of a piece}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {50} {6} \\\\
                        &= 8 \ \text{remainder} \ 2 \\\\
                        &\approx 8 \ \text {pieces}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$8 \ \text {pieces}$

Small egg boxes can hold six eggs. How many egg boxes are needed to hold $50$ eggs?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of egg boxes needed $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a \times 6                          &= 50 \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {50} {6} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {25 \times 2} {3 \times 2} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {25 \times \cancel 2} {3 \times \cancel 2} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {25} {3} \\\\
a                                   &= 8 \dfrac {1} {3} \\\\
a                                   &= 9
\end{aligned}
$

Number of egg boxes needed $= 9$.
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Lisa has some boxes that are all cubes of the same size.

She uses four of the boxes to make a pile with a height of $72 \ \text{cm}$.

She puts one more box on top of the pile.

![papers/alderley-edge-school-for-girls/sample/sample-paper-2/s02-q14-i00.png](/assets/papers/alderley-edge-school-for-girls/sample/sample-paper-2/s02-q14-i00.png "papers/alderley-edge-school-for-girls/sample/sample-paper-2/s02-q14-i00.png")

Work out the height of the pile of **five** boxes.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Lisa has some boxes that are all cubes of the same size.
<emptyline>
She uses four of the boxes to make a pile with a height of $72 \ \text{cm}$.
<emptyline>
She puts one more box on top of the pile.
<emptyline>
%image%
<emptyline>
Work out the height of the pile of **five** boxes.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Height of the pile of 5 boxes}            &= 5 \times \dfrac {72} {4} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {5 \times 72} {4} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {5 \times 18 \times 4} {4} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {5 \times 18 \times \cancel 4} {\cancel 4} \\\\
                                                &= 5 \times 18 \\\\
                                                &= 90 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$90 \ \text{cm}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

An icicle measured $2.14 \ \text{m}$ at the start of a sunny day, but only $87 \ \text{cm}$ at the end of the day. What length of icicle had melted?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">An icicle measured $2.14 \ \text{m}$ at the start of a sunny day, but only $87 \ \text{cm}$ at the end of the day. What length of icicle had melted?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Length of icicle at start of the day}         &= 2.14 \ \text{m} \\\\
                                                    &= 2.14 \times 100 \ \text{cm} \\\\
                                                    &= 214 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Length of icicle melted}          &= 214 - 87 \\\\
                                        &= 127 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

When I lay a new patio in my back garden, I will need $290 \ \text{kg}$ of gravel. How many $12 \ \text{kg}$ bags do I need to buy?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">When I lay a new patio in my back garden, I will need $290 \ \text{kg}$ of gravel. How many $12 \ \text{kg}$ bags do I need to buy?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of bags}               &= \dfrac {290} {12} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {145 \times 2} {6 \times 2} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {145 \times \cancel 2} {6 \times \cancel 2} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {145} {6} \\\\
                                    &= 24 \dfrac {1} {6} \\\\
                                    &= 25
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Angus and his six friends have collected $756$ football stickers, which they all share out equally.  
How many stickers do they each get?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Angus and his six friends have collected $756$ football stickers, which they all share out equally.  
How many stickers do they each get?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Stickers each get}                 &= \dfrac {\text{Total stickers}} {\text{Total people}} \\\\
                                              &= \dfrac {756} {7} \\\\
                                              &= \dfrac {7 \times 108} {7} \\\\
                                              &= \dfrac {\cancel{7} \times 108} {\cancel{7}} \\\\
                                              &= 108
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

**Question**

Amar works for $45$ weeks each year. 
His total cost of travelling to and from work is $\pounds 630$ each year. 
How much is that per week?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Amar works for $45$ weeks each year. 
His total cost of travelling to and from work is $\pounds 630$ each year. 
How much is that per week?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Travelling cost per week}        &= \dfrac {\text{Total cost each year}} {\text{No. of weeks}} \\\\
                                              &= \dfrac {630} {45} \\\\
                                              &= \dfrac {14 \times 45} {45} \\\\
                                              &= \dfrac {14 \times \cancel{45}} {\cancel{45}} \\\\
                                              &= \pounds 14
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$\pounds 14$

**Question**

At Redville Primary School, $16$ of the teachers travel to work by car, $6$ travel by bus and the other $3$ walk. 

|  Car | Bus | Walk |
|:----:|:---:|:----:|
| $16$ | $6$ |  $3$ |

</div>

</code></pre>

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

                                              &= \dfrac {349} {8} \\\\
                                              &= 43 \text{ remainder } 5 \\\\

\end{aligned}
$

**Question**

Flora is exactly eleven and a half years old. How many months old is she?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Flora is exactly eleven and a half years old. How many months old is she?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Flora's age}                  &= 11 \dfrac {1} {2} \ \text{years} \\\\
                                    &= 11 \dfrac {1} {2} \times 12 \ \text{months} \\\\
                                    &= 11 \dfrac {1} {2} \times 12 \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {23 \times 12} {2} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {23 \times 2 \times 6} {2} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {23 \times \cancel{2} \times 6} {\cancel{2}} \\\\
                                    &= 138 \ \text{months}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$138 \ \text{months}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

How many peanuts did Monkey $D$ eat?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many peanuts did Monkey $D$ eat?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Peanuts eaten by Monkey A}        &= \dfrac {1} {2} \times 60 \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {60} {2} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {30 \times 2} {2} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {30 \times \cancel 2} {\cancel 2} \\\\
                                        &= 30 \\\\
\text{Peanuts eaten by Monkey B}          &= \dfrac {1} {3} \times (60 - 30) \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {30} {3} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {10 \times 3} {3} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {10 \times \cancel 3} {\cancel 3} \\\\
                                        &= 10 \\\\
\text{Peanuts eaten by Monkey C}          &= \dfrac {1} {4} \times (60 - 30 - 10) \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {20} {4} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {5 \times 4} {4} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {5 \times \cancel 4} {\cancel 4} \\\\
                                        &= 5 \\\\
\text{Peanuts eaten by Monkey D}          &= \dfrac {1} {5} \times (60 - 30 - 10 - 5) \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {15} {5} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 5} {5} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel 5} {\cancel 5} \\\\
                                        &= 3
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Peanuts left after Monkey A}      &= \dfrac {1} {2} \times 60 \\\\
\text{Peanuts left after Monkey B}      &= \dfrac {2} {3} \times \dfrac {1} {2} \times 60 \\\\
\text{Peanuts left after Monkey C}      &= \dfrac {3} {4} \times \dfrac {2} {3} \times \dfrac {1} {2} \times 60 \\\\
\text{Peanuts eaten by Monkey D}        &= \dfrac {1} {5} \times \dfrac {3} {4} \times \dfrac {2} {3} \times \dfrac {1} {2} \times 60 \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 2 \times 60} {5 \times 4 \times 3 \times 2} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 2 \times 5 \times 4 \times 3} {5 \times 4 \times 3 \times 2} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 4 \times \cancel 3} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 4 \times \cancel 3 \times \cancel 2} \\\\
                                        &= 3
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$3$

</div>

**Question**

$20 \%$ of a number is $3.2$. What is the number?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$20 \%$ of a number is $3.2$. What is the number?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number $=a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
20 \% \ \text{of} \ a           &= 3.2 \\\\
\dfrac {20} {100} \times a      &= \dfrac {32} {10} \\\\
a                               &= \dfrac {32} {10} \times \dfrac {100} {20} \\\\
a                               &= \dfrac {32 \times 100} {10 \times 20} \\\\
a                               &= \dfrac {16 \times 2 \times 20 \times 5} {2 \times 5 \times 20} \\\\
a                               &= \dfrac {16 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel {20} \times \cancel 5} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel {20}} \\\\
a                               &= 16
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

Calculate the value of $135 \div (1 + 3 + 5)$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

</div>

&= \dfrac {135} {1 + 3 + 5} \\\\

&= \dfrac {9 \times 15} {9} \\\\
&= \dfrac {\cancel 9 \times 15} {\cancel 9} \\\\
&= 15
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

                        &= 219
\end{aligned}
$

**Question**

Calculate $50 \%$ of $20 \%$ of $6000$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Calculate $50 \%$ of $20 \%$ of $6000$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 50 \% \ \text{of} \ 20 \% \ \text{of} \ 6000 \\\\
&= \dfrac {50} {100} \times \dfrac {20} {100} \times 6000 \\\\
&= \dfrac {50 \times 20 \times 6000} {100 \times 100} \\\\
&= \dfrac {5 \cancel 0 \times 2 \cancel 0 \times 60 \cancel {00}} {1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0 \times 1 \cancel {00}} \\\\
&= 5 \times 2 \times 60 \\\\
&= 10 \times 60 \\\\
&= 600
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

&= \dfrac {2017 \times 10001} {2017} \\\\
&= \dfrac {\cancel {2017} \times 10001} {\cancel {2017}} \\\\
&= 10001
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

At Ali's shop, a multipack of $8$ toilet rolls costs $\pounds 2.40$. 

At Mya's shop, the cost per toilet roll is twice as much. 

How much is a pack of $3$ toilet rolls at Mya's shop?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">At Ali's shop, a multipack of $8$ toilet rolls costs $\pounds 2.40$. 
<emptyline>
At Mya's shop, the cost per toilet roll is twice as much. 
<emptyline>
How much is a pack of $3$ toilet rolls at Mya's shop?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost at Ali's shop}                   &= \dfrac {2.40} {8} \\\\
                                            &= \pounds 0.30 \\\\
\text{Cost at Mya's shop}                   &= 0.30 \times 2 \\\\
                                            &= \pounds 0.60 \\\\
\text{Cost of 3 rolls at Mya's shop}        &= 0.60 \times 3 \\\\
                                            &= \pounds 1.80
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 1.80$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Twelve people (and no more) can sit evenly spaced around a square table. 

Deesha puts eight of these square tables together in a row to make one very long rectangular table. 

What is the maximum number of people that can sit evenly spaced around this long table?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Twelve people (and no more) can sit evenly spaced around a square table. 
<emptyline>
Deesha puts eight of these square tables together in a row to make one very long rectangular table. 
<emptyline>
What is the maximum number of people that can sit evenly spaced around this long table?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

The long rectangle has $2$ long sides and $2$ short sides.

Each short side is same as $1$ side of a square table.
Each square table contributes one segment of the long side. Each long side is same as side of $8$ square tables.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of people on each side of square table}    &= \dfrac {12} {4} \\\\
                                                        &= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel 4} {\cancel 4} \\\\
                                                        &= 3 \\\\
\text{Number of people on long table}          & = 2 \times \text{(people on short sides)} + 2 \times \text{(people on long sides)} \\\\     
&= 2 \times 3 + 2 \times 8 \times 3  \\\\
                                                        &= 6 + 48 \\\\
                                                        &= 54
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$54$

</div>
</div>

</div>

<emptyline>
Each short side is same as $1$ side of a square table.
Each square table contributes one segment of the long side. Each long side is same as side of $8$ square tables.
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}

                                                        &= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel 4} {\cancel 4} \\\\
                                                        &= 3 \\\\
\text{Number of people on long table}          & = 2 \times \text{(people on short sides)} + 2 \times \text{(people on long sides)} \\\\

                                                        &= 54

$
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Granny takes one a day of each of two types of tablet. 

One type of tablet is in packets of $25$ and the other type is in packets of $20$. 

She starts new packets of both on $1 ^ \text{st}$ March. 

On what date will she next start new packets of both?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Granny takes one a day of each of two types of tablet. 
<emptyline>
One type of tablet is in packets of $25$ and the other type is in packets of $20$. 
<emptyline>
She starts new packets of both on $1 ^ \text{st}$ March. 
<emptyline>
On what date will she next start new packets of both?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

She will next start new packets of both on a day that is a common multiple of $20$ and $25$ days after $1 ^ \text{st}$ March.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of days}          &= \text{LCM of 20 and 25} \\\\
                                        &= 100 \\\\
\text{Date}                    &= 1 \text{st March} + 100 \ \text{days} \\\\
                                        &= 8 \text{th June}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

My flask holds $480 \ \text{ml}$ when it is one quarter empty.

How much does it hold when it is one quarter full?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">My flask holds $480 \ \text{ml}$ when it is one quarter empty.
<emptyline>
How much does it hold when it is one quarter full?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the capacity of the flask $=a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {3} {4} \times a                 &= 480 \\\\
\dfrac {3 \times a} {4}                 &= 480 \\\\
\dfrac {a} {4}                          &= \dfrac {480} {3} \\\\
\dfrac {a} {4}                          &= \dfrac {3 \times 160} {3} \\\\
\dfrac {a} {4}                          &= \dfrac {\cancel{3} \times 160} {\cancel{3}} \\\\
\dfrac {a} {4}                          &= 160 \ \text{ml}
\end{aligned}
$

Capacity when one quarter full $= 160 \ \text{ml}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$160 \ \text{ml}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

![papers/bancrofts-school/2018/sample-paper-4/s01-q11-s02-i00.png](/assets/papers/bancrofts-school/2018/sample-paper-4/s01-q11-s02-i00.png "papers/bancrofts-school/2018/sample-paper-4/s01-q11-s02-i00.png")

In the diagram, the small squares are all the same size.

What fraction of the large square is shaded?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

</code></pre>

<div class="workings">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Shaded squares}            &= 9 \\\\
\text{Unshaded squares}          &= 4 + 8 \times \dfrac {1} {2} + 4 \times \dfrac {1} {4} \\\\
                                 &= 4 + \dfrac {8} {2} + \dfrac {4} {4} \\\\
                                 &= 4 + 4 + 1 \\\\
                                 &= 9
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Fraction of shaded squares}          &= \dfrac {\text{Shaded squares}} {\text{Total squares}} \\\\
                                           &= \dfrac {9} {9 + 9} \\\\
                                           &= \dfrac {9} {18} \\\\
                                           &= \dfrac {9} {2 \times 9} \\\\
                                           &= \dfrac {\cancel 9} {2 \times \cancel 9} \\\\
                                           &= \dfrac {1} {2}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Dave has a lot of tables.

Each rectangular table seats $8$ people.

Each round table seats $5$ people.

What is the smallest number of tables of each type that 
Dave needs to use to seat $35$ friends and himself, without any empty seats? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Dave has a lot of tables.
<emptyline>
Each rectangular table seats $8$ people.
<emptyline>
Each round table seats $5$ people.
<emptyline>
What is the smallest number of tables of each type that 
Dave needs to use to seat $35$ friends and himself, without any empty seats? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Total people $= 35 + 1 = 36$

Let the number of rectangular tables $= r$

Let the number of round tables $= c$

As per the question,

$8r + 5c = 36$

We have only $1$ equation with $2$ variables. This can be solved by trial and error.

| $r$   | $c$                                    | $c$ integer? |
|:-------------:|:--------------------------------------------------|:------------:|
| $1$           | $c = (36 - 8 \times 1) \div 5 = 28 \div 5 = 5.6$  | No           |
| $2$           | $c = (36 - 8 \times 2) \div 5 = 20 \div 5 = 4$    | Yes         |
| $3$           | $c = (36 - 8 \times 3) \div 5 = 12 \div 5 = 2.4$  | No           |
| $4$           | $c = (36 - 8 \times 4) \div 5 = 4 \div 5 = 0.8$   | No           |

Number of rectangular tables $= 2$

Number of round tables $= 4$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

rectangular tables $=$ $2$

</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

round tables $=$ $4$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

Fill in each box with either $+$ or $-$ to make the answer of $100$.

$
123 \ \boxed{\ \phantom{+} \ } \
45  \ \boxed{\ \phantom{+} \ } \ 
67  \ \boxed{\ \phantom{+} \ } \ 
89  \ \boxed{\ \phantom{+} \ } \ = \ 100
$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Last year, $275$ of the $500$ pupils at Woodgreen School were boys.

This year, there are $540$ pupils in the school but the proportion of boys is the same as last year.

How many boys are at the school this year?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Last year, $275$ of the $500$ pupils at Woodgreen School were boys.
<emptyline>
This year, there are $540$ pupils in the school but the proportion of boys is the same as last year.
<emptyline>
How many boys are at the school this year?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of boys this year $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {a} {540}                    &= \dfrac {275} {500} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {540 \times 275} {500} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {27 \times 20 \times 25 \times 11} {25 \times 20} \\\\
a                                   &= \dfrac {27 \times \cancel {20} \times \cancel {25} \times 11} {\cancel {25} \times \cancel {20}} \\\\
a                                   &= 27 \times 11 \\\\
a                                   &= 297
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$297$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Maya cuts a $6 \ \text{metre}$ piece of string unto three different pieces.

The longest piece is $40 \ \text{cm}$ longer than the middle piece.

The middle piece is $70 \ \text{cm}$ longer than the shorter piece.

How long (in centimetres) is the longest piece?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Maya cuts a $6 \ \text{metre}$ piece of string unto three different pieces.
<emptyline>
The longest piece is $40 \ \text{cm}$ longer than the middle piece.
<emptyline>
The middle piece is $70 \ \text{cm}$ longer than the shorter piece.
<emptyline>
How long (in centimetres) is the longest piece?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the longest piece length     $= a \ \text{cm}$

Length of middle piece           $= (a - 40) \ \text{cm}$

Length of shortest piece           $= (a - 40 - 70) \ \text{cm}$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a \ \text{cm} + (a - 40) \ \text{cm} + (a - 40 - 70) \ \text{cm}   &= 6 \ \text{m} \\\\
a \ \text{cm} + (a - 40) \ \text{cm} + (a - 110) \ \text{cm}   &= 6 \times 100 \ \text{cm} \\\\
a + a - 40 + a - 110                                           &= 6 \times 100 \\\\
3a - 150                                               &= 600 \\\\
a                                                              &= \dfrac {600 + 150} {3} \\\\
a                                                              &= \dfrac {750} {3} \\\\
a                                                              &= \dfrac {3 \times 250} {3} \\\\
a                                                              &= \dfrac {\cancel 3 \times 250} {\cancel 3} \\\\
a                                                              &= 250 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$

Longest piece length $= 250 \ \text{cm}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$250 \ \text{cm}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A car journey starts at $10{:}27 \ \text{am}$ and finishes at $1{:}24 \ \text{pm}$. 

How many minutes did the journey take?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A car journey starts at $10{:}27 \ \text{am}$ and finishes at $1{:}24 \ \text{pm}$. 
<emptyline>
How many minutes did the journey take?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Duration of journey}   &= 1{:}24 \ \text{pm} - 10{:}27 \ \text{am} \\\\
                             &= 2 \ \text{hours} + 57 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                             &= 2 \times 60 \ \text{minutes} + 57 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                             &= 120 + 57 \\\\
                             &= 177 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$177 \ \text{minutes}$

**Question**

A child is $13$ years old and their parent is $40$ years old. 

In how many years' time will it be before the parent is exactly twice the child's age?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A child is $13$ years old and their parent is $40$ years old. 
<emptyline>
In how many years' time will it be before the parent is exactly twice the child's age?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of years $= t \ \text{years}$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
40 + t                              &= 2 \times (13 + t) \\\\
40 + t                              &= 2 \times 13 + 2 \times t \\\\
40 + t                              &= 26 + 2t \\\\
2t - t                              &= 40 - 26 \\\\
t                                   &= 14 \ \text{years}
\end{aligned}
$

Number of years $= 14 \ \text{years}$
</div>

**Working**

Directions in order anticlockwise:

- East ($0 \degree$)
- North ($90  \degree$)
- West ($180  \degree$)
- South ($270  \degree$)

\begin{aligned}

\text{Current direction}            &= 315 \degree + 225 \degree \\\\
                                    &= 540 \degree \\\\
                                    &= 540 \degree - 360 \degree \\\\
                                    &= 180 \degree \\\\
                                    &= \text{West}
\end{aligned}
$

Current direction $= \text{West}$
</div>
