<li class="questionContainer">
<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

My flask holds $480 \ \text{ml}$ when it is one quarter empty. 

How much does it hold when it is one quarter full?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">My flask holds $480 \ \text{ml}$ when it is one quarter empty. 
<emptyline>
How much does it hold when it is one quarter full?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let quantity of water it hold at one quarter full $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
\left( 1 - \dfrac {1} {4} \right) \ \text{fraction} : 480 \ \text{volume}  &= \dfrac {1} {4} \ \text{fraction} : a \ \text{volume} \\\\
\dfrac{\left( 1 - \dfrac {1} {4} \right)} {480}                            &= \dfrac {\dfrac {1} {4}} {a} \\\\
\dfrac{\dfrac {3} {4}} {480}                                               &= \dfrac {\dfrac {1} {4}} {a} \\\\
\dfrac {3} {4 \times 480}                                                  &= \dfrac {1} {4 \times a} \\\\
3 \times 4 \times a                                                        &= 4 \times 480 \\\\
a                                                                          &= \dfrac {4 \times 480} {3 \times 4} \\\\
a                                                                          &= \dfrac {4 \times 3 \times 160} {3 \times 4} \\\\
a                                                                          &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times \cancel 3 \times 160} {\cancel 3 \times \cancel 4} \\\\
a                                                                          &= 160 \ \text{ml}
\end{aligned}
$

Quantity of water it hold at one quarter full $= 160 \ \text{ml}$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{fraction}                                   &:& \text{volume} \\\\
= & \left( 1 - \dfrac {1} {4} \right)                 &:& 480 \ \text{ml} \\\\
= & \left( \dfrac {4} {4} - \dfrac {1} {4} \right)    &:& 480 \\\\
= & \dfrac {4 - 1} {4}                                &:& 480 \\\\
= & \dfrac {3} {4}                                    &:& 480 \\\\
= & \dfrac {1} {4}                                    &:& \dfrac {480} {3} \\\\
= & \dfrac {1} {4}                                    &:& \dfrac {3 \times 160} {3} \\\\
= & \dfrac {1} {4}                                    &:& \dfrac {\cancel 3 \times 160} {\cancel 3} \\\\
= & \dfrac {1} {4}                                    &:& 160 \ \text{ml}
\end{array}
$

Quantity of water it hold at one quarter full $= 160 \ \text{ml}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$160 \ \text{ml}$

</div>
</div>

\dfrac{\left( 1 - \dfrac {1} {4} \right)} {480}                            &= \dfrac {\dfrac {1} {4}} {a} \\\\
\dfrac{\dfrac {3} {4}} {480}                                               &= \dfrac {\dfrac {1} {4}} {a} \\\\
\dfrac {3} {4 \times 480}                                                  &= \dfrac {1} {4 \times a} \\\\
3 \times 4 \times a                                                        &= 4 \times 480 \\\\

a                                                                          &= 160 \ \text{ml}

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Dave has a lot of tables.

Each rectangular table seats $8$ people.

Each round table seats $5$ people.

What is the smallest number of tables of each type that 
Dave needs to use to seat $35$ friends and himself, without any empty seats? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Dave has a lot of tables.
<emptyline>
Each rectangular table seats $8$ people.
<emptyline>
Each round table seats $5$ people.
<emptyline>
What is the smallest number of tables of each type that 
Dave needs to use to seat $35$ friends and himself, without any empty seats? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Total people $= 35 + 1 = 36$

Let the number of rectangular tables $= r$

Let the number of round tables $= c$

As per the question,

$8r + 5c = 36$

We have only $1$ equation with $2$ variables. This can be solved by trial and error.

| $r$   | $c$                                    | $c$ integer? |
|:-------------:|:--------------------------------------------------|:------------:|
| $1$           | $c = (36 - 8 \times 1) \div 5 = 28 \div 5 = 5.6$  | No           |
| $2$           | $c = (36 - 8 \times 2) \div 5 = 20 \div 5 = 4$    | Yes         |
| $3$           | $c = (36 - 8 \times 3) \div 5 = 12 \div 5 = 2.4$  | No           |
| $4$           | $c = (36 - 8 \times 4) \div 5 = 4 \div 5 = 0.8$   | No           |

Number of rectangular tables $= 2$

Number of round tables $= 4$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

rectangular tables $=$ $2$

</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

round tables $=$ $4$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A farmer has $364$ ewes and each ewe has either one or two new born lambs. 
If there are $468$ lambs in total, how many of the ewes have twin lambs?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A farmer has $364$ ewes and each ewe has either one or two new born lambs. 
If there are $468$ lambs in total, how many of the ewes have twin lambs?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of ewes with twin lambs $= a$

Number of ewes with one born lamb $= 364 - a$

As per the questions,

$
\begin{aligned}
a \times 2 + (364 - a) \times 1     &= 468 \\\\
2a + 364 - a                        &= 468 \\\\
a + 364                             &= 468 \\\\
a                                   &= 468 - 364 \\\\
a                                   &= 104
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$104$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Eleanor receives $\pounds 20$ pocket money each week.
This week, she spent $\pounds 4.88$ on sweets at the shop.
She then put a third of what was left in her piggy bank.

How much money does she still have to spend?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Eleanor receives $\pounds 20$ pocket money each week.
This week, she spent $\pounds 4.88$ on sweets at the shop.
She then put a third of what was left in her piggy bank.
<emptyline>
How much money does she still have to spend?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Money left after sweets}      &= 20 - 4.88 \\\\
                                    &= \pounds 15.12 \\\\
\text{Money put in piggy bank}      &= \dfrac {1} {3} \times 15.12 \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {15.12} {3} \\\\
                                    &= \pounds 5.04 \\\\
\text{Money left}                   &= 20 - (4.88 + 5.04) \\\\
                                    &= 20 - (4.88 + 5.04) \\\\
                                    &= 20 - 9.92 \\\\
                                    &= \pounds 10.08
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 10.08$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

As everyone knows, a normal cat has $18$ claws, $5$ on each 
front leg and $4$ on each back leg.

At Harry's Care Home for Distressed Cats there are 
$4$ three-legged cats, each one with a different leg missing.

How many claws do they have all together?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">As everyone knows, a normal cat has $18$ claws, $5$ on each 
front leg and $4$ on each back leg.
<emptyline>
At Harry's Care Home for Distressed Cats there are 
$4$ three-legged cats, each one with a different leg missing.
<emptyline>
How many claws do they have all together?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

There are $4$ cats, each missing a different leg. So the missing legs are:

- Missing front left: $5$ claws
- Missing front right: $5$ claws
- Missing back left: $4$ claws
- Missing back right: $4$ claws

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total claws per cat}          &= 5 \times 2 + 4 \times 2 \\\\
                                    &= 10 + 8 \\\\
                                    &= 18 \\\\
\text{Claws lost by cats}           &= 5 + 5 + 4 + 4 \\\\
\text{Total claws}                  &= 4 \times 18 - (5 + 5 + 4 + 4) \\\\
                                    &= 72 - 18 \\\\
                                    &= 54
\end{aligned}
$

Total claws $= 54$.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$54$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">There are $4$ cats, each missing a different leg. So the missing legs are:
<emptyline>
- Missing front left: $5$ claws
- Missing front right: $5$ claws
- Missing back left: $4$ claws
- Missing back right: $4$ claws
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total claws per cat}          &= 5 \times 2 + 4 \times 2 \\\\
                                    &= 10 + 8 \\\\
                                    &= 18 \\\\
\text{Claws lost by cats}           &= 5 + 5 + 4 + 4 \\\\
\text{Total claws}                  &= 4 \times 18 - (5 + 5 + 4 + 4) \\\\
                                    &= 72 - 18 \\\\
                                    &= 54
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Total claws $= 54$.
</code></pre>
</div>

**Question**

How many packets of each type of sweet does she need to buy?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many packets of each type of sweet does she need to buy?
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">

%empty%
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of raspberry creams}       &= 30 \times 3 \\\\
                                        &= 90 \\\\
\text{Number of pineapple jellies}      &= 30 \times 1 \\\\
                                        &= 30 \\\\
\text{Number of lemon sours}            &= 30 \times 2 \\\\
                                        &= 60
\end{aligned}
$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of raspberry creams packets}       &= \dfrac {90} {15} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {15 \times 6} {15} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {\cancel {15} \times 6} {\cancel {15}} \\\\
                                                &= 6 \\\\
\text{Number of pineapple jellies packets}      &= \dfrac {30} {10} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {3 \cancel 0} {1 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                                &= 3 \\\\
\text{Number of lemon sours packets}            &= \dfrac {60} {20} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {20 \times 3} {20} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {\cancel {20} \times 3} {\cancel {20}} \\\\
                                                &= 3
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

Raspberry creams packets $= 6$

Pineapple jellies packets $= 3$

Lemon sours packets $= 3$

</div>
</div>

\end{aligned}

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I need exactly $1 \ \text{litre}$ of water.

I have a measuring jug that holds $400 \ \text{ml}$ when it is full.

Explain how I can use my measuring jug to obtain $1 \ \text{litre}$ of water. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I need exactly $1 \ \text{litre}$ of water.
<emptyline>
I have a measuring jug that holds $400 \ \text{ml}$ when it is full.
<emptyline>
Explain how I can use my measuring jug to obtain $1 \ \text{litre}$ of water. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Two full jugs} &= 400 + 400 \\\\
                     &= 800 \ \text{ml}
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{One half jug} &= \dfrac {400} {2} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {2 \times 200} {2} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {\cancel {2} \times 200} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
                    &= 200 \ \text{ml}
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total} &= 800 + 200 \\\\
             &= 1000 \ \text{ml} \\\\
             &= \dfrac {1000} {1000} \ \text{litre} \\\\
             &= \dfrac {\cancel {1000}} {\cancel {1000}} \\\\
             &= 1 \ \text{litre}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$2 \dfrac {1} {2} \ \text{jugs of water required}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How long, in metres, is a line of forty $10 \ \text{p}$ coins?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How long, in metres, is a line of forty $10 \ \text{p}$ coins?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Length of forty 10p coins}   &= 40 \times 25 \ \text {mm} \\\\
                                   &= 40 \times \dfrac {25} {1000} \ \text{m} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {40 \times 25} {1000} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {40 \times 25} {40 \times 25} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {\cancel {40} \times \cancel {25}} {\cancel {40} \times \cancel {25}} \\\\
                                   &= 1 \ \text{m}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$1 \ \text{m}$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Aidan can buy wine for his shop in two ways. 

Firstly, he can buy cases which each contain $12$ bottles of wine. Each case costs $\pounds 40$. 

Secondly, he can buy single bottles of wine at a cost of $\pounds 4.50$ each. For every $6$ bottles he buys, he gets $2$ extra bottles free.

Aidan decides he needs $96$ bottles of wine. Work out the cost by each of the two methods and then say which method is cheaper, and by how much. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Aidan can buy wine for his shop in two ways. 
<emptyline>
Firstly, he can buy cases which each contain $12$ bottles of wine. Each case costs $\pounds 40$. 
<emptyline>
Secondly, he can buy single bottles of wine at a cost of $\pounds 4.50$ each. For every $6$ bottles he buys, he gets $2$ extra bottles free.
<emptyline>
Aidan decides he needs $96$ bottles of wine. Work out the cost by each of the two methods and then say which method is cheaper, and by how much. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the total cost of cases  $= a$

Let the cost of individual bottles $= b$

Number of cases Adian have to buy $= \dfrac{96}{12}$

Number of individual bottles Adian have to buy $= \dfrac{96}{8} \times 6$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a &= \dfrac{96}{12} \times 40 \\\\
a &= \dfrac{12 \times 8}{12} \times 40 \\\\
a &= \dfrac{\cancel {12} \times 8}{\cancel {12}} \times 40 \\\\
a &= 8 \times 40 \\\\
a &= \pounds 320
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
b &= \dfrac{96}{8} \times 6 \times 4.50 \\\\
b &= \dfrac{12 \times 8}{8} \times 6 \times 4.50 \\\\
b &= \dfrac{\cancel 8 \times 12}{\cancel 8} \times 6 \times 4.50 \\\\
b &= 12 \times 6 \times 4.50 \\\\
b &= \pounds 324
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Therefore first method is cheaper by} &= \pounds 324 - \pounds 320 \\\\
                                            &= \pounds 4
\end{aligned}
$ 
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 320, \pounds 324, \pounds 4$

</div>
</div>

\begin{aligned}
a &= \dfrac{96}{12} \times 40 \\\\
a &= \dfrac{12 \times 8}{12} \times 40 \\\\
a &= \dfrac{\cancel {12} \times 8}{\cancel {12}} \times 40 \\\\
a &= 8 \times 40 \\\\
a &= \pounds 320
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
b &= \dfrac{96}{8} \times 6 \times 4.50 \\\\
b &= \dfrac{12 \times 8}{8} \times 6 \times 4.50 \\\\
b &= \dfrac{\cancel 8 \times 12}{\cancel 8} \times 6 \times 4.50 \\\\
b &= 12 \times 6 \times 4.50 \\\\
b &= \pounds 324
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Therefore first method is cheaper by} &= \pounds 324 - \pounds 320 \\\\
                                            &= \pounds 4
\end{aligned}
$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Cheadle Construction uses metal beams, like the one below, in buildings to support walls and ceilings.

![papers/the-manchester-grammar-school/2012/arithmetic-2/s01-q03-i00.png](/assets/papers/the-manchester-grammar-school/2012/arithmetic-2/s01-q03-i00.png "papers/the-manchester-grammar-school/2012/arithmetic-2/s01-q03-i00.png")

The beams can be placed in one of two ways so the end of the beam is in either Position $1$ or Position $2$.

![papers/the-manchester-grammar-school/2012/arithmetic-2/s01-q03-i01.png](/assets/papers/the-manchester-grammar-school/2012/arithmetic-2/s01-q03-i01.png "papers/the-manchester-grammar-school/2012/arithmetic-2/s01-q03-i01.png")

![papers/the-manchester-grammar-school/2012/arithmetic-2/s01-q03-i02.png](/assets/papers/the-manchester-grammar-school/2012/arithmetic-2/s01-q03-i02.png "papers/the-manchester-grammar-school/2012/arithmetic-2/s01-q03-i02.png")

The height and width of a beam (in $\text{cms}$) determines the size of the greatest load (in $\text{kgs}$) the beam can support, according to the following formula

$\bold { \textbf{Load} = 10 \times \textbf{height} \times \textbf{height} \times \textbf{width} }$

So if the height is $4 \ \text{cm}$ and the width is $6 \ \text{cm}$, the greatest load is given by

$L = 10 \times 4 \times 4 \times 6 = 960 \ \text{kg}$

</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The weight of a wall means that a beam in the wall is needed to support a load of $4860 \ \text{kg}$.

If the width of the beam had to be $6 \ \text{cm}$, what height of beam would a builder have to use?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The weight of a wall means that a beam in the wall is needed to support a load of $4860 \ \text{kg}$.
<emptyline>
If the width of the beam had to be $6 \ \text{cm}$, what height of beam would a builder have to use?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the height of the beam $= h$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
10 \times h \times h \times 6      &= 4860 \\\\
10 \times 6 \times h ^ 2           &= 4860 \\\\
h ^ 2                              &= \dfrac {4860} {10 \times 6} \\\\
h ^ 2                              &= \dfrac {10 \times 6 \times 81} {10 \times 6} \\\\
h ^ 2                              &= \dfrac {\cancel {10} \times \cancel 6 \times 81} {\cancel {10} \times \cancel 6} \\\\
h ^ 2                              &= 81 \\\\
h                                  &= \sqrt {81} \\\\
h                                  &= 9 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">

$9 \ \text{cm}$

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Let the height of the beam $= h$
<emptyline>
As per the question,
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
10 \times h \times h \times 6      &= 4860 \\\\
10 \times 6 \times h ^ 2           &= 4860 \\\\
h ^ 2                              &= \dfrac {4860} {10 \times 6} \\\\
h ^ 2                              &= \dfrac {10 \times 6 \times 81} {10 \times 6} \\\\
h ^ 2                              &= \dfrac {\cancel {10} \times \cancel 6 \times 81} {\cancel {10} \times \cancel 6} \\\\
h ^ 2                              &= 81 \\\\
h                                  &= \sqrt {81} \\\\
h                                  &= 9 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

John the electrician needs to cut three lengths of wire from the $5 \ \text{metre}$ roll he has brought with him to do a job. The three lengths he cuts are $85 \ \text{cm}$, $2.5 \ \text{metres}$ and $650 \ \text{mm}$. How much wire (in cms) will he have left after cutting off his lengths?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">John the electrician needs to cut three lengths of wire from the $5 \ \text{metre}$ roll he has brought with him to do a job. The three lengths he cuts are $85 \ \text{cm}$, $2.5 \ \text{metres}$ and $650 \ \text{mm}$. How much wire (in cms) will he have left after cutting off his lengths?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total wire length} &= 5 \ \text{m} \\\\
                         &= 5 \times 100 \\\\
                         &= 500 \ \text{cm} \\\\
\text{Total length cut}  &= 85 \ \text{cm} + 2.5 \ \text{m} + 650 \ \text{mm} \\\\
                         &= 85 \ \text{cm} + 250 \ \text{cm} + 65 \ \text{cm} \\\\
                         &= 85 + 250 + 65 \\\\
                         &= 400 \ \text{cm} \\\\
\text{Wire left}         &= 500 - 400 \\\\
                         &= 100 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$100 \ \text{cm}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Ollie is making some small snacks for a party. He cuts 
$1.2 \ \text{kg}$ of cheese into a number 
of $15 \ \text{g}$ pieces.  How many pieces does he have?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Ollie is making some small snacks for a party. He cuts 
$1.2 \ \text{kg}$ of cheese into a number 
of $15 \ \text{g}$ pieces.  How many pieces does he have?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of pieces}     &= \dfrac {1.2 \ \text{kg}} {15 \ \text{g}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {1.2 \times 1000 \ \text{g}} {15 \ \text{g}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {1200} {15} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {80 \times 15} {15} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {80 \times \cancel{15}} {\cancel{15}} \\\\
                            &= 80
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$80$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

*Lathes Engineering* produces ten boxes of screws every minute. It has to produce $48{,}000$ boxes of screws in five days. If its machines work an equal amount of time each day, work out the number of hours which will be needed **__each day__** to produce the boxes of screws needed.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">*Lathes Engineering* produces ten boxes of screws every minute. It has to produce $48{,}000$ boxes of screws in five days. If its machines work an equal amount of time each day, work out the number of hours which will be needed **__each day__** to produce the boxes of screws needed.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of boxes produced every minute}    &= 10 \\\\
\text{Number of boxes produced every hour}      &= 60 \times 10 \\\\
                                                &= 600 \\\\
\text{Number of working hours each day}         &= \dfrac {48000} {5 \times 600} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {600 \times 5 \times 16} {5 \times 600} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {\cancel {600} \times \cancel 5 \times 16} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel {600}} \\\\
                                                &= 16 \ \text{hours}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$16 \ \text{hours}$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of boxes produced every minute}    &= 10 \\\\
\text{Number of boxes produced every hour}      &= 60 \times 10 \\\\
                                                &= 600 \\\\
\text{Number of working hours each day}         &= \dfrac {48000} {5 \times 600} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {600 \times 5 \times 16} {5 \times 600} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {\cancel {600} \times \cancel 5 \times 16} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel {600}} \\\\
                                                &= 16 \ \text{hours}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Complete this bill for a small shopping trip, filling in the **__five__** missing quantities and amounts in the spaces provided.

{/*
,$\pounds \ldotp \ \text{p}$
$\ldots$ biscuits at $45  \ \text{p}$ each                        ,$3.60$
$\ldots$ eggs which cost $\pounds 1.60$ for twelve              ,$0.80$
$\ldots$ grams of butter at $\pounds 2.50 \ \text{per Kg}$      ,$1.50$
$\ldots$ litres of milk costing $90 \ \text{p}$ per litre         ,$\ldots$
**TOTAL**                                                           ,$\pounds 8.15$ 
*/}

|                                                                | $\pounds \ldotp \ \text{p}$ |
|----------------------------------------------------------------|:-------------------------:|
| $\ldots$ biscuits at $45  \ \text{p}$ each                   |           $3.60$          |
| $\ldots$ eggs which cost $\pounds 1.60$ for twelve         |           $0.80$          |
| $\ldots$ grams of butter at $\pounds 2.50 \ \text{per Kg}$ |           $1.50$          |
| $\ldots$ litres of milk costing $90 \ \text{p per litre}$    |          $\ldots$         |
| **TOTAL**                                                      |       $\pounds 8.15$      |

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Complete this bill for a small shopping trip, filling in the **__five__** missing quantities and amounts in the spaces provided.
<emptyline>
{/*
,$\pounds \ldotp \ \text{p}$
$\ldots$ biscuits at $45  \ \text{p}$ each                        ,$3.60$
$\ldots$ eggs which cost $\pounds 1.60$ for twelve              ,$0.80$
$\ldots$ grams of butter at $\pounds 2.50 \ \text{per Kg}$      ,$1.50$
$\ldots$ litres of milk costing $90 \ \text{p}$ per litre         ,$\ldots$
**TOTAL**                                                           ,$\pounds 8.15$ 
*/}
<emptyline>
|                                                                | $\pounds \ldotp \ \text{p}$ |
|----------------------------------------------------------------|:-------------------------:|
| $\ldots$ biscuits at $45  \ \text{p}$ each                   |           $3.60$          |
| $\ldots$ eggs which cost $\pounds 1.60$ for twelve         |           $0.80$          |
| $\ldots$ grams of butter at $\pounds 2.50 \ \text{per Kg}$ |           $1.50$          |
| $\ldots$ litres of milk costing $90 \ \text{p per litre}$    |          $\ldots$         |
| **TOTAL**                                                      |       $\pounds 8.15$      |
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of biscuits}        &= \dfrac {3.6 \times 100} {45} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {36 \times 10} {45} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {9 \times 4 \times 5 \times 2} {9 \times 5} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {\cancel 9 \times 4 \times \cancel 5 \times 2} {\cancel 9 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
                                 &= 4 \times 2 \\\\
                                 &= 8 \\\\
\text{Price of 1 egg}            &= \dfrac {1.6} {12} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {16} {12 \times 10} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {4 \times 2 \times 2} {4 \times 3 \times 2 \times 5} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 2 \times \cancel 2} {\cancel 4 \times 3 \times \cancel 2 \times 5} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {2} {3 \times 5} \\\\
                                 &= \pounds \dfrac {2} {15} \\\\
\text{Number of eggs}            &= \dfrac {0.8} {\dfrac {2} {15}} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {0.8 \times 15} {2} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {8 \times 15} {2 \times 10} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 5 \times 3} {2 \times 2 \times 5} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {2 \times 2 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times 3} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {2 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times 3} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
                                 &= 2 \times 3 \\\\
                                 &= 6 \\\\
\text{Amount of butter}          &= \dfrac {1.5} {2.5} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {15 \times 10} {25 \times 10} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {5 \times 3 \times 5 \times 2} {5 \times 5 \times 10} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {\cancel 5 \times 3 \times \cancel 5 \times 2} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 5 \times 10} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {3 \times 2} {10} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {6} {10} \\\\
                                 &= 0.6 \ \text{kg} \\\\
\text{Money left}                &= 8.15 - 3.6 - 0.8 - 1.5 \\\\
                                 &= \pounds 2.25 \\\\
\text{Volume of milk}            &= \dfrac {2.25 \times 100} {90} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {225 \times 100} {90 \times 100} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {9 \times 25 \times 100} {9 \times 10 \times 100} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {\cancel 9 \times 25 \times \cancel {100}} {\cancel 9 \times 10 \times \cancel {100}} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {25} {10} \\\\
                                 &= 2.5 \ \text{litres}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$8 \ \text{biscuits}, 6 \ \text{eggs}, 0.6 \ \text{kg butter}, \pounds 2.25, 2.5 \ \text{litres of milk}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Groups of car enthusiasts are going to a car festival. To get to the place where the festival is happening they have a number of different sizes of car available as follows:

**Two** seater sports cars

**Four** seater cars

**Six** seater people carriers

In order to keep the cost down, **__each vehicle used on the journey is always full__**.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Groups of car enthusiasts are going to a car festival. To get to the place where the festival is happening they have a number of different sizes of car available as follows:
<emptyline>
**Two** seater sports cars
<emptyline>
**Four** seater cars
<emptyline>
**Six** seater people carriers
<emptyline>
In order to keep the cost down, **__each vehicle used on the journey is always full__**.
</code></pre>

The second group has $76$ people in it. How many four seater cars will they need if they take $5$ sports cars and $7$ people carriers?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

Let the number of four seater cars needed $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
a \times 4 + 5 \times 2 + 7 \times 6         &= 76 \\\\

4a + 52                                      &= 76 \\\\
4a                                           &= 76 - 52 \\\\

a                                            &= \dfrac {4 \times 6} {4} \\\\
a                                            &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 6} {\cancel 4} \\\\
a                                            &= 6
\end{aligned}
$

Number of four seater cars needed $= 6$
</div>

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
8 \times 4 + a \times 2 + a \times 6         &= 112 \\\\

a                                            &= \dfrac {\cancel 8 \times 10} {\cancel 8} \\\\
a                                            &= 10
\end{aligned}
$

Number of sports cars and people carriers each needed $= 10$
</div>

**Question**

In the fourth group there are $66$ people. 
They need twice as many sports cars as four seater cars and twice as many four seater cars as people carriers.  
How many four seater cars do they use?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In the fourth group there are $66$ people. 
They need twice as many sports cars as four seater cars and twice as many four seater cars as people carriers.  
How many four seater cars do they use?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of people carriers needed $= a$

Number of four seater cars needed $= 2a$

Number of sports cars needed $= 4a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
2a \times 4 + 4a \times 2 + a \times 6      &= 66 \\\\
8a + 8a + 6a                                &= 66 \\\\
22a                                         &= 66 \\\\
a                                           &= \dfrac {66} {22} \\\\
a                                           &= \dfrac {22 \times 3} {22} \\\\
a                                           &= \dfrac {\cancel {22} \times 3} {\cancel {22}} \\\\
a                                           &= 3
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of four seater cars used}            &= 2 \times a \\\\
                                                  &= 2 \times 3 \\\\
                                                  &= 6
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$6$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Mr Smith, a maths teacher, takes $8\, \text{minutes}$ to mark each pupil's homework. He has a class of $31$. How many minutes will he save if $7$ of the class are absent?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>

</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

                         &= 56 \ \text{mins}
\end{aligned}

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is the mass of $16\, \text{tins}$, each of mass $178\,\text{g}$?

Give your answer in **kilograms.**

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is the mass of $16\, \text{tins}$, each of mass $178\,\text{g}$?
<emptyline>
Give your answer in **kilograms.**
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Mass of 1 tin}                    &= 178 \text{ g} \\\\
\text{Mass of 16 tins}                  &= 16 \times 178 \text{ g} \\\\
                                        &= 2848 \text { g} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {2848} {1000} \text { kg} \\\\
                                        &= 2.848 \text { kg}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

How many were given socks?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many were given socks?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

**Formulas**

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Teachers with socks}   &= \dfrac {4} {9} \times 45 \\\\
&= \dfrac {4 \times 45} {9} \\\\
&= \dfrac {4 \times 5 \times 9} {9} \\\\
&= \dfrac {4 \times 5 \times \cancel {9}} {\cancel {9}} \\\\
&= 4 \times 5 \\\\
&= 20 \ \text{teachers}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$20$

</div>

**Question**

$20\%$ of those who were given socks also received a tie. How many were given socks and a tie?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$20\%$ of those who were given socks also received a tie. How many were given socks and a tie?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$ 
\begin{aligned}
&= 20 \% \ \text{of} \ 20 \  \text {teachers} \\\\
&= \dfrac {20} {100} \times 20 \\\\
&= \dfrac {20 \times 20} {100} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5} {2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times 2 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
&= 2 \times 2 \\\\
&= 4 \ \text {teachers}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

![papers/the-queens-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q12-i00.png](/assets/papers/the-queens-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q12-i00.png "papers/the-queens-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q12-i00.png")  

Biscuits are sold in packets of $12$.

How many packets will I need to buy if I want $148$ biscuits?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%image%  
<emptyline>
Biscuits are sold in packets of $12$.
<emptyline>
How many packets will I need to buy if I want $148$ biscuits?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of packets needed to buy}       &= \dfrac {\text{Total number of biscuits}} {\text{Number of biscuits in each packet}} \\\\
                                             &= \dfrac {148} {12} \\\\
                                             &= 12 \text{ remainder } 4 \\\\
                                             &\approx 13
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{Biscuits}                   &:& \text{Packets} \\\\
= & 12                                &:& 1 \\\\
= & 1                                 &:& \dfrac {1} {12} \\\\
= & 1 \times 148                      &:& \dfrac {148} {12} \\\\
= & 148                               &:& 12 \text{ remainder } 4 \\\\
= & 148                               &:& \approx 13
\end{array}
$

Number of packets needed to buy $= 13$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$13 \ \text{packets}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Concert tickets for $4$ adults cost a total of $\pounds 62.$        

Children are admitted at half price.

What would it cost for $2$ adults and a child to attend the same concert?

![papers/the-queens-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q21-i00.png](/assets/papers/the-queens-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q21-i00.png "papers/the-queens-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q21-i00.png")


</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Concert tickets for $4$ adults cost a total of $\pounds 62.$        
<emptyline>
Children are admitted at half price.
<emptyline>
What would it cost for $2$ adults and a child to attend the same concert?
<emptyline>
%image%
<emptyline>
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of one adult} &= \dfrac {62} {4} \\\\
\text{Cost of one child} &= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \dfrac {62} {4} \\\\
\text{Total cost}        &= 2 \times \dfrac {62} {4} + \dfrac {1} {2} \times \dfrac {62} {4}\\\\
                         &= \dfrac {2 \times 62} {4} + \dfrac {62} {2 \times 4} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {2 \times 2 \times 31} {2 \times 2} + \dfrac {2 \times 31} {2 \times 4} \\\\
                         &= \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 2 \times 31} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 2} + \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times 31} {\cancel 2 \times 4} \\\\
                         &= 31 + \dfrac {31} {4} \\\\
                         &= 31 + 7.75 \\\\
                         &= \pounds 38.75 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 38.75$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Ben has $\pounds 68$. He gives a quarter of this to his sister. How much does he have left?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Ben has $\pounds 68$. He gives a quarter of this to his sister. How much does he have left?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Money given to sister} &= \dfrac{1}{4} \times 68 \\\\
&= \dfrac{68}{4} \\\\
&= \dfrac{4 \times 17}{4} \\\\
&= \dfrac{\cancel{4} \times 17}{\cancel{4}} \\\\
&= \pounds 17 \\\\
\text{Money left} &= 68 - 17 \\\\
&= \pounds 51
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

&= \pounds 6.96
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Homer, Marge and Bart each have $1000$.

Homer gives $10\%$ of his money to Marge. Marge then gives $10\%$ of her new amount to Bart. Bart then gives $10\%$ of his new amount to Homer.

How much has Homer got now?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Homer, Marge and Bart each have $1000$.
<emptyline>
Homer gives $10\%$ of his money to Marge. Marge then gives $10\%$ of her new amount to Bart. Bart then gives $10\%$ of his new amount to Homer.
<emptyline>
How much has Homer got now?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Amount Homer gives to Marge}          &= 10 \% \ \text{of} \ 1000 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {10} {100} \times 1000 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {10 \times 1000} {100} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {10 \times 10 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} {1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                            &= 10 \times 10 \\\\
                                            &= 100 \\\\
\text{Amount Homer is left with}            &= 1000 - 100\\\\ 
                                            &= 900 \\\\                                           
\text{New amount that Marge has}            &= 1000 + 100 \\\\   
                                            &= 1100 \\\\                                        
\text{Amount Marge gives to Bart}           &= 10 \% \ \text{of} \ 1100 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {10} {100} \times 1100 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {10 \times 1100} {100} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {10 \times 11 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} {1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                            &= 10 \times 11 \\\\
                                            &= 110 \\\\
\text{New amount that Bart has}             &= 1000 + 110 \\\\   
                                            &= 1110 \\\\                                        
\text{Amount Bart gives to Homer}           &= 10 \% \ \text{of} \ 1110 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {10} {100} \times 1110 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {10 \times 1110} {100} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {1 \cancel 0 \times 111 \cancel 0} {1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                            &= 1 \times 111 \\\\
                                            &= 111 \\\\
\text{New amount that Homer has}            &= 900 + 111 \\\\   
                                            &= 1011
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$1011$

</div>
</div>

                              &= \dfrac {7 \times 30} {2} + 20 \\\\

                              &= \dfrac {7 \times \cancel 2 \times 15} {\cancel 2} + 20 \\\\
                              &= 7 \times 15 + 20 \\\\
                              &= 105 + 20 \\\\
                              &= 125 \ \text{mins}
\end{aligned}
$

= & 3 \dfrac {1} {2}                        &:& 15 \times 7 \\\\

\end{array}

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Three gear wheels turn one another. $X$ has $8$ teeth, $Y$ has $12$ teeth and $Z$ has $16$ teeth. In one minute, $X$ turns $30$ times. In this time, how many turns do $Y$ and $Z$ make? Draw arrows to show the directions in which $Y$ and $Z$ move.


![papers/whitgift-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s02-q08-i00.png](/assets/papers/whitgift-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s02-q08-i00.png "papers/whitgift-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s02-q08-i00.png")

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Three gear wheels turn one another. $X$ has $8$ teeth, $Y$ has $12$ teeth and $Z$ has $16$ teeth. In one minute, $X$ turns $30$ times. In this time, how many turns do $Y$ and $Z$ make? Draw arrows to show the directions in which $Y$ and $Z$ move.
<emptyline>

%image%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of turn Y make}  &= \dfrac {8 \times 30} {12} \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {4 \times 2 \times 3 \times 10} {4 \times 3} \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 2 \times \cancel 3 \times 10} {\cancel 4 \times \cancel 3} \\\\
                              &= 2 \times 10 \\\\
                              &= 20 \\\\
\text{Number of turn Z make}  &= \dfrac {8 \times 30} {16} \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {4 \times 2 \times 3 \times 2 \times 5} {4 \times 2 \times 2} \\\\
                              &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times \cancel 2 \times 3 \times \cancel 2 \times 5} {\cancel 4 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 2} \\\\
                              &= 3 \times 5 \\\\
                              &= 15
\end{aligned}
$

Y revolves in the opposite direction to X.

Z revolves in the same direction as X.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$20 ,15$

</div>
</div>

                              &= 2 \times 10 \\\\

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

**Cough mixture**

A bottle contains $250\,\text{ml}$ of cough mixture.

**One adult** and **one child** need to take cough mixture **$4$ times a day** every day for **$5$ days**. 

Will there be enough cough mixture in the bottle? 

Explain your answer.

![papers/woldingham-school/2014/sample-paper-1/s02-q04-i00.png](/assets/papers/woldingham-school/2014/sample-paper-1/s02-q04-i00.png "papers/woldingham-school/2014/sample-paper-1/s02-q04-i00.png")



</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">**Cough mixture**
<emptyline>
A bottle contains $250\,\text{ml}$ of cough mixture.
<emptyline>
**One adult** and **one child** need to take cough mixture **$4$ times a day** every day for **$5$ days**. 
<emptyline>
Will there be enough cough mixture in the bottle? 
<emptyline>
Explain your answer.
<emptyline>
%image%
<emptyline>

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cough syrup required}             &= \text{Adult} + \text{Child} \\\\
                                        &= (10 \times 4 \times 5) + (5 \times 4 \times 5) \\\\
                                        &= 200 + 100 \\\\
                                        &= 300 \ \text{ml}
\end{aligned}
$

We need $300 \ \text{ml}$ and so there will not be enough cough mixture in the bottle.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

No

</div>
</div>

How many minions is he going to need?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

                            &= 52
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I roll a bouncy ball down the stairs. It bounces once after $2$ steps, then again after double the number of steps. 
It carries on falling, bouncing after triple the number of steps it had bounced originally. 
At this point how many steps lower is the ball than where it started?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I roll a bouncy ball down the stairs. It bounces once after $2$ steps, then again after double the number of steps. 
It carries on falling, bouncing after triple the number of steps it had bounced originally. 
At this point how many steps lower is the ball than where it started?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of steps before 1st bounce}        &= 2 \\\\
\text{Number of steps before 2nd bounce}        &= 2 \times 2 \\\\
                                                &= 4 \\\\
\text{Number of steps before 3rd bounce}        &= 2 \times 3 \\\\
                                                &= 6
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total number of steps}        &= 2 + 4 + 6 \\\\
                                    &= 12
\end{aligned}
$

Number of steps the ball lowered after it started rolling $= 12$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$12$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Which is greater $90 \%$ of $10 \%$ of $300$ or $80 \%$ of $20 \%$ of $200?$ 

You must show calculations to explain your answer.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Which is greater $90 \%$ of $10 \%$ of $300$ or $80 \%$ of $20 \%$ of $200?$ 
<emptyline>
You must show calculations to explain your answer.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned} 
\text{First number}     &= 90 \% \ \text {of} \ 10 \% \ \text {of} \ 300 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {90} {100} \times \dfrac {10} {100} \times 300 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {90 \times 10 \times 300} {100 \times 100} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {9 \cancel 0 \times 1 \cancel 0 \times 3 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} {1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0 \times 1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                        &= 9 \times 3 \\\\
                        &= 27 \\\\
\text{Second number}    &= 80 \% \ \text {of} \ 20 \% \ \text{of} \ 200 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {80} {100} \times \dfrac {20} {100} \times 200 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {80 \times 20 \times 200} {100 \times 100} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {8 \cancel 0 \times 2 \cancel 0 \times 2 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} {1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0 \times 1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                        &= 8 \times 2 \times 2 \\\\
                        &= 32
\end{aligned}
$

Answer $= 80 \%  \text { of }  20 \%  \text{ of } 200$
</div>
</div>

Missing letter $= \text{M}$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Mr Rich decided to share his wealth among his children. 

Richie as the oldest got $\dfrac{1}{3}$, 
Thrifty the second oldest got a $\dfrac{1}{3}$ of what was left, 
Bounty got $\dfrac{1}{2}$ of what was left once Richie and Thrifty got their share. 
The dog, Archie, got the rest. 

If Mr Rich shared $\pounds 9$ million pounds, how much did Archie get?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Mr Rich decided to share his wealth among his children. 
<emptyline>
Richie as the oldest got $\dfrac{1}{3}$, 
Thrifty the second oldest got a $\dfrac{1}{3}$ of what was left, 
Bounty got $\dfrac{1}{2}$ of what was left once Richie and Thrifty got their share. 
The dog, Archie, got the rest. 
<emptyline>
If Mr Rich shared $\pounds 9$ million pounds, how much did Archie get?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Archie's share of wealth}     &= \pounds \dfrac {1} {2} \times \left( \dfrac {2} {3} \times \left( \dfrac {2} {3} \times 9000000 \right) \right) \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \dfrac {2} {3} \times \dfrac {2} {3} \times 9000000 \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {1 \times 2 \times 2 \times 9000000} {2 \times 3 \times 3} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {2 \times 2 \times 3 \times 3 \times 1000000} {2 \times 3 \times 3} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {2 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 3 \times \cancel 3 \times 1000000} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 3 \times \cancel 3} \\\\
                                    &= 2 \times 1000000 \\\\
                                    &= \pounds 2000000
\end{aligned}
$

Share of Archie in Mr Rich wealth $= \pounds 2 \ \text{million}$.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 2 \ \text{million}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

There are $45$ scouts in a troop. The scouts are divided into patrols.
There must be at least $6$ patrols, and each patrol must have the same number of scouts.

What is the largest number of scouts that each patrol could contain?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">There are $45$ scouts in a troop. The scouts are divided into patrols.
There must be at least $6$ patrols, and each patrol must have the same number of scouts.
<emptyline>
What is the largest number of scouts that each patrol could contain?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Largest number of scouts per patrol}      &= \dfrac {45} {6} \\\\
                                                &= 7 \text{ remainder } 3 \\\\
                                                &\approx 7
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$7$

</div>
</div>
