<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A medicine bottle contains $90$ pills. Each pill weighs $250 \  \text{mg}$, The full bottle weighs $160 \  \text{g}$. How much does the empty bottle weigh?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A medicine bottle contains $90$ pills. Each pill weighs $250 \  \text{mg}$, The full bottle weighs $160 \  \text{g}$. How much does the empty bottle weigh?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total weight of pills}      &= 90 \times 250 \ \text{mg} \\\\
                                   &= 90 \times \dfrac {250} {1000} \ \text {g} \\\\
                                   &= 90 \times 0.25 \\\\
                                   &= 22.5 \ \text {g} \\\\
\text {Weight of empty bottle}     &= 160 - 22.5 \\\\
                                   &= 137.5 \ \text {g}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$137.5 \ \text {g}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a school $24\%$ of children have blond hair. If there are $1100$ children at a school, how many have blond hair?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a school $24\%$ of children have blond hair. If there are $1100$ children at a school, how many have blond hair?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Children that have blond hair}   &= 24 \% \ \text{of} \ 1100 \\\\
                                       &= \dfrac {24} {100} \times 1100 \\\\
                                       &= \dfrac {24 \times 1100} {100} \\\\
                                       &= \dfrac {24 \times 11 \cancel {00} } {1 \cancel {00} } \\\\
                                       &= 24 \times 11 \\\\
                                       &= 264
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$264$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A minibus carries $16$ pupils.

How many buses would be needed to take $300$ pupils?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A minibus carries $16$ pupils.
<emptyline>
How many buses would be needed to take $300$ pupils?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of bused required} &= \dfrac {300} {16} \\\\
                                &= 18 \text{ remainder } 12 \\\\
                                &\approx 19
\end{aligned}
$

We need $1$ more bus for the remaining $12$ pupils.

Total buses = $18 + 1 = 19$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$19$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many times can $117$ be subtracted from $1200$ before we get to zero?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many times can $117$ be subtracted from $1200$ before we get to zero?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of times} &= \dfrac {1200} {117} \\\\
                       &= \dfrac {3 \times 400} {3 \times 39} \\\\
                       &= \dfrac {\cancel 3 \times 400} {\cancel 3 \times 39} \\\\
                       &= \dfrac {400} {39} \\\\
                       &= 10 \text{ remainder } 10 \\\\
                       &\approx 10
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$10$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$6 \%$ of children wear glasses. If there are $1450$ children at a school, how many wear glasses?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$6 \%$ of children wear glasses. If there are $1450$ children at a school, how many wear glasses?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Children that wear glasses}   &= 6 \% \ \text{of} \ 1450 \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {6} {100} \times 1450 \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {6 \times 1450} {100} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {2 \times 3 \times 2 \times 29 \times 25} {2 \times 2 \times 25} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {\cancel {2} \times 3 \times \cancel {2} \times 29 \times \cancel {25} } {\cancel{2} \times \cancel{2} \times \cancel {25}} \\\\
                                    &= 3 \times 29 \\\\
                                    &= 87
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$87$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A full sweet jar weighs $180.5 \ \text{g}$. The jar contains $120$ sweets. Each sweet weighs $450 \ \text{mg}$.
How much does the empty jar weigh?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A full sweet jar weighs $180.5 \ \text{g}$. The jar contains $120$ sweets. Each sweet weighs $450 \ \text{mg}$.
How much does the empty jar weigh?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total weight of sweets}     &= 120 \times 450 \ \text{mg} \\\\
                                   &= 120 \times \dfrac {450}{1000} \ \text {g} \\\\
                                   &= 120 \times 0.45 \\\\
                                   &= 54 \ \text {g} \\\\
\text {Weight of empty jar }       &= 180.5 - 54 \\\\
                                   &= 126.5 \ \text {g}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$126.5 \ \text {g}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many $15\ \text{cm}$ strips can I cut from a ribbon $1\ \text{m}$ long?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many $15\ \text{cm}$ strips can I cut from a ribbon $1\ \text{m}$ long?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Number of strips}    &= \dfrac {1 \ \text{m}} {15 \ \text{cm}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {1 \times 100 \ \text{cm}} {15 \ \text{cm}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {5 \times 20} {5 \times 3} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {\cancel 5 \times 20} {\cancel 5 \times 3} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {20} {3} \\\\
                            &= 6 \text { remainder } 2 \\\\
                            &\approx 6
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$6$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A box contains $48$ pencils.

If I take out $\dfrac {3} {4}$ of the pencils how many would be left?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A box contains $48$ pencils.
<emptyline>
If I take out $\dfrac {3} {4}$ of the pencils how many would be left?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Pencils left}     &= \left( 1 - \dfrac {3} {4} \right) \times 48 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {1} {4} \times 48 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {48} {4} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {12 \times 4} {4} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {12 \times \cancel{4}} {\cancel{4}} \\\\
                        &= 12
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$12$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

At the school medical centre, there are enough plasters to patch up $12$ cut knees per day for $30 \ \text{days}$. 
Work out how long the plasters would last if the medical centre were having to treat $20$ boys with cut knees a day.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">At the school medical centre, there are enough plasters to patch up $12$ cut knees per day for $30 \ \text{days}$. 
Work out how long the plasters would last if the medical centre were having to treat $20$ boys with cut knees a day.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total plasters}     &= 12 \times 30 \\\\
\text{Number of days}     &= \dfrac {12 \times 30} {20} \\\\
                          &= \dfrac {2 \times 6 \times 3 \times 10} {2 \times 10} \\\\
                          &= \dfrac { \cancel{2} \times 6 \times 3 \times 1 \cancel{0}} { \cancel{2} \times 1 \cancel{0}} \\\\
                          &= 6 \times 3 \\\\
                          &= 18
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Simon and Fiona are sharing a cupboard. If Simon's things take up $\dfrac{2}{5}$ of the space and Fiona's things take up 
$\dfrac{2}{7}$ of the space, what fraction of the cupboard is empty? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Simon and Fiona are sharing a cupboard. If Simon's things take up $\dfrac{2}{5}$ of the space and Fiona's things take up 
$\dfrac{2}{7}$ of the space, what fraction of the cupboard is empty? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Empty Space}      &= \text{Total space} - \text{Used space} \\\\
                        &= 1 - \bigg(\dfrac {2} {5} + \dfrac {2} {7}\bigg) \\\\
                        &= 1 - \bigg(\dfrac {2 \times 7} {5 \times 7} + \dfrac {2 \times 5} {7 \times 5}\bigg) \\\\
                        &= 1 - \bigg(\dfrac {14} {35} + \dfrac {10} {35}\bigg) \\\\
                        &= 1 - \bigg(\dfrac {14 + 10} {35}\bigg) \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {1 \times 35} {1 \times 35} - \dfrac {24} {35} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {35 - 24} {35} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {11} {35}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {11} {35}$

</div>
</div>

</div>

</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Tom uses $750 \ \text{g}$ of sugar from a $2.5 \ \text{kg}$ packet. How many kilograms of sugar are left? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Tom uses $750 \ \text{g}$ of sugar from a $2.5 \ \text{kg}$ packet. How many kilograms of sugar are left? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Sugar left}           &= \text{Total sugar} - \text{Sugar used by Tom} \\\\
                            &= 2.5 \ \text{kg} - 750 \ \text{g} \\\\
                            &= 2.5 \ \text{kg} - \dfrac {750} {1000} \ \text{kg} \\\\
                            &= 2.5 - 0.75 \\\\
                            &= 1.75 \ \text{kg}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$1.75 \ \text{kg}$

</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Given that Tom eats $\dfrac{3}{5}$ of a cake and his friend, Jerry, eats $\dfrac{1}{3}$ of the cake, what fraction of the cake is left? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Given that Tom eats $\dfrac{3}{5}$ of a cake and his friend, Jerry, eats $\dfrac{1}{3}$ of the cake, what fraction of the cake is left? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Cake left}   &= 1 - \left( \dfrac {3} {5} + \dfrac {1} {3} \right) \\\\
                    &= 1 - \left( \dfrac {3 \times 3} {5 \times 3} + \dfrac {1 \times 5} {3 \times 5} \right) \\\\
                    &= 1 - \left( \dfrac {9} {15} + \dfrac {5} {15} \right) \\\\
                    &= 1 - \left( \dfrac {9 + 5} {15} \right) \\\\
                    &= 1 - \dfrac {14} {15} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {1 \times 15} {1 \times 15} - \dfrac {14} {15} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {15} {15} - \dfrac {14} {15} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {15 - 14} {15} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {1} {15}
\end{aligned} 
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {1} {15}$

</div>
</div>

</div>

</code></pre>

\end{aligned} 
$
</code></pre>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Given that Tom's piece of cake weighed $150 \ \text{grams}$, what was the weight of the whole cake? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Given that Tom's piece of cake weighed $150 \ \text{grams}$, what was the weight of the whole cake? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the weight of the whole cake $= c$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{3}{5} \times c              &= 150 \\\\
c                                  &= \dfrac{150 \times 5}{3} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac{50 \times 3 \times 5}{3} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac{50 \times \cancel{3} \times 5}{\cancel{3}} \\\\
                                   &= 50 \times 5 \\\\
                                   &= 250 \ \text{grams}
\end{aligned}
$

Weight of the whole cake $= 250 \ \text{grams}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$250 \ \text {grams}$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A book has $256$ pages with, on average, $33$ lines on each page and $9$ words on each line.

Find an estimate for the number of words in the book.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<emptyline>

</code></pre>

\text{Estimated number of words}          &= 256 \times 33 \times 9 \\\\
                                &\approx 300 \times 30 \times 10 \\\\
                                &\approx 90000
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is the smallest possible difference between two different nine digit numbers, 
each of which includes all of the digits $1$ to $9?$
<emptyline>
For example the two numbers could be:
<emptyline>
$123456789$ and $987654321$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

- We want two 9-digit numbers using digits 1–9 once each, with the smallest possible positive difference.
To make the difference small, the numbers should:
  - Match in as many leading digits as possible.
  - Differ by as little as possible at the first place where they differ.
- If the first 8 digits are the same, then the last digits must be different and from $\{1,\ldots,9\}$, so the smallest possible difference at the units place is 1.
- Example:
  - First number: 123456789
  - Second number: 123456798
- Check both:
  - First uses digits 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9.
  - Second uses digits 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,9,8.
  - Both are valid permutations of 1–9.
- Compute the difference:
  - 123456798 − 123456789 = 9
- We cannot get a difference smaller than 1 at the units place, and any difference at a higher place value would be at least 10, so 9 is minimal.

Let the first number $= 789456132$

The second number $= 789456123$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Difference}   &= 789456132 - 789456123 \\\\
                    &= 9
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

It was reported recently that in an average lifetime of $70 \ \text{years}$, each
human is likely to swallow about $8$ spiders while sleeping. Supposing
that the population of UK is $60 \ \text{millions}$, what is the best
estimate of number of spiders that are consumed in this way in the 
UK each year?

- $600000$
- $7000000$
- $80000000$
- $900000000$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">It was reported recently that in an average lifetime of $70 \ \text{years}$, each
human is likely to swallow about $8$ spiders while sleeping. Supposing
that the population of UK is $60 \ \text{millions}$, what is the best
estimate of number of spiders that are consumed in this way in the 
UK each year?
<emptyline>
- $600000$
- $7000000$
- $80000000$
- $900000000$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total spiders per person per year}  &= \dfrac {8} {70} \\\\
\text{Total spiders per year in UK}       &= 60000000 \times \dfrac {8} {70} \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {60000000 \times 8} {70} \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {6000000 \cancel 0 \times 8} {7 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {48000000} {7} \\\\
                                          &= 6857142 \text{ remainder } 6 \\\\
                                          &\approx 7000000
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="option" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Option**

<p>B</p>
</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$7000000$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I choose three numbers from this number
square, including one number from each row
and one number from each column.

| $1$ | $2$ | $3$ |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| $4$ | $5$ | $6$ |
| $7$ | $8$ | $9$ |

I then multiply the three numbers together.

What is the largest possible product?

- $96$
- $105$
- $162$
- $504$ 

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A transport company’s vans each carry a maximum load of $12 \ \text {tonnes}$ . A firm needs to deliver $24$ crates each weighing $5  \ \text {tonnes}$. How many van loads will be needed to do this?

- $9$
- $10$
- $11$
- $12$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A transport company’s vans each carry a maximum load of $12 \ \text {tonnes}$ . A firm needs to deliver $24$ crates each weighing $5  \ \text {tonnes}$. How many van loads will be needed to do this?
<emptyline>
- $9$
- $10$
- $11$
- $12$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Van loads needed}    &= \dfrac {24 \ \text {crates} \ \times 5 \ \text {tonnes}} {12 \ \text {tonnes}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {120} {12} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {12 \times 10} {12} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {\cancel {12} \times 10} {\cancel {12}} \\\\
                            &= 10
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In the British Army there are $4500$ men who are taller than $180 \ \text{cms}$. 
Of these $750$ are taller than $190 \ \text{cms}$.

How many men are there who are between $180$ and $190 \ \text{cms}$ tall? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<emptyline>
How many men are there who are between $180$ and $190 \ \text{cms}$ tall? 
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jordan eats $\dfrac{1}{4}$ of a pizza and Anna eats $\dfrac{1}{3}$ of what is left.

Rohit, Guhesh and Matilda share equally the remainder.

What fraction of the pizza did Matilda eat? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Jordan eats $\dfrac{1}{4}$ of a pizza and Anna eats $\dfrac{1}{3}$ of what is left.
<emptyline>
Rohit, Guhesh and Matilda share equally the remainder.
<emptyline>
What fraction of the pizza did Matilda eat? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Jordan ate}  &= \dfrac {1} {4} \\\\
\text {Anna ate}    &= \dfrac {1} {3} \times \left(1 - \dfrac {1} {4} \right) \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {1} {3} \times \dfrac {3} {4} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {3} {3 \times 4} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {1 \times \cancel {3}} {\cancel {3} \times 4} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {1} {4} \\\\
\text {Pizza left}  &= 1 - \dfrac {1} {4} - \dfrac {1} {4} \\\\
                    &= 1 - \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
\text {Matilda gets} &= \dfrac {1} {3} \times \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {1} {3 \times 2} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {1} {6}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {1} {6}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Jordan ate}  &= \dfrac {1} {4} \\\\
\text {Anna ate}    &= \dfrac {1} {3} \times \left(1 - \dfrac {1} {4} \right) \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {1} {3} \times \dfrac {3} {4} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {3} {3 \times 4} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {1 \times \cancel {3}} {\cancel {3} \times 4} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {1} {4} \\\\
\text {Pizza left}  &= 1 - \dfrac {1} {4} - \dfrac {1} {4} \\\\
                    &= 1 - \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
\text {Matilda gets} &= \dfrac {1} {3} \times \dfrac {1} {2} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {1} {3 \times 2} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {1} {6}
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Grace plants a row of daffodils.

There is a gap of $1.1 \ \text {metres}$ within each daffodil, and the row begins and ends with a daffodil.

She has $8$ daffodils.

How long is the row of daffodils when she has finished? 

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jerry the bearded dragon eats $12$ locusts for breakfast at the start of every day.

His owner buys $100$ locusts one afternoon for Jerry to eat.

How many locusts does Jerry get on the day these locusts run out? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

                            &= 8 \text{ remainder } 4
\end{aligned}

                                                        &= 100 - 96 \\\\
                                                        &= 4
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Ermintrude the female cat flea can lay $50$ eggs a day.

These become adults in $30 \ \text{days}$.

How many new adult fleas will there be in $40 \ \text{days}?$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Ermintrude the female cat flea can lay $50$ eggs a day.
<emptyline>
These become adults in $30 \ \text{days}$.
<emptyline>
How many new adult fleas will there be in $40 \ \text{days}?$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Eggs take $30 \ \text{days}$ to become adults.
Therefore, only the eggs laid in the first $40 - 30 = 10 \ \text{days}$ will have time to become adults by the $40^{\text{th}}$ day.

Any eggs laid after day $10$ will not become adults until after day $40$.

$\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of productive days} &= 40 - 30 \\\\
&= 10 \ \text{days} \\\\
\text{Total new adult fleas} &= 10 \times 50 \\\\
&= 500
\end{aligned}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$500$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

A number is a multiple of $11$ if $11$ goes into it. $33$ and $121$ are both multiples of $11$.

Ajay says that a number is a multiple of $11$ if the difference of alternate sums of digits in the number is a multiple of $11$.

So, $27390628$ is a multiple of $11$ because

$2 + 3 + 0 + 2 = 8$

$7 + 9 + 6 + 8 = 30$

and $30 - 8 = 22$ which is a multiple of $11$. 

</div>

**Question**

Find one of the ways to fill in the gaps so that this number is a multiple of $11$.

$\Large{7 \ \text{\textunderscore} \ 5  \ 6 \ \text{\textunderscore} \ 0}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

$\Large{7 \ \text{\textunderscore} \ 5  \ 6 \ \text{\textunderscore} \ 0}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the first gap $= a$ and the second gap $= b$

Number after filling the gaps $= 7a56b0$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Sum of digits at odd position}      &= 7 + 5 + b \\\\
                                          &= 12 + b \\\\
\text{Sum of digits at even position}     &= a + 6 + 0 \\\\
                                          &= a + 6 \\\\
\text{Difference}                         &= 12 + b - (a + 6) \\\\
                                          &= 12 + b - a - 6 \\\\
                                          &= 6 + b - a
\end{aligned}
$

For a number to be a multiple of $11$, $6 + b - a$ must be a multiple of $11$ ($0$ or $11, -11, \ldots$).

An easy way to start is to try to make $6 + b - a$ equal to $0$ or $a = 6 + b$.

We can easily infer the values by using a trial and error table.

| $b$ |  $a$ |  $a$ is a digit (0–9)? |
| :--------------: | :--------------- | :-------------------: |
|        $0$       | $a = 6 + 0 = 6$      |          Yes          |
|        $1$       | $a = 6 + 1 = 7$      |          Yes          |
|        $2$       | $a = 6 + 2 = 8$      |          Yes          |
|        $3$       | $a = 6 + 3 = 9$      |          Yes          |
|        $4$       | $a = 6 + 4 = 10$     |           No          |

Possible answer $=765600$
</div>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Let the first gap $= a$ and the second gap $= b$
<emptyline>
Number after filling the gaps $= 7a56b0$
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Sum of digits at odd position}      &= 7 + 5 + b \\\\
                                          &= 12 + b \\\\
\text{Sum of digits at even position}     &= a + 6 + 0 \\\\
                                          &= a + 6 \\\\
\text{Difference}                         &= 12 + b - (a + 6) \\\\
                                          &= 12 + b - a - 6 \\\\
                                          &= 6 + b - a
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
For a number to be a multiple of $11$, $6 + b - a$ must be a multiple of $11$ ($0$ or $11, -11, \ldots$).
<emptyline>
An easy way to start is to try to make $6 + b - a$ equal to $0$ or $a = 6 + b$.
<emptyline>
We can easily infer the values by using a trial and error table.
<emptyline>
| $b$ |  $a$ |  $a$ is a digit (0–9)? |
| :--------------: | :--------------- | :-------------------: |
|        $0$       | $a = 6 + 0 = 6$      |          Yes          |
|        $1$       | $a = 6 + 1 = 7$      |          Yes          |
|        $2$       | $a = 6 + 2 = 8$      |          Yes          |
|        $3$       | $a = 6 + 3 = 9$      |          Yes          |
|        $4$       | $a = 6 + 4 = 10$     |           No          |
<emptyline>
Possible answer $=765600$
</code></pre>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Krishn has $1 \ \text{hour}$ to clean the house before his parents get back from their holidays.

He has to hoover $3$ rooms, clean out his pet hamster's cage and wipe off the drawing of an elephant he accidently did on the bathroom wall.

Each room takes $12  \ \text{minutes}$ to hoover, it takes $18  \ \text{minutes}$ to clean out his hamster's cage and $21  \ \text{minutes}$ to rub out the elephant, which he does last.

Wht fraction of the elephant is left on the wall when Krishn's parents arrive home?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Krishn has $1 \ \text{hour}$ to clean the house before his parents get back from their holidays.
<emptyline>
He has to hoover $3$ rooms, clean out his pet hamster's cage and wipe off the drawing of an elephant he accidently did on the bathroom wall.
<emptyline>
Each room takes $12  \ \text{minutes}$ to hoover, it takes $18  \ \text{minutes}$ to clean out his hamster's cage and $21  \ \text{minutes}$ to rub out the elephant, which he does last.
<emptyline>
Wht fraction of the elephant is left on the wall when Krishn's parents arrive home?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time taken for rooms \& cage}       &= 12 \times 3 + 18 \\\\
                                                &= 36 + 18 \\\\
                                                &= 54 \ \text{min} \\\\
\text{Time left to wipe off elephant}       &= 60 - 54 \\\\
                                                &= 6 \ \text{min}
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Fraction of elephant wiped off}           &= \dfrac {6} {21} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {2 \times 3} {7 \times 3} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {2 \times \cancel 3} {7 \times \cancel 3} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {2} {7} \\\\
\text{Fraction of elephant left}                &= 1 - \dfrac {2} {7} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {1 \times 7} {1 \times 7} - \dfrac {2} {7} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {7 - 2} {7} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {5} {7}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {5} {7}$

</div>
</div>

                                                &= 36 + 18 \\\\
                                                &= 54 \ \text{min} \\\\

                                                &= 6 \ \text{min}

\text{Fraction of elephant left}                &= 1 - \dfrac {2} {7} \\\\

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

One quire of paper is equal to $24$ sheets.
One ream is equal to $20$ quires.
How many sheets are there in $2$ ream?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Three prime numbers multiply together to get $110$. What are they?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</code></pre>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Milly has some marbles at the start of the week.

One day at school she does well in her marble games with her friends and increase her total by a tenth.

The next day is not so good and she loses a tenth that time.

Has she ended up with more, less or the same as she had at the start of the week? Explain your answer carefully.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Milly has some marbles at the start of the week.
<emptyline>
One day at school she does well in her marble games with her friends and increase her total by a tenth.
<emptyline>
The next day is not so good and she loses a tenth that time.
<emptyline>
Has she ended up with more, less or the same as she had at the start of the week? Explain your answer carefully.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of marbles Milly had at the start of the week $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total marbles at the end of first day}     &= a + 10 \% \ \text{of} \ a \\\\
                                                 &= a + \dfrac {10} {100} \times a \\\\
                                                 &= a + \dfrac {10a} {100} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {a \times 100} {1 \times 100} + \dfrac {10a} {100} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {100a} {100} + \dfrac {10a} {100} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {100a + 10a} {100} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {110a} {100} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {11 \cancel 0a} {10 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {11a} {10} \\\\
\text{Total marbles at the end of second day}    &= \dfrac {11a} {10} - 10 \% \ \text{of} \ \dfrac {11a} {10} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {11a} {10} - \dfrac {10} {100} \times \dfrac {11a} {10} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {11a} {10} - \dfrac {10 \times 11a} {100 \times 10} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {11a} {10} - \dfrac {\cancel {10} \times 11a} {100 \times \cancel {10}} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {11a} {10} - \dfrac {11a} {100} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {11a \times 10} {10 \times 10} - \dfrac {11a} {100} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {110a} {100} - \dfrac {11a} {100} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {110a - 11a} {100} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {99a} {100} \\\\
                                                 &= 0.99a
\end{aligned}
$

She ended up with less marbles.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

Less

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>

</code></pre>
</div>

                                                 &= \dfrac {a \times 100} {1 \times 100} + \dfrac {10a} {100} \\\\

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Emma has a rectangular  card $6 \ \text{cm}$ by $9 \ \text{cm}$. She colours in a border of $1 \ \text{cm}$ around  the edge. The border is $1 \ \text{cm}$ thick throughout. What fraction of the area of the rectangle is coloured in?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Emma has a rectangular  card $6 \ \text{cm}$ by $9 \ \text{cm}$. She colours in a border of $1 \ \text{cm}$ around  the edge. The border is $1 \ \text{cm}$ thick throughout. What fraction of the area of the rectangle is coloured in?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text{Area of rectangle} = \text{length} \times \text{width}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Fraction coloured}       &= \dfrac {\text {Area of outer rectangle} - \text {Area of inner rectangle}} {\text {Area of inner rectangle}} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {6 \times 9 - 4 \times 7 } { 6 \times 9 } \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {54 - 28} { 54} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {26} { 54} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {2 \times 13} {2 \times 27} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {\cancel{2} \times 13} {\cancel{2} \times 27} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {13} {27}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {13} {27}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Cheese costs $\pounds 5.40 \ \text{per kg}$. Jessica buys $0.6\ \text{kg}$ of cheese. How much does Jessica pay? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Cheese costs $\pounds 5.40 \ \text{per kg}$. Jessica buys $0.6\ \text{kg}$ of cheese. How much does Jessica pay? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Amount Jessica paid}      &= 5.40 \times 0.6 \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {54} {10} \times \dfrac {6} {10} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {54 \times 6} {10 \times 10} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {324} {100} \\\\
                                &= \pounds 3.24
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 3.24$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

There are $31 \ \text{days}$ in July. Each day throughout July I picked $300\ \text{g}$ of raspberries from my garden.

What was the total weight of the raspberries I picked that month? Give your answer in $\text{kilograms}$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">There are $31 \ \text{days}$ in July. Each day throughout July I picked $300\ \text{g}$ of raspberries from my garden.
<emptyline>
What was the total weight of the raspberries I picked that month? Give your answer in $\text{kilograms}$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total weight of the raspberries}          &= 31 \times \dfrac {300} {1000} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {31 \times 300} {1000} \\\\
                                                &= \dfrac {9300} {1000} \\\\
                                                &= 9.3 \ \text{kg}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9.3 \ \text{kg}$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Natalie, Sara and Antonia catch $3$ different buses to go to the same destination.

Antonia catches the $19{:}15$ bus.

Natalie's bus journey takes three times as long as Sara's. 
Natalie's bus leaves $20 \ \text{minutes}$ before Antonia's bus and arrives at $20{:}10$. 
Sara catches the $19{:}25$ bus. 

What time does Sara arrive at the destination?

Natalie's bus journey takes three times as long as Sara's. 
Natalie's bus leaves $20 \ \text{minutes}$ before Antonia's bus and arrives at $20{:}10$. 
Sara catches the $19{:}25$ bus. 
<emptyline>
What time does Sara arrive at the destination? 
<emptyline>
%image% 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time when Natalia catch the bus}           &= \text{Time when Antonia catch the bus} - 20 \ \text{min} \\\\
                                                 &= 19{:}15 - 20 \ \text{min} \\\\
                                                 &= 18{:}55 \\\\
\text{Duration of Natalia journey}               &= 20{:}10 - 18{:}55 \\\\
                                                 &= 75 \ \text{min} \\\\
\text{Duration of Sara journey}                  &= \dfrac {\text{Duration of Natalia journey}} {3} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {75} {3} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {3 \times 25} {3} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {\cancel 3 \times 25} {\cancel 3} \\\\
                                                 &= 25 \ \text{min} \\\\
\text{Time when Sara arrive at destination}      &= 19{:}25 + 25 \ \text{min} \\\\
                                                 &= 19{:}50
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$19{:}50$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Sara starts her maths homework at $4.30 \ \text{pm}$ and she finishes it at $6.10 \ \text{pm}$. 
During that time she watches 'Neighbours' for $25 \ \text{minutes}$ and 
she speaks to her friend Jean on the telephone for $20 \ \text{minutes}$. 
How long is Sara actually working on her maths?

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The total of the opposite faces on a dice is always $7$.
Jack places  three dice on a table as shown in the diagram. 
What is the total score of the faces that Jack cannot see?

![papers/james-allens-girls-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q19-i00.png](/assets/papers/james-allens-girls-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q19-i00.png "papers/james-allens-girls-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q19-i00.png")  

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The total of the opposite faces on a dice is always $7$.
Jack places  three dice on a table as shown in the diagram. 
What is the total score of the faces that Jack cannot see?
<emptyline>
%image%  
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total score of the faces that Jack cannot see}     &= 3 \times ((7 -6) + (7 - 3) + (7 - 2)) + 2 \times 2 \\\\
                                                         &= 3 \times (1 + 4 + 5) + 4 \\\\
                                                         &= 3 \times 10 + 4 \\\\
                                                         &= 30 + 4 \\\\
                                                         &= 34
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$34$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A length of rope is $5 \ \text{m}$ long. It is cut into four unequal lengths. Three of the pieces are $147 \ \text{cm}$, $132.5 \ \text{cm}$ and $67 \ \text{cm}$. How long is the fourth piece? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A length of rope is $5 \ \text{m}$ long. It is cut into four unequal lengths. Three of the pieces are $147 \ \text{cm}$, $132.5 \ \text{cm}$ and $67 \ \text{cm}$. How long is the fourth piece? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Length of fourth piece} &= 5 \ \text{m} - (147 \ \text{cm} + 132.5 \ \text{cm} + 67 \ \text{cm}) \\\\
                               &= 5 \ \text{m} - 346.5 \ \text{cm} \\\\
                               &= 5 \ \text{m} - \dfrac {346.5} {100} \ \text{m} \\\\
                               &= 5 - 3.465 \\\\
                               &= 1.535 \ \text{m}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$1.535 \ \text{m}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Tom is $142 \ \text{cm}$ tall and Harry is $168 \ \text{cm}$ tall. 
James is half way between Tom's and Harry's height. 
Work out James' height. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Tom is $142 \ \text{cm}$ tall and Harry is $168 \ \text{cm}$ tall. 
James is half way between Tom's and Harry's height. 
Work out James' height. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {James' height} &= \dfrac {\text {Tom's height} + \text {Harry's height}} {2} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {142 + 168} {2} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {310} {2} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {155 \times 2} {2} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {155 \times \cancel {2}} {\cancel {2}} \\\\
                      &= 155 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$155 \ \text{cm}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$3$ masses are measured to be $720 \ \text{g}$, $3.46 \ \text{kg}$, and $2 \ \text{kg } 53 \ \text{g}$. 
What is their total mass, give your answer in grams. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$3$ masses are measured to be $720 \ \text{g}$, $3.46 \ \text{kg}$, and $2 \ \text{kg } 53 \ \text{g}$. 
What is their total mass, give your answer in grams. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total mass} &= 720 \ \text{g} + 3.46 \ \text{kg} + 2 \ \text{kg} \ 53 \ \text{g} \\\\
                   &= 720 \ \text{g} + 3.46 \times 1000 \ \text{g} + 2 \times 1000 \ \text{g} + 53 \ \text{g} \\\\
                   &= 720 + 3.46 \times 1000 + 2 \times 1000 + 53 \\\\
                   &= 720 + 3460 + 2000 + 53 \\\\
                   &= 6233 \ \text{g}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$6233 \ \text{g}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

Nine people sit at one table. They share the chocolate equally.

![papers/kent-college/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q18-s01-i00.png](/assets/papers/kent-college/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q18-s01-i00.png "papers/kent-college/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q18-s01-i00.png")

What fraction of a bar do they each have?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\begin{aligned}
\text {Fraction per person}  &= \dfrac {\text {Total bars}} {\text {Total people}} \\\\
                             &= \dfrac {3} {9} \\\\

                             &= \dfrac {\cancel {3}} {3 \times \cancel {3}} \\\\
                             &= \dfrac {1} {3}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

In another room there are two tables.

There are four bars of chocolate on one table. There are five on the other.

![papers/kent-college/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q18-s03-i00.png](/assets/papers/kent-college/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q18-s03-i00.png "papers/kent-college/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q18-s03-i00.png") ![papers/kent-college/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q18-s03-i01.png](/assets/papers/kent-college/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q18-s03-i01.png "papers/kent-college/sample/sample-paper-1/s01-q18-s03-i01.png")

Twelve people sit at the table with four bars. Some other people sit at the table with five bars.

At each table they share the chocolate equally. Everyone in the room has the same fraction of a bar.

How many people sit at the table with five bars?

Show your working.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In another room there are two tables.
<emptyline>
There are four bars of chocolate on one table. There are five on the other.
<emptyline>
%image% %image%
<emptyline>
Twelve people sit at the table with four bars. Some other people sit at the table with five bars.
<emptyline>
At each table they share the chocolate equally. Everyone in the room has the same fraction of a bar.
<emptyline>
How many people sit at the table with five bars?
<emptyline>
Show your working.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of people sitting at the table with five bars $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {4} {12}                                                         &= \dfrac {5} {a} \\\\
4a                                                                      &= 5 \times 12 \\\\
a                                                                       &= \dfrac {5 \times 12} {4} \\\\
a                                                                       &= \dfrac {5 \times 3 \times 4} {4} \\\\
a                                                                       &= \dfrac {5 \times 3 \times \cancel {4}} {\cancel {4}} \\\\
a                                                                       &= 5 \times 3 \\\\
a                                                                       &= 15
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$15$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A number line starts at $-9$ and finishes at $11$.

What number is $\dfrac{2}{5}$ of the way along the number line?

![papers/kent-college-canterbury/2020/sample-paper-1/s01-q13-i00.png](/assets/papers/kent-college-canterbury/2020/sample-paper-1/s01-q13-i00.png "papers/kent-college-canterbury/2020/sample-paper-1/s01-q13-i00.png")

Show your working. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A number line starts at $-9$ and finishes at $11$.
<emptyline>
What number is $\dfrac{2}{5}$ of the way along the number line?
<emptyline>
%image%
<emptyline>
Show your working. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Effective length of the number line} &= 11 - (-9) \\\\
                                           &= 11 + 9 \\\\
                                           &= 20
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Position of required number from start}    &= \dfrac {2} {5} \times 20 \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {2 \times 20} {5} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {2 \times 5 \times 4} {5} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {2 \times \cancel {5} \times 4} {\cancel {5}} \\\\
                                                 &= 2 \times 4 \\\\
                                                 &= 8
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number}        &= - 9 + 8 \\\\
                     &= - 1
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$- 1$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Bill has a bag containing $60$ sweets. He eats a half of the sweets himself and then gives away a third of the sweets that remain. How many sweets does Bill have left?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Bill has a bag containing $60$ sweets. He eats a half of the sweets himself and then gives away a third of the sweets that remain. How many sweets does Bill have left?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Sweets left}  &= \text {Total sweets} - (\text {Sweets eaten} + \text {Sweets given away}) \\\\
                     &= 60 - \bigg(\dfrac {1} {2} \ \text {of} \ 60 + \dfrac {1} {3} \ \text {of} \ \bigg(\dfrac {1} {2} \ \text {of} \ 60 \bigg) \bigg) \\\\
                     &= 60 - \bigg(\dfrac {1} {2} \times 60 +\dfrac {1} {3} \times \bigg(\dfrac {1} {2} \times 60 \bigg) \bigg) \\\\
                     &= 60 - \bigg(\dfrac {60} {2} + \dfrac {1} {3} \times \dfrac {60} {2} \bigg) \\\\
                     &= 60 - \bigg(\dfrac {30 \times 2} {2} + \dfrac {10 \times 3 \times 2} {3 \times 2} \bigg) \\\\
                     &= 60 - \bigg(\dfrac {30 \times \cancel 2} {\cancel 2} + \dfrac {10 \times \cancel 3 \times \cancel 2} {\cancel 3 \times \cancel 2} \bigg) \\\\
                     &= 60 - (30 + 10) \\\\
                     &= 60 - 40 \\\\
                     &= 20
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$20$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="formulacodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="formulacodeblock_title">

<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Sweets left}  &= \text {Total sweets} - (\text {Sweets eaten} + \text {Sweets given away}) \\\\
                     &= 60 - \bigg(\dfrac {1} {2} \ \text {of} \ 60 + \dfrac {1} {3} \ \text {of} \ \bigg(\dfrac {1} {2} \ \text {of} \ 60 \bigg) \bigg) \\\\
                     &= 60 - \bigg(\dfrac {1} {2} \times 60 +\dfrac {1} {3} \times \bigg(\dfrac {1} {2} \times 60 \bigg) \bigg) \\\\
                     &= 60 - \bigg(\dfrac {60} {2} + \dfrac {1} {3} \times \dfrac {60} {2} \bigg) \\\\
                     &= 60 - \bigg(\dfrac {30 \times 2} {2} + \dfrac {10 \times 3 \times 2} {3 \times 2} \bigg) \\\\
                     &= 60 - \bigg(\dfrac {30 \times \cancel 2} {\cancel 2} + \dfrac {10 \times \cancel 3 \times \cancel 2} {\cancel 3 \times \cancel 2} \bigg) \\\\
                     &= 60 - (30 + 10) \\\\
                     &= 60 - 40 \\\\
                     &= 20
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>

$3\%$ of the time is taken up with the opening title sequence and final credits.

All the remainder of the film is shot inside The Manor House.

**Question**

- $132$ 
- $1$ 
- $42$ 
- $22$
