<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">For result $= 14$ we need atleast $3$ digits
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
&= 1 ^ 2 + 2 ^ 2 + 3 ^ 2 \\\\
&= 1 + 4 + 9 \\\\
&= 14
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Therefore it is not possible to find a two digit number which will give result $= 14$
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A box of $92$ Smarties contains only reef, green and purple Smarties. If there are $37$ red Smarties and $29$ green Smarties how many purple Smarties does it contain?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A box of $92$ Smarties contains only reef, green and purple Smarties. If there are $37$ red Smarties and $29$ green Smarties how many purple Smarties does it contain?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Purple Smarties}  &= \text {Total Smarties} - (\text{Red Smarties} + \text{Green Smarties}) \\\\
                         &= 92 - (37 + 29) \\\\
                         &= 92 - 66 \\\\
                         &= 26
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$26$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jenny is given $3$ large jigsaw puzzles for Christmas which get muddled together. The first contains $496$ pieces, the second $812$ pieces and the third $984$ pieces.

By rounding each of these numbers to the nearest $100$, write down a simple sum you can do to estimate the total number of jigsaw pieces there are all together.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Jenny is given $3$ large jigsaw puzzles for Christmas which get muddled together. The first contains $496$ pieces, the second $812$ pieces and the third $984$ pieces.
<emptyline>
By rounding each of these numbers to the nearest $100$, write down a simple sum you can do to estimate the total number of jigsaw pieces there are all together.
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

\begin{aligned}
\text{Approximate number of jigsaw pieces}      &= 500 + 800 + 1000 \\\\
                                                &= 2300
\end{aligned}
$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

**Question**

Meera is now exactly $3$ times as tall as she was when she was born. What was her height in centimetres when she was born?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Meera is now exactly $3$ times as tall as she was when she was born. What was her height in centimetres when she was born?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Meera's height when she was born}   &= \dfrac {1.62} {3} \ \text{m} \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {1.62 \times 100} {3} \ \text{cm} \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {162} {3} \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {54 \times 3} {3} \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {54 \times \cancel {3}} {\cancel {3}} \\\\
                                          &= 54 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

                       &= \pounds 7.52
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</code></pre>

                   &= 360 - 312 \\\\
                   &= 48 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A school requires enough pencils so that each of its $340$ pupils can have a pencil each. How many boxes of $24$ pencils should the school buy, and how many spare pencils will this leave?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A school requires enough pencils so that each of its $340$ pupils can have a pencil each. How many boxes of $24$ pencils should the school buy, and how many spare pencils will this leave?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of boxes required}         &= \dfrac {340} {24} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {85 \times 4} {6 \times 4} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {85 \times \cancel 4} {6 \times \cancel 4} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {85} {6} \\\\
                                        &= 14 \text{ remainder } 1 \\\\
                                        &\approx 15 \\\\
\text{Number of spare pencils}          &= 15 \times 24 - 340\\\\
                                        &= 360 - 340 \\\\
                                        &= 20
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

Number of boxes $= 15$

Number of spare pencils $= 20$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A ball of string is $2\ \text{metres}$ long. Pieces of length $30\ \text{cm}$ are cut from the ball. How many whole pieces may be cut and what length is left over?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A ball of string is $2\ \text{metres}$ long. Pieces of length $30\ \text{cm}$ are cut from the ball. How many whole pieces may be cut and what length is left over?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of pieces} &= \dfrac {\text{Length of string}} {\text{Length of a piece}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {2 \ \text{m}} {30  \ \text{cm}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {2 \times 100 \ \text{cm}} {30 \ \text{cm}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {2 \times 10 \cancel {0}} {3 \cancel {0}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {20} {3} \\\\
                        &= 6 \text{ remainder } 2 \\\\
                        &\approx 6 \\\\
\text{Remaining length}     &= 2 \ \text{m} - 6 \times 30 \ \text{cm} \\\\
                            &= 2 \times 100 \ \text{cm} - 6 \times 30 \ \text{cm} \\\\
                            &= 200 - 180 \\\\
                            &= 20 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$6, 20 \ \text{cm}$

</div>
</div>

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$

                        &= \dfrac {2 \ \text{m}} {30  \ \text{cm}} \\\\

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A glass holds $225\ \text{ml}$.

![papers/leicester-high-school-for-girls/sample/sample-paper-4/s01-q06-s01-i00.png](/assets/papers/leicester-high-school-for-girls/sample/sample-paper-4/s01-q06-s01-i00.png "papers/leicester-high-school-for-girls/sample/sample-paper-4/s01-q06-s01-i00.png")

An adult needs about $1.8\ \text{litres}$ of water each day to stay healthy.

How many glasses is that? 

Show your working.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A glass holds $225\ \text{ml}$.
<emptyline>
%image%
<emptyline>
An adult needs about $1.8\ \text{litres}$ of water each day to stay healthy.
<emptyline>
How many glasses is that? 
<emptyline>
Show your working.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Amount of water needed per day}     &= 1.8 \ \text{litres} \\\\
                                          &= 1.8 \times 1000 \ \text{ml} \\\\
                                          &= 1.8 \times 1000 \\\\
                                          &= 1800 \ \text{ml} \\\\
\text{Number of glasses of water}         &= \dfrac {1800} {225} \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {8 \times 225} {225} \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {8 \times \cancel {225}} {\cancel {225}} \\\\
                                          &= 8
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$8$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

An adult weighs $80\ \text{kg}$.

$60\%$ of his total mass is water.

What is the mass of this water?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">An adult weighs $80\ \text{kg}$.
<emptyline>
$60\%$ of his total mass is water.
<emptyline>
What is the mass of this water?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Mass of water}        &= 60 \% \ \text{of} \ 80 \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {60} {100} \times 80 \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {60 \times 80} {100} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {6 \cancel {0} \times 8 \cancel {0}} {1 \cancel {0} \cancel {0}} \\\\
                            &= 6 \times 8 \\\\
                            &= 48 \ \text {kg}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$48 \ \text {kg}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Complete the table to show what **percentage** of the cost of a cup of coffee goes to retailers, growers and others.

Show your working.

| Retailers     | $\%$         |
|:---------:    |---------:    |
|  Growers      | $\%$         |
|   Others      | $\%$         |

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Complete the table to show what **percentage** of the cost of a cup of coffee goes to retailers, growers and others.
<emptyline>
Show your working.
<emptyline>
| Retailers     | $\%$         |
|:---------:    |---------:    |
|  Growers      | $\%$         |
|   Others      | $\%$         |
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Retailers \%} &= \dfrac{5} {2.50 \times 100} \times 100 \\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac{5 \times 100 } {250} \\\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac{5 \times 50 \times 2} {5 \times 50} \\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac{\cancel 5 \times \cancel{50} \times 2} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel{50} } \\\\
                                                     &= 2 \% \\\\
\text{Growers \%}   &= \dfrac{30} {2.50 \times 100} \times 100 \\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac{30 \times 100 } {250} \\\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac{5 \times 6 \times 50 \times 2} {5 \times 50} \\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac{\cancel 5 \times 6 \times \cancel{50} \times 2} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel{50} } \\\\
                                                     &= 6 \times 2 \\\\
                                                     &= 12 \% \\\\
\text{Others \%}    &= \dfrac{2.15 \times 100} {2.50 \times 100} \times 100 \\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac{215 \times 100 } {250} \\\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac{5 \times 43 \times 50 \times 2} {5 \times 50} \\\\
                                                     &= \dfrac{\cancel 5 \times 43 \times \cancel{50} \times 2} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel{50} } \\\\
                                                     &= 43 \times 2 \\\\
                                                     &= 86 \% 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**


| Retailers     | $2 \%$       |
|:---------:    |---------:    |
|  Growers      | $12 \%$      |
|   Others      | $86 \%$      |

</div>

Work out the number of chocolates each student receives.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Work out the number of chocolates each student receives.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Number of chocolates each student receives} &= \dfrac {\text {Total chocolates}} {\text {Total students}} \\\\
                                                   &= \dfrac {36 \times 4} {27} \\\\
                                                   &= \dfrac {9 \times 4 \times 4} {9 \times 3} \\\\
                                                   &= \dfrac {\cancel {9} \times 4 \times 4} {\cancel {9} \times 3} \\\\
                                                   &= \dfrac {16} {3} \\\\
                                                   &= 5 \text{ remainder } 1 \\\\
                                                   &\approx 5
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The distance between Richmond and Kingston is approximately $3 \dfrac{3}{8} \ \text{miles}$. If I walk $\dfrac{2}{3}$ of the way, 
how far do I walk?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The distance between Richmond and Kingston is approximately $3 \dfrac{3}{8} \ \text{miles}$. If I walk $\dfrac{2}{3}$ of the way, 
how far do I walk?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Distance travelled} &= \dfrac {2} {3} \ \text {of} \ 3 \dfrac {3} {8} \\\\
                           &= \dfrac {2} {3} \times \dfrac {27} {8} \\\\
                           &= \dfrac {2 \times 27} {3 \times 8} \\\\
                           &= \dfrac {2 \times 3 \times 9} {3 \times 2 \times 4} \\\\
                           &= \dfrac {\cancel {2} \times \cancel {3} \times 9} {\cancel {3} \times \cancel {2} \times 4} \\\\
                           &= \dfrac {9} {4} \ \text {miles}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {9} {4} \ \text {miles}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A car hire firm charges $\pounds 35 \ \text{per day}$ plus $34 \ \text{p per km}$ travelled. A man hired a car for $4 \ \text{days}$ and travelled 
$300 \ \text{km}$. How much did he pay?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A car hire firm charges $\pounds 35 \ \text{per day}$ plus $34 \ \text{p per km}$ travelled. A man hired a car for $4 \ \text{days}$ and travelled 
$300 \ \text{km}$. How much did he pay?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">

</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Amount he paid}                &= 4 \times \pounds 35 + 300 \times 34 \ \text{p} \\\\
                                      &= 4 \times \pounds 35 + 300 \times \pounds 0.34 \\\\
                                      &= 140 +  102 \\\\
                                      &= 140 +  102 \\\\
                                      &= \pounds 242
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 242$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If a bag of $2 \ \text{pence}$ coins weighs $350 \ \text{g}$, how many coins are there?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If a bag of $2 \ \text{pence}$ coins weighs $350 \ \text{g}$, how many coins are there?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of coins} &= \dfrac {350} {7} \\\\
                       &= \dfrac {50 \times 7} {7} \\\\
                       &= \dfrac {50 \times \cancel {7}} {\cancel {7}} \\\\
                       &= 50
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How much are $500 \ \text{g}$ of $20 \ \text{pence}$ coins worth?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of coins}  &= \dfrac {500} {5} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {5 \times 100} {5} \\\\

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jeff goes to the cinema. He buys a ticket for $\pounds 5.75$, popcorn for $\pounds 1.50$ and a drink for $76 \ \text{p}$. 
His return train fare is $\pounds 3.80$. If he leaves home with a $\pounds 20$ note how much change does he return with?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Jeff goes to the cinema. He buys a ticket for $\pounds 5.75$, popcorn for $\pounds 1.50$ and a drink for $76 \ \text{p}$. 
His return train fare is $\pounds 3.80$. If he leaves home with a $\pounds 20$ note how much change does he return with?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Money spent}         &= \pounds 5.75 + \pounds 1.50 + 76 \ \text{p} + \pounds 3.80 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 5.75 + \pounds 1.50 + \pounds 0.76 + \pounds 3.80 \\\\
                            &= 5.75 + 1.50 +  0.76 + 3.80\\\\
                            &= 11.81 \\\\
\text {Change received}     &= 20 - 11.81 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 8.19
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 8.19$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$\pounds 50000$ in $\pounds 50$ notes weighs about $1.3 \ \text{Kg}$. How much, in grams, does one $\pounds 50$ note weigh?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$\pounds 50000$ in $\pounds 50$ notes weighs about $1.3 \ \text{Kg}$. How much, in grams, does one $\pounds 50$ note weigh?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of notes}      &= \dfrac {50000} {50} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {50 \times 1000} {50} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {\cancel{50} \times 1000} {\cancel{50}} \\\\
                            &= 1000 \\\\
\text{Weight of a note}     &= \dfrac {1.3} { 1000} \ \text{kg} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {1.3 \times 1000} { 1000} \ \text {g} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {1.3 \times 1 \cancel{0} \cancel{0} \cancel{0}} { 1 \cancel{0} \cancel{0} \cancel{0} } \\\\
                            &= 1.3 \ \text {g}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$1.3 \ \text {g}$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A bag contains $49$ red balls and $1$ blue ball. How many red balls should be removed for the bag to contain $90\%$ red balls?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A bag contains $49$ red balls and $1$ blue ball. How many red balls should be removed for the bag to contain $90\%$ red balls?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of red balls removed $= b$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac {49 - b} {50 - b}                                             &= \dfrac {90} {100} \\\\
49 - b                                                               &= \dfrac {90} {100} \times (50 - b) \\\\
49 - b                                                               &= \dfrac {90} {100} \times 50 - \dfrac {90} {100} \times b \\\\
49 - b                                                               &= \dfrac {45 \times 2 \times 50} {50 \times 2} - \dfrac {90 b} {100} \\\\
49 - b                                                               &= \dfrac {45 \times \cancel {2} \times \cancel {50}} {\cancel {50} \times \cancel {2}} - \dfrac {90 b} {100} \\\\
49 - b                                                               &= 45 - \dfrac {90 b} {100} \\\\
-b + \dfrac {90 b} {100}                                             &= 45 - 49 \\\\
-\dfrac {b \times 100} {1 \times 100} + \dfrac {90 b} {100}          &= -4 \\\\
-\dfrac {100 b + 90 b} {100}                                         &= -4 \\\\
-\dfrac {10 b} {100}                                                 &= -4 \\\\
\dfrac {10 b} {100}                                                  &= 4 \\\\
\dfrac {1 \cancel {0} b} {10 \cancel {0}}                            &= 4 \\\\
\dfrac {b} {10}                                                      &= 4 \\\\
b                                                                    &= 4 \times 10 \\\\
b                                                                    &= 40
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Alternate solution
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the total number of balls after red balls removed $= a$

Number of blue balls,

$
\begin{aligned}
10 \% \ \text{of} \ a            &= 1 \\\\
\dfrac {10} {100} \times a   &= 1 \\\\
a                            &= \dfrac {100} {10} \\\\
a                            &= \dfrac {10 \cancel 0} {1 \cancel 0} \\\\
a                            &= 10
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Red balls}           &= \text{Total balls} - \text {Blue balls} \\\\
                           &= 10 - 1 \\\\
                           &= 9
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Red balls removed}   &= 49 - 9 \\\\
                           &= 40
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If a basketball weighs $300 \ \text{g}$ plus half its own weight, how much does it weigh?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If a basketball weighs $300 \ \text{g}$ plus half its own weight, how much does it weigh?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the weight of basketball $= b$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
b                                                 &= 300 + \dfrac {b} {2} \\\\
b - \dfrac {b} {2}                                &= 300 \\\\
\dfrac {b \times 2} {1 \times 2} - \dfrac {b} {2} &= 300 \\\\
\dfrac {2 b} {2} - \dfrac {b} {2}                 &= 300 \\\\
\dfrac {2 b - b} {2}                              &= 300 \\\\
\dfrac {b} {2}                                    &= 300 \\\\
b                                                 &= 300 \times 2 \\\\
b                                                 &= 600 \ \text{g}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$600 \ \text{g}$

</div>

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

\end{aligned}
$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

                                            &= \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times 3 \times 60} {\cancel 2} \\\\
                                            &= 3 \times 60 \\\\
                                            &= 180 \ \text{metres}
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A metal rod is $10 \dfrac{4}{5} \ \text{metres}$ long.  How many short rods $\dfrac{3}{10} \ \text{metres}$ 
long can be cut from the longer rod?  

Show full working

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A metal rod is $10 \dfrac{4}{5} \ \text{metres}$ long.  How many short rods $\dfrac{3}{10} \ \text{metres}$ 
long can be cut from the longer rod?  
<emptyline>
Show full working
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Numbers of rods} &= \dfrac {\text {Length of longer rod}} {\text {Length of shorter rod}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {10 \dfrac {4} {5}} {\dfrac {3} {10}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {\dfrac {54} {5}} {\dfrac {3} {10}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {54} {5} \times \dfrac {10} {3} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {54 \times 10} {5 \times 3} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {3 \times 18 \times 5 \times 2} {5 \times 3} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {\cancel {3} \times 18 \times \cancel {5} \times 2} {\cancel {5} \times \cancel {3}} \\\\
                        &= 18 \times 2 \\\\
                        &= 36
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Subtract three times the smallest number from twice the largest number in this list:

$4, \quad 11,\quad 8, \quad 2, \quad 7, \quad 13$


</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Subtract three times the smallest number from twice the largest number in this list:
<emptyline>
$4, \quad 11,\quad 8, \quad 2, \quad 7, \quad 13$
<emptyline>
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Smallest number} &= 2 \\\\
\text{Largest number} &= 13 \\\\
\text{Difference} &= (2 \times 13) - (3 \times 2) \\\\
&= 26 - 6 \\\\
&= 20
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$20$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Five friends shared the cost of a mansion (priced at $3$ million pounds) equally. How much did each of them pay ?  

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\begin{aligned}
\text{Each friend's share} &= \dfrac {3000000} {5} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {5 \times 600000} {5} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {\cancel{5} \times 600000} {\cancel{5}} \\\\
                        &= \pounds 600000
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

There are $120$ boys and $80$ girls at a small primary school. During the holidays, $50\%$ of the boys and $60\%$ of the girls saw the latest Harry Potter movie. How many pupils in total from the primary school saw the movie?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">There are $120$ boys and $80$ girls at a small primary school. During the holidays, $50\%$ of the boys and $60\%$ of the girls saw the latest Harry Potter movie. How many pupils in total from the primary school saw the movie?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total pupils who saw the movie}   &= \dfrac {50} {100} \times {120} + \dfrac {60} {100} \times {80} \\\\
                                         &= \dfrac {50 \times 120} {100} + \dfrac {60 \times 80} {100} \\\\
                                         &= \dfrac {5 \cancel 0 \times 12 \cancel 0} {1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} + \dfrac {6 \cancel 0 \times 8 \cancel 0} {1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                         &= 5 \times 12 + 6 \times 8 \\\\
                                         &= 60 + 48 \\\\
                                         &= 128
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$128$

</div>
</div>

\end{aligned}

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

John and Daisy share a pizza. John eats $\dfrac{1}{5}$ of it and Daisy eats $\dfrac{7}{12}$ of it. What fraction remains?                                          

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">John and Daisy share a pizza. John eats $\dfrac{1}{5}$ of it and Daisy eats $\dfrac{7}{12}$ of it. What fraction remains?                                          
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Fraction of pizza remaining}      &= 1 - (\dfrac {1}{5} + \dfrac{7}{12} ) \\\\
                                        &= 1 - (\dfrac {1 \times 12} {5 \times 12} + \dfrac{7 \times 5}{12 \times 5}) \\\\
                                        &= 1 - (\dfrac {12}{60} + \dfrac {35}{60}) \\\\
                                        &= 1 - \dfrac {47} {60} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {60 - 47} {60} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {13} {60}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {13} {60}$

</div>

<div class="question subsubquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If there are $14$ small bottles, how many large bottles will be needed?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If there are $14$ small bottles, how many large bottles will be needed?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of large bottles needed $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
14 \times 1 \dfrac {1} {4}      &= a \times 3 \dfrac {4} {7} \\\\
14 \times \dfrac {5} {4}        &= a \times \dfrac {25} {7} \\\\
a \times \dfrac {25} {7}        &= 14 \times \dfrac {5} {4} \\\\
a                               &= 14 \times \dfrac {5} {4} \times \dfrac {7} {25} \\\\
a                               &= \dfrac {14 \times 5 \times 7} {4 \times 25} \\\\
a                               &= \dfrac {7 \times 2 \times 5 \times 7} {2 \times 2 \times 5 \times 5} \\\\
a                               &= \dfrac {7 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times 7} {\cancel 2 \times 2 \times 5 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
a                               &= \dfrac {7 \times 7} {2 \times 5} \\\\
a                               &= \dfrac {49} {10} \\\\
a                               &= 4 \text{ remainder } 9 \\\\
a                               &\approx 5
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$5$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

At the start of January there were $2349290978$ Facebook users in the world. By the end of January $28863298$ users had joined Facebook.

Calculate how many users there were at the end of January (assume no-one left Facebook).

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<emptyline>

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

</div>
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Users at the end of January} &= 2349290978 + 28863298 \\\\
                                   &= 2378154276
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

**Question**

Tax is charged at the rate of $17\%$ on business profits. If a business makes profits of $\pounds 45{,}330$ one year, how much tax must be paid?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Tax paid} &= 17 \% \times 45330 \\\\
                &= \dfrac {17} {100} \times 45330 \\\\
                &= \dfrac {17 \times 45330} {100} \\\\
                &= \dfrac {770610} {100} \\\\
                &= \pounds 7706.10
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A chocolate bar is shared amongst two friends. 

Alfred first eats one third of the bar. Barbara then eats two thirds of the remaining chocolate.

What fraction of the original chocolate bar is left? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A chocolate bar is shared amongst two friends. 
<emptyline>
Alfred first eats one third of the bar. Barbara then eats two thirds of the remaining chocolate.
<emptyline>
What fraction of the original chocolate bar is left? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Fraction eaten by Alferd}    &= \dfrac {1} {3} \\\\
                                   &= 1 - \dfrac {1} {3} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {1 \times 3} {1 \times 3} - \dfrac {1}{3} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {3} {3} - \dfrac {1} {3} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {3 - 1} {3} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {2} {3} \\\\
\text{Fraction eaten by Barbara}   &= \dfrac {2} {3} \times \dfrac{2} {3} \\\\

                                   &= \dfrac {5} {9}

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In the first week of the screening of a new film a cinema sells $2140$ tickets. 

In the second week it sells $320$ less tickets than the first week.

In the third week it sells $210$ less tickets than the second week.

How many tickets are sold over the three weeks?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In the first week of the screening of a new film a cinema sells $2140$ tickets. 
<emptyline>
In the second week it sells $320$ less tickets than the first week.
<emptyline>
In the third week it sells $210$ less tickets than the second week.
<emptyline>
How many tickets are sold over the three weeks?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total ticket sold }    &= 2140 + (2140 - 320) + (2140 - 320 - 210) \\\\                                                                 
                             &= 2140 + 1820 + 1610 \\\\
                             &= 3960 + 1610 \\\\
                             &= 5570
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$5570$

</div>
</div>

![papers/reigate-grammar-school/2012/sample-paper-3/s01-q21-i00.png](/assets/papers/reigate-grammar-school/2012/sample-paper-3/s01-q21-i00.png "papers/reigate-grammar-school/2012/sample-paper-3/s01-q21-i00.png")

What fraction of this flag is shaded? How many more rectangles need to be shaded to fill $\dfrac{2}{3}$ of the flag?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%image%
<emptyline>
What fraction of this flag is shaded? How many more rectangles need to be shaded to fill $\dfrac{2}{3}$ of the flag?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Fraction of flag shaded}              &= \dfrac {5} {6 \times 5} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {\cancel{5}} {6 \times \cancel{5}} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {1} {6} \\\\
\text{Rectangles required}                  &= \left( \dfrac {2} {3} \times 30 \right) - 5 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {2 \times 30} {3} - 5 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {60} {3} - 5 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {20 \times 3} {3} - 5 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {20 \times \cancel{3}} {\cancel{3}} - 5 \\\\
                                            &= 20 - 5 \\\\
                                            &= 15
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {1} {6}, 15$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

Four lamp posts are in a straight line. The distance from each post to the next is $25 \ \text{m}$. What is the distance from the first post to the last?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Four lamp posts are in a straight line. The distance from each post to the next is $25 \ \text{m}$. What is the distance from the first post to the last?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Distance} &= 25 + 25 + 25 \\\\
                                                 &= 75 \ \text{m}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">

$75 \ \text{m}$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A transport company's vans each carry a maximum load of $12 \ \text{tonnes}$. A firm needs to deliver $24$ crates each weighing $5\ \text{tonnes}$. How many vans are needed?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A transport company's vans each carry a maximum load of $12 \ \text{tonnes}$. A firm needs to deliver $24$ crates each weighing $5\ \text{tonnes}$. How many vans are needed?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total vans needed}                &= \dfrac {\text{Total crates} \times \text{Weight of 1 crate}} {\text{Maximum load van can take}} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {24 \times 5} {12} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {2 \times 12 \times 5} {12} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {2 \times \cancel{12} \times 5} {\cancel{12}} \\\\
                                        &= 2 \times 5 \\\\
                                        &= 10
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$10$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is the sum of the first $40$ whole numbers?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is the sum of the first $40$ whole numbers?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{First number}                             &= 0 \\\\
\text{Last number}                              &= 39 \\\\
\text{Total numbers}                            &= 40
\end{aligned}
$

Let's find the sum of  first 40 whole numbers.

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {\text{Total numbers}} {2} \times (\text{First term + Last term}) \\\\
&= \dfrac {40} {2} \times (0 + 39) \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times 20} {2} \times 39 \\\\
&= \dfrac {\cancel{2} \times 20} {\cancel{2}} \times 39 \\\\
&= 20 \times 39 \\\\
&= 780
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$780$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">

<div class="formulacodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="formulacodeblock_title">

</div>

</code></pre>

<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">As per the question,
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\text{First number}                             &= 0 \\\\
\text{Last number}                              &= 39 \\\\
\text{Total numbers}                            &= 40
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Let's find the sum of  first 40 whole numbers.
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac {\text{Total numbers}} {2} \times (\text{First term + Last term}) \\\\
&= \dfrac {40} {2} \times (0 + 39) \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times 20} {2} \times 39 \\\\
&= \dfrac {\cancel{2} \times 20} {\cancel{2}} \times 39 \\\\
&= 20 \times 39 \\\\
&= 780
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many spots are there on a normal six-sided dice?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many spots are there on a normal six-sided dice?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Numbers of spots on six different sides of dice}  &= 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 \\\\
\text{Total spots}                                      &= 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 + 6 \\\\
                                                        &= 21
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As we know, opposite sides of a dice always add up to 7.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total spots}                                 &= \dfrac {6} {2} \times 7 \\\\
                                                   &= 3 \times 7 \\\\
                                                   &= 21
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$21$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In an orchestra there are $60$ children. If $\dfrac {1} {5}$ play the recorder and $40\%$ play the triangle, how many children play something else?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In an orchestra there are $60$ children. If $\dfrac {1} {5}$ play the recorder and $40\%$ play the triangle, how many children play something else?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Children playing something else} &= \text{Total children - Playing recorder - Playing triangle}  \\\\
&= 60 - \dfrac {1} {5} \times 60 - 40\% \times 60 \\\\
&= 60 - \dfrac {60} {5} - \dfrac {40 \times 60} {100} \\\\
&= 60 - \dfrac {5 \times 12} {5} -  \dfrac {40 \times 60} {100} \\\\
&= 60 - \dfrac {\cancel{5} \times 12} {\cancel{5}}  -\dfrac {4 \cancel{0} \times 6 \cancel{0}} {1 \cancel{0} \cancel{0}} \\\\
&= 60 - 12 - 24 \\\\
&= 24
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$24$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

He can lay $7$ bricks every $5 \ \text{minutes}$. How long will it take him to build the wall? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">He can lay $7$ bricks every $5 \ \text{minutes}$. How long will it take him to build the wall? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time}         &= \dfrac {\text{Total bricks}} {7} \times 5  \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {266} {7} \times 5 \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {7 \times 38 \times 5} {7} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {\cancel{7} \times 38 \times 5} {\cancel{7}} \\\\
                    &= 38 \times 5 \\\\
                    &= 190 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac{190}{60} \ \text{hours} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac{19 \times 2 \times 5}{2 \times 5 \times 6} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac{19 \times \cancel{2} \times \cancel{5}}{\cancel{2} \times \cancel{5} \times 6} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {19} {6} \\\\
                    &= 3 \ \text{hours} \ 10 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$3 \ \text{hours} \ 10 \ \text{minutes or } 190 \ \text{minutes}$

</div>
</div>

</code></pre>

<div class="formulacodeblock_title">

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Time}         &= \dfrac {\text{Total bricks}} {7} \times 5  \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {266} {7} \times 5 \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {7 \times 38 \times 5} {7} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {\cancel{7} \times 38 \times 5} {\cancel{7}} \\\\
                    &= 38 \times 5 \\\\
                    &= 190 \ \text{minutes} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac{190}{60} \ \text{hours} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac{19 \times 2 \times 5}{2 \times 5 \times 6} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac{19 \times \cancel{2} \times \cancel{5}}{\cancel{2} \times \cancel{5} \times 6} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {19} {6} \\\\
                    &= 3 \ \text{hours} \ 10 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>
</div>

**Question**

How many pieces of ribbon of $30\ \text{cm}$ length can be cut from a piece of length $7\ \text{m}?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many pieces of ribbon of $30\ \text{cm}$ length can be cut from a piece of length $7\ \text{m}?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total ribbons}    &= \dfrac {7 \times 1 \ \text{m}} {30 \ \text{cm}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {7 \times 100 \ \text{cm}} {30 \ \text{cm}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {70 \times 2 \times 5} {3 \times 2 \times 5} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {70 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} {3 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {70} {3} \\\\
                        &= 23 \text{ remainder } 1 \\\\
                        &\approx 23
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$23$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Alex and Emma buy the same type of bike.

Alex pays $\pounds169.99$ cash from his birthday money.

Emma pays a deposit of $\pounds70.00$ and then pays instalments of $\pounds10$ per month over the course of one year (12 months).

Who pays the most and by how much ? Show all of your working clearly.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Alex and Emma buy the same type of bike.
<emptyline>

<emptyline>
Emma pays a deposit of $\pounds70.00$ and then pays instalments of $\pounds10$ per month over the course of one year (12 months).
<emptyline>
Who pays the most and by how much ? Show all of your working clearly.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Amount paid by Alex}                   &= \pounds 169.99 \\\\
\text{Amount paid by Emma}                   &= 70 + 12 \times 10 \\\\ 
                                                 &= 70 + 120 \\\\
                                                 &= \pounds 190 \\\\
\text{Difference}     &= 190 - 169.99 \\\\
                                                 &= \pounds 20.01
\end{aligned}
$

Emma pays $\pounds 20.01$ more than Alex
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

Emma pays more

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Mrs Walker is planning a party for her grand-daughter and there will be $70$ children in total.

Each child will have a party bag to take home with a lollipop 
and a toy.

Empty party bags are sold in packs of $12$ and cost $\pounds2$ per pack.

Lollipops are sold in packs of $8$ and cost $\pounds4$ per pack.

Toys are sold in packs of $9$ and cost $\pounds10$ per pack.

As a special new year offer, all prices are reduced by one quarter.

How many packs of each item will she need to buy and what will be her total cost? Show all your working clearly. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Mrs Walker is planning a party for her grand-daughter and there will be $70$ children in total.
<emptyline>
Each child will have a party bag to take home with a lollipop 
and a toy.
<emptyline>
Empty party bags are sold in packs of $12$ and cost $\pounds2$ per pack.
<emptyline>
Lollipops are sold in packs of $8$ and cost $\pounds4$ per pack.
<emptyline>
Toys are sold in packs of $9$ and cost $\pounds10$ per pack.
<emptyline>
As a special new year offer, all prices are reduced by one quarter.
<emptyline>
How many packs of each item will she need to buy and what will be her total cost? Show all your working clearly. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{New cost of solid bag}                     &= 2 - 2 \times \dfrac{1}{4} \\\\
                                                 &= 2 -  \dfrac{1 \times 2}{4} \\\\
                                                 &= 2 -  \dfrac{1 \times \cancel{2}}{2 \times \cancel{2}} \\\\
                                                 &= 2 -  \dfrac{1}{2} \\\\
                                                 &= 2 -  0.5 \\\\
                                                 &= \pounds 1.5 \\\\
\text{New cost of lollipops}                     &= 4 - 4 \times \dfrac{1}{4} \\\\
                                                 &= 4 - 4 \times \dfrac{1}{4} \\\\
                                                 &= 4 - \dfrac{4}{4} \\\\
                                                 &= 4 - \dfrac{\cancel{4}}{\cancel{4}} \\\\
                                                 &= 4 - 1 \\\\
                                                 &= \pounds 3 \\\\
\text{New cost of toys}                          &= 10 - 10 \times \dfrac{1}{4} \\\\
                                                 &= 10 - \dfrac{10}{4} \\\\
                                                 &= 10 - \dfrac{5 \times 2}{2 \times 2} \\\\
                                                 &= 10 - \dfrac{5 \times \cancel{2}}{2 \times \cancel{2}} \\\\
                                                 &= 10 - \dfrac{5}{2} \\\\
                                                 &= 10 - 2.5 \\\\
                                                 &= \pounds 7.5 \\\\
\text{Number of party bags required}             &= 70 \div 12 \\\\
												 &= \dfrac {70} {12}
                                                 &= 5 \text{ remainder } 10 \\\\
                                                 &\approx 6 \\\\
\text{Cost of party bags for }70\text{ children} &= 6 \times 1.5 \\\\
                                                 &= \pounds 9 \\\\
\text{Number of lollipop packs required}         &= 70 \div 8 \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {70} {8} \\\\
                                                 &= 8 \text{ remainder } 6 \\\\
                                                 &\approx 9\\\\
\text{Cost of lollipops for }70\text{ children}  &= 9 \times 3 \\\\
                                                 &= \pounds 27 \\\\
\text{Number of toy packs required}              &= 70 \div 9 \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac {70} {9} \\\\
                                                 &= 7 \text{ remainder } 7 \\\\
                                                 &\approx 8 \\\\
\text{Cost of toys for }70\text{ children}       &= 8 \times 7.5 \\\\
                                                 &= \pounds 60 \\\\
\text{Total cost}                                &= 60 + 27 + 9 \\\\
                                                 &= \pounds 95
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 95$

</div>
</div>
