<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A sunflower is one hundred and fifty centimetres tall.

How tall will it be if its height increases by ten per cent?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A sunflower is one hundred and fifty centimetres tall.
<emptyline>
How tall will it be if its height increases by ten per cent?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If the height is increased by $10\%$ then new height will be $100 + 10 = 110\%$ of the orginal height.

Using this we get,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{New height}  &= 110 \% \text { of} \ 150 \\\\
                   &= \dfrac {110} {100} \times 150 \\\\
                   &= \dfrac {110 \times 150} {100} \\\\
                   &= \dfrac {11 \cancel {0} \times 15 \cancel {0}} {1 \cancel {0} \cancel {0}} \\\\
                   &= 11 \times 15 \\\\
                   &= 165 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$165 \ \text{cm}$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="formulacodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="formulacodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Formulas Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If the height is increased by $10\%$ then new height will be $100 + 10 = 110\%$ of the orginal height.
<emptyline>
Using this we get,
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\text{New height}  &= 110 \% \text { of} \ 150 \\\\
                   &= \dfrac {110} {100} \times 150 \\\\
                   &= \dfrac {110 \times 150} {100} \\\\

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

One display cabinet holds $38$ DVDs. How many cabinets will be needed to hold $646$ DVDs? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">One display cabinet holds $38$ DVDs. How many cabinets will be needed to hold $646$ DVDs? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of cabinets required}      &= \dfrac {646} {38} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {17 \times 38} {38} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {17 \times \cancel {38}} {\cancel{38}} \\\\
                                        &= 17
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$17$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Lizzie gets $20\%$ on a $10$-problem test, $80\%$ on a $20$-problem test and $9 \%$ on a $30$-problem test. If the three tests are combined into one $60$-problem test, what percentage is her overall score?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Lizzie gets $20\%$ on a $10$-problem test, $80\%$ on a $20$-problem test and $9 \%$ on a $30$-problem test. If the three tests are combined into one $60$-problem test, what percentage is her overall score?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}\
\text{Marks Lizzie got in 10-problem set}   &= 20 \% \ \text{of} \ 10 \\\\ 
                                            &= \dfrac{20}{100} \times 10 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{20 \times 10}{100} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{2 \cancel 0 \times 1 \cancel 0}{1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                            &= 2 \\\\
\text{Marks Lizzie got in 20-problem set}   &= 80 \% \ \text{of} \ 20 \\\\ 
                                            &= \dfrac{80}{100} \times 20 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{80 \times 20}{100} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{8 \cancel 0 \times 2 \cancel 0}{1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                            &= 8 \times 2 \\\\
                                            &= 16 \\\\
\text{Marks Lizzie got in 30-problem set}   &= 90 \% \ \text{of} \ 30 \\\\ 
                                            &= \dfrac{90}{100} \times 30 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{90 \times 30}{100} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{9 \cancel 0 \times 3 \cancel 0}{1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                            &= 9 \times 3 \\\\
                                            &= 27 \\\\
\text{Total precentage}                     &= \dfrac{2 + 16 + 27}{60} \times 100 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{45}{60} \times 100 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{45 \times 100}{60} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{15 \times 3 \times 4 \times 25}{15 \times 4} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{\cancel {15} \times 3 \times \cancel 4 \times 25}{\cancel {15} \times \cancel 4} \\\\
                                            &= 3 \times 25 \\\\
                                            &= 75 \ \%
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$75 \ \%$

</div>
</div>

                                            &= \dfrac{20}{100} \times 10 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{20 \times 10}{100} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{2 \cancel 0 \times 1 \cancel 0}{1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                            &= 2 \\\\
\text{Marks Lizzie got in 20-problem set}   &= 80 \% \ \text{of} \ 20 \\\\ 
                                            &= \dfrac{80}{100} \times 20 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{80 \times 20}{100} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{8 \cancel 0 \times 2 \cancel 0}{1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                            &= 8 \times 2 \\\\
                                            &= 16 \\\\
\text{Marks Lizzie got in 30-problem set}   &= 90 \% \ \text{of} \ 30 \\\\ 
                                            &= \dfrac{90}{100} \times 30 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{90 \times 30}{100} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{9 \cancel 0 \times 3 \cancel 0}{1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                            &= 9 \times 3 \\\\
                                            &= 27 \\\\
\text{Total precentage}                     &= \dfrac{2 + 16 + 27}{60} \times 100 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{45}{60} \times 100 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{45 \times 100}{60} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac{15 \times 3 \times 4 \times 25}{15 \times 4} \\\\

\end{aligned}
$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A number is called a palindrome if it reads the same backwards as forwards. For example, $13931$ is a palindrome. 

What is the difference between the least $5$-digit palindrome number and the greatest $6$-digit palindrome number?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A number is called a palindrome if it reads the same backwards as forwards. For example, $13931$ is a palindrome. 
<emptyline>
What is the difference between the least $5$-digit palindrome number and the greatest $6$-digit palindrome number?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{5 digit smallest palindromic number}      &= 10001 \\\\
\text{6 digit largest palindromic number}       &= 999999 \\\\
\text{Difference}                               &= 999999 - 10001 \\\\
                                                &= 989998
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answers">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

I got $30\%$ on a $10$-problem test, $70\%$ on a $20$-problem test and $80\%$ on a $30$-problem test.

If the three tests are combined into one $60$-problem test, what percentage is my overall score?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">I got $30\%$ on a $10$-problem test, $70\%$ on a $20$-problem test and $80\%$ on a $30$-problem test.
<emptyline>
If the three tests are combined into one $60$-problem test, what percentage is my overall score?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Overall score}            &= \dfrac {10} {100} \times 10 + \dfrac {70} {100} \times 20 + \dfrac {80} {100} \times 30 \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {10 \times 10} {100} + \dfrac {70 \times 20} {100} + \dfrac {80 \times 30} {100} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {100} {100} + \dfrac {14 \times 5 \times 20} {20 \times 5} + \dfrac {20 \times 4 \times 6 \times 5} {20 \times 5} \\\\
                                 &= 1 + 14 + 6 \times 4 \\\\
                                 &= 15 + 24 \\\\ 
                                 &= 39 \\\\
\text {Overall percentage}       &= \dfrac {39} {60} \times 100 \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {3 \times 13 \times 2 \times 5 \times 10} {2 \times 3 \times 10} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {\cancel {3} \times 13 \times \cancel {2} \times 5 \times \cancel {10}} {\cancel {2} \times \cancel {3} \times \cancel {10}} \\\\
                                 &= 13 \times 5 \\\\
                                 &= 65 \%
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$65 \%$

</div>
</div>

                                 &= \dfrac {100} {100} + \dfrac {14 \times 5 \times 20} {20 \times 5} + \dfrac {20 \times 4 \times 6 \times 5} {20 \times 5} \\\\
                                 &= 1 + 14 + 6 \times 4 \\\\
                                 &= 15 + 24 \\\\ 
                                 &= 39 \\\\
\text {Overall percentage}       &= \dfrac {39} {60} \times 100 \\\\

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Take a $2$ digit number, then reverse it. Take the smaller number away from the larger.

[For example, starting with $83$, you would form $83 - 38 = 45$. Starting with $91$, you would form $91 - 19 = 72$]

Do this several times. What do you notice about your answers?

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The sum of the all the whole numbers from $1$ to $50$ inclusive is $1275$. Work out the sum of the whole numbers from $2$ and $51$ inclusive.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\end{aligned}

We need $1$ more minibus for the remaining $9$ members.

Total minibuses $= 2 + 1 = 3$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The transport costs were $\pounds 90$ altogether. They also had to pay $\pounds 150$ for the group to use the leisure centre. Helen collected $\pounds 6.50$ from each passenger to pay for this.

How much was left over?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The transport costs were $\pounds 90$ altogether. They also had to pay $\pounds 150$ for the group to use the leisure centre. Helen collected $\pounds 6.50$ from each passenger to pay for this.
<emptyline>
How much was left over?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total costs} &= \text{Transport} + \text{Leisure centre} \\\\
&= 90 + 150 \\\\
&= \pounds 240 \\\\
\text{Total collected} &= 39 \times 6.50 \\\\
&= \pounds 253.50 \\\\
\text{Left over} &= \text{Total collected} - \text{Total costs} \\\\
&= 253.50 - 240 \\\\
&= \pounds 13.50
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 13.50$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total boxes}             &= \dfrac {570} {50} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {57 \cancel 0} {5 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                   &= \dfrac {57} {5} \\\\
                                   &= 11 \text{ remainder } 2 \\\\
                                   &\approx 12
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$12$ boxes

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a class of $40$ pupils, $14$ failed the physical fitness test. What percentage of the class failed the test?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a class of $40$ pupils, $14$ failed the physical fitness test. What percentage of the class failed the test?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\begin{aligned}
\text{Percentage of class failed the test}       &= \dfrac{14}{40} \times 100 \\\\ 
                                                 &= \dfrac{14 \times 100}{40} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac{7 \times 2 \times 2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5}{2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 5} \\\\
                                                 &= \dfrac{7 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times 5}{\cancel 2 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
                                                 &= 7 \times 5 \\\\
                                                 &= 35\%
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

                                    &= 389 - (32 \times 12) \\\\
                                    &= 389 - 384 \\\\
                                    &= 5
\end{aligned}
$

**Question**

The family keep eight of the filled boxes to give to friends. The rest are sold in the farm shop.

What percentage of the filled boxes are sold in the farm shop?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<emptyline>
What percentage of the filled boxes are sold in the farm shop?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Percentage of filled boxes sold in the farm shop}     &= \dfrac {32 - 8} {32} \times 100 \\\\
                                                             &= \dfrac {24} {32} \times 100 \\\\
                                                             &= \dfrac {24 \times 100} {32} \\\\
                                                             &= \dfrac {3 \times 8 \times 4 \times 25} {8 \times 4} \\\\
                                                             &= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel {8} \times \cancel {4} \times 25} {\cancel {8} \times \cancel {4}} \\\\
                                                             &= 3 \times 25 \\\\
                                                             &= 75\%
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$75\%$

$

                                  &= \pounds 17.40
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{doughnuts}                  &:& \text{cost} \\\\
= & 1                                 &:& \pounds 1.45 \\\\
= & 1 \times 12                       &:& 1.45 \times 12 \\\\
= & 12                                &:& \pounds 17.40
\end{array}
$

Cost $= \pounds 17.40$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A shop has an end-of-season sale. Everything is reduced by $15\%$. A dress is originally priced at $\pounds 48$ (full price). What is the sale price of the dress?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A shop has an end-of-season sale. Everything is reduced by $15\%$. A dress is originally priced at $\pounds 48$ (full price). What is the sale price of the dress?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Sale price}  &= 85\% \ \text{of} \ \pounds 48 \\\\
                   &= \dfrac {85 \times 48} { 100 } \\\\
                   &= \dfrac {5 \times 17 \times 2 \times 24} {2 \times 5 \times 10} \\\\
                   &= \dfrac {\cancel{5} \times 17 \times \cancel{2} \times 24} {\cancel{2} \times \cancel{5} \times 10 } \\\\
                   &= \dfrac {17 \times 24} {10} \\\\
                   &= \dfrac {408} {10} \\\\
                   &= \pounds 40.8
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 40.8$

</div>

**Question**

If the concert hall is $75\%$ full, how many seats are empty? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If the concert hall is $75\%$ full, how many seats are empty? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">

</div>

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If the concert hall is 75% full, then the hall is: 100% - 75% = 25% empty.

Using that we get,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Empty seats}  &= 25 \% \ \text {of} \ 4480 \\\\
                     &= \dfrac {25} {100} \times 4480 \\\\
                     &= \dfrac {5 \times 5 \times 2 \times 2 \times 1120} {5 \times 5 \times 2 \times 2} \\\\
                     &= \dfrac {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 2 \times 1120} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 2} \\\\
                     &= 1120
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$1120$

</div>
</div>

                     &= \dfrac {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 2 \times 1120} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 2} \\\\

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Nicola has four number cards:

$\Large{\boxed{1} \quad \boxed{2} \quad \boxed{8} \quad \boxed{9}}$
 
She arranges them to form two $2$ digit numbers. She multiplies the numbers together. Calculate the largest possible answer.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Nicola has four number cards:
<emptyline>
$\Large{\boxed{1} \quad \boxed{2} \quad \boxed{8} \quad \boxed{9}}$
<emptyline>
She arranges them to form two $2$ digit numbers. She multiplies the numbers together. Calculate the largest possible answer.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

The largest answer will only be possible when the two numbers are $91$ and $82$. So,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Largest possible product}  &= 91 \times 82 \\\\
                                  &= 7462
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\text{Each month}       &= \dfrac {\text{Total bill in a year}} {\text{Number of month in a year}} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {375.84} {12} \\\\

                        &= \dfrac {3132} {100} \\\\
                        &= \pounds 31.32
\end{aligned}
$

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$

\text{Number of women} &= \dfrac {2} {5} \times 480 \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times 480} {5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times 96 \times 5} {5} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2 \times 96 \times \cancel {5}} {\cancel {5}} \\\\
&= 192 \\\\
\text{Number of children}   &= \text {Total} - \text {Women}- \text{Men} \\\\
                            &= 480 - 192 - 160 \\\\
                            &= 128
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A test to find whether a number is divisible by $9$ is to add up the digits. If the result is divisible by $9$ so is the original number.

For example, in the number $576$, the sum of the digits is $5 + 7 + 6 = 18$.

Since $18$ is exactly divisible by $9$, the number $576$ is also divisible by $9$.

On the other hand, in the number $1357$, the sum of the digits is $1 + 3 + 5 + 7 = 16$.

Since $16$ is not divisible by $9$, the number $1357$ is not divisible by $9$. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

**Question**

The five digit number $b6b51$ is divisible by $9$. What is the value of the $b \text{?}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Sum of digits}                          &= b + 6 + b + 5 + 1 \\\\
                                              &= 2b + 12
\end{aligned}
$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
2b + 12       &= 18 \\\\
2b            &= 18 - 12 \\\\
2b            &= 6 \\\\
b             &= \dfrac {6} {2} \\\\
b             &= \dfrac {2 \times 3} {2} \\\\
b             &= \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times 3} {\cancel 2} \\\\
b             &= 3
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$3$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a Tennis club $\dfrac {1} {9}$ of the players are left handed.
                 
There are three times as many players who wear glasses as there are who are left handed. What fraction of the players wear glasses? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a Tennis club $\dfrac {1} {9}$ of the players are left handed.
<emptyline>
There are three times as many players who wear glasses as there are who are left handed. What fraction of the players wear glasses? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Fraction of players who wear glasses}      &= 3 \times \dfrac {1}{9} \\\\
                                                  &= \dfrac {3 \times 1} {9} \\\\
                                                  &= \dfrac {3 \times 1} {3 \times 3} \\\\
                                                  &= \dfrac {\cancel{3} \times 1} {\cancel{3} \times 3} \\\\
                                                  &= \dfrac {1} {3}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac {1} {3}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Boxes of eggs hold $12$ eggs. How many boxes will be needed to hold $158$ eggs? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total Box} &= \dfrac{158}{12} \\\\
                 &= \dfrac{79 \times 2}{6 \times 2} \\\\
                 &= \dfrac{79 \times \cancel 2}{6 \times \cancel 2} \\\\
                 &= \dfrac{79}{6} \\\\
                 &= 13 \text { remainder } 6 \\\\
                 &\approx 14
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Pairs of avocados are sold in a shop. $16$ pairs of avocados are sold at a total cost of $\pounds 24$. The shopkeeper now decides to separate the pairs and sell the avocados individually, but without any change to the total price. What is the cost of an individual avocado? Give your answer in pence.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Pairs of avocados are sold in a shop. $16$ pairs of avocados are sold at a total cost of $\pounds 24$. The shopkeeper now decides to separate the pairs and sell the avocados individually, but without any change to the total price. What is the cost of an individual avocado? Give your answer in pence.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of 1 pair of avocados}     &= \dfrac {\pounds  24} {16} \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac {24 \times 100 \ \text{pence}} {16}  \\\\
\text{Cost of 1 avocado}              &= \dfrac {1} {2} \times \dfrac {24 \times 100} {16} \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac {24 \times 100} {2 \times 16} \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac {8 \times 3 \times 2 \times 2 \times 25} {2 \times 8 \times 2} \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac {\cancel{8} \times 3 \times \cancel{2} \times \cancel{2} \times 25} {\cancel{2} \times \cancel{8} \times \cancel{2}} \\\\
                                      &= 3 \times 25  \\\\
                                      &= 75 \ \text{pence}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$75 \ \text{pence}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Gita wants to form a $4$ digit number where the first and last digits are both prime. What are the largest and smallest numbers that Gita can form?

Repeated digits are allowed. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Gita wants to form a $4$ digit number where the first and last digits are both prime. What are the largest and smallest numbers that Gita can form?
<emptyline>
Repeated digits are allowed. 
</code></pre>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A square number is what we get if we multiply a whole number by 
itself. A cube number comes from multiplying a number by itself and then by itself again. 
So $9$ is a square number because $9 = 3 \times 3$, and $8$ is a cube number because $8 = 2 \times 2 \times 2$.

$1$ is both a square and a cube because $1 = 1 \times 1$ and $1 = 1 \times 1 \times 1$. 
Find another number bigger than $0$ that is both a square and cube number.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A square number is what we get if we multiply a whole number by 
itself. A cube number comes from multiplying a number by itself and then by itself again. 
So $9$ is a square number because $9 = 3 \times 3$, and $8$ is a cube number because $8 = 2 \times 2 \times 2$.
<emptyline>
$1$ is both a square and a cube because $1 = 1 \times 1$ and $1 = 1 \times 1 \times 1$. 
Find another number bigger than $0$ that is both a square and cube number.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= 8 \times 8 \\\\   
&= 8^2 \\\\
& = 64 \\\\
&= 4 \times 4 \times 4  \\\\
&= 4^3 \\\\   
& = 64 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$64$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

'Yummy' chocolate bars are packed in either boxes of $5$ or boxes of $12$.

What is the smallest number of full boxes required to pack exactly $2019$ 'Yummy' bars?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">'Yummy' chocolate bars are packed in either boxes of $5$ or boxes of $12$.
<emptyline>
What is the smallest number of full boxes required to pack exactly $2019$ 'Yummy' bars?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let number of $5$ size boxes $= a$

Let number of $12$ size boxes $= b$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
5a + 12b              &= 2019 \\\\
5a                    &= 2019 - 12b \\\\
a                     &= \dfrac {2019 - 12b} {5}
\end{aligned}
$

For minimum number of boxes we need to have maximum number of $12$ size boxes.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Maximum number of 12 size boxes}    &= \dfrac {2019} {12} \\\\
                                          &= 168 \text{ remainder } 3 \\\\
                                          &\approx 168
\end{aligned}
$

We can easily infer the value of a and b by trial and error.

|  Value of b  |      Value of $12b$       |  Value of $2019 - 12b$  |      Value a           |  Is value of a integer  |
|:------------:|:-------------------------:|:-----------------------:|:----------------------:|:-----------------------:|
|    $168$     |  $12 \times 168 = 2016$   |    $2019 - 2016 = 3$    |  $\dfrac {3} {5}$      |          No             |
|    $167$     |  $12 \times 167 = 2004$   |    $2019 - 2004 = 15$   |  $\dfrac {15} {5} = 3$ |          Yes            |

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Minimum number of boxes required}   &= a + b \\\\
                                          &= 3 + 167 \\\\
                                          &= 170
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$170$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

On a farm $80$ sheep gave birth. $30\%$ of the sheep gave birth to two lambs. The rest of the sheep gave birth to one lamb. In total, how many lambs were born? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">On a farm $80$ sheep gave birth. $30\%$ of the sheep gave birth to two lambs. The rest of the sheep gave birth to one lamb. In total, how many lambs were born? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Twins}          &= 30\% \ \text{of} \ 80 \\\\
                      &= \dfrac{30}{100}\times 80 \\\\
                      &= \dfrac{30 \times 80}{100} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac{3 \cancel 0 \times 8 \cancel 0}{1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                      &= 3 \times 8 \\\\
                      &= 24 \\\\
\text{Single}         &= 80-24 \\\\
                      &= 56 \\\\
\text{Total lambs}    &= 56 + 24 \times 2 \\\\
                      &= 56 + 48 \\\\
                      &= 104 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$104$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a tin of Roses, $8\%$ are “Purple Ones” (hazelnut & caramel). If the tin has a total of $250$ chocolates, how many are **not** Purple Ones?  

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a tin of Roses, $8\%$ are “Purple Ones” (hazelnut & caramel). If the tin has a total of $250$ chocolates, how many are **not** Purple Ones?  
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Not Purple}  &=  250 - 8 \% \times 250 \\\\
                    &=  250 - \dfrac {8} {100} \times 250 \\\\
                    &=  250 - \dfrac {2 \times 2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5 \times 10} {2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5} \\\\
                    &=  250 - \dfrac {2 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times 10} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
                    &=  250 - 2 \times 10 \\\\
                    &=  250 - 20 \\\\
                    &=  230
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$230$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a tin of Quality Street, $12\%$ are Coffee Crèmes. If the tin has a total of $250$ chocolates, how many are not Coffee Crèmes?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a tin of Quality Street, $12\%$ are Coffee Crèmes. If the tin has a total of $250$ chocolates, how many are not Coffee Crèmes?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Not Coffee Crèmes}  &= 250 - 12 \ \% \ \text{of} \ 250 \\\\
                          &= 250 - \dfrac {12 \times 250} {100} \\\\
                          &= 250 - \dfrac {30 \times 2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5} {2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5} \\\\
                          &= 250 - \dfrac {30 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
                          &= 250 - 30 \\\\
                          &= 220
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$220$

</div>
</div>

                          &= 250 - \dfrac {12 \times 250} {100} \\\\
                          &= 250 - \dfrac {30 \times 2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5} {2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5} \\\\
                          &= 250 - \dfrac {30 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} \\\\

**Question**

A kilometre is $\dfrac {5} {8}$  of a mile. How many miles away from Goodison Park do I live?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

</code></pre>

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\text{Distance}     &= 6.4 \ \text{km} \\\\

&= \dfrac{0.8 \times 8 \times 5}{8} \\\\
&= \dfrac{0.8 \times \cancel{8} \times 5}{\cancel{8}} \\\\
&= 0.8 \times 5 \\\\
&= 4 \ \text{miles}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a giant tube of Fruit Pastilles, $20\%$ are orange. If the tube has a total of $85$ sweets, how many are **not** orange? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a giant tube of Fruit Pastilles, $20\%$ are orange. If the tube has a total of $85$ sweets, how many are **not** orange? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Not orange}  &= 85 - 20\% \times 85 \\\\
                    &= 85 - \dfrac {20} {100} \times 85 \\\\
                    &= 85 - \dfrac{2 \times 2 \times 5 \times 17 \times 5} {2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5} \\\\
                    &= 85 - \dfrac{\cancel 2 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times 17 \times \cancel 5} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} \\\\ 
                    &= 85 - 17 \\\\
                    &= 68
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$68$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Pippa came home from her holiday at her Grandma's with $5$ books. Whilst she was away she bought $2$ books from the bookshop and got $1$ book as a present from her Grandma. During her stay at her Grandma's she gave her cousin $4$ books that she had finished. How many books did Pippa take with her when she left for her holiday? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Pippa came home from her holiday at her Grandma's with $5$ books. Whilst she was away she bought $2$ books from the bookshop and got $1$ book as a present from her Grandma. During her stay at her Grandma's she gave her cousin $4$ books that she had finished. How many books did Pippa take with her when she left for her holiday? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Number of books Pipa took for holiday}   &= \text {Total books} - \text {Books given by Grandma} \\\\
                                                &= 5 + 2 + 1 + 4 - 2 - 1 \\\\
                                                &= 12 - 3 \\\\
                                                &= 9
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$9$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In 1990 a new $5 \ \text{p}$ coin was minted. The old size weighs $5.65\ \text{g}$ while the new size weighs $3.25\ \text{g}$. How much lighter will your pocket be if it contains $\pounds 2$ worth of the new size coins instead of the old size. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In 1990 a new $5 \ \text{p}$ coin was minted. The old size weighs $5.65\ \text{g}$ while the new size weighs $3.25\ \text{g}$. How much lighter will your pocket be if it contains $\pounds 2$ worth of the new size coins instead of the old size. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Old Weight}    &= \dfrac {2 \times 100}{5} \times 5.65 \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {2 \times 565 \times 100} {5 \times 100} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {2 \times 5 \times 113 \times 2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5} {5 \times 2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {2 \times \cancel 5 \times 113 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
                      &= 226 \ \text {g} \\\\
\text {New Weight}    &= \dfrac{2 \times 100}{5} \times 3.25 \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {2 \times 325 \times 100} {5 \times 100} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {2 \times 5 \times 65 \times 2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5} {5 \times 2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {2 \times \cancel 5 \times 65 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
                      &= 130 \ \text {g} \\\\
\text{Difference}     &= 226 - 130 \\\\
                      &= 96 \ \text{g}                                  
\end{aligned}
$

Pocket will be $96 \ \text{g}$ lighter.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$96 \ \text{g}$

</div>
</div>

                      &= \dfrac {2 \times \cancel 5 \times 113 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
                      &= 226 \ \text {g} \\\\

                      &= \dfrac {2 \times \cancel 5 \times 65 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} \\\\

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Marie bought seven cinema tickets for $\pounds 58.10$. How much was each ticket? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

</code></pre>

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of ticket}   &= \dfrac {58.10} {7} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{7 \times 8.30 }{7} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{\cancel{7} \times 8.30 }{\cancel{7}} \\\\
                        &= \pounds 8.30
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\text{Cost of ticket}   &= \dfrac {58.10} {7} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{7 \times 8.30 }{7} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{\cancel{7} \times 8.30 }{\cancel{7}} \\\\
                        &= \pounds 8.30
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a box of sweets there are $7$ toffees for every $12$ chocolates. If there are $72$ chocolates how many toffees are there? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a box of sweets there are $7$ toffees for every $12$ chocolates. If there are $72$ chocolates how many toffees are there? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of toffees $= a$

Using equivalent ratio,

$
\begin{aligned}
12 \ \text{chocolates} : 7 \ \text{toffees}     &= 72 \ \text{chocolates} : a \ \text{toffees} \\\\
\dfrac {12} {7}                                 &= \dfrac {72} {a} \\\\
12 \times a                                     &= 72 \times 7 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {72 \times 7} {12} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {6 \times 12 \times 7} {12} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {6 \times \cancel {12} \times 7} {\cancel {12}} \\\\
a                                               &= 6 \times 7 \\\\
a                                               &= 42
\end{aligned}
$

Number of toffees $= 42$
</div>
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Using ratio,

$
\begin{array}{cccccccccccccc}
  & \text{chocolates}             &:& \text{toffees} \\\\
= & 12                            &:& 7 \\\\
= & 12 \times 6                   &:& 7 \times 6 \\\\
= & 72                            &:& 42
\end{array}
$

Number of toffees $= 42$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$42$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

David is $15 \ \text{stone} \ 11$. Andrew is $275 \ \text{pounds}$. If there are $14 \ \text{pounds}$ in $1 \ \text{stone}$ what is the difference between their weights? Give your answer in pounds. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">David is $15 \ \text{stone} \ 11$. Andrew is $275 \ \text{pounds}$. If there are $14 \ \text{pounds}$ in $1 \ \text{stone}$ what is the difference between their weights? Give your answer in pounds. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Difference}           &= 275 \text{ pounds} - (15 \text{ stone } + 11 \text{ pounds}) \\\\
                            &= 275 \text{ pounds} - (15 \times 14 \text{ pounds} + 11 \text{ pounds}) \\\\
                            &= 275 - (210 + 11) \\\\
                            &= 275 - 221 \\\\
                            &= 54 \text{ pounds}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$54 \text{ pounds}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jennifer is assembling a wardrobe. The measurements for the $3$ sections are given in different units. 
The first section is $30 \ \text{cm}$ wide; the second section is $1.5 \ \text{m}$ wide and 
the third section $150 \ \text{mm}$ wide. How wide is whole wardrobe? Give your answer in $\text{cm}$. 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Jennifer is assembling a wardrobe. The measurements for the $3$ sections are given in different units. 
The first section is $30 \ \text{cm}$ wide; the second section is $1.5 \ \text{m}$ wide and 
the third section $150 \ \text{mm}$ wide. How wide is whole wardrobe? Give your answer in $\text{cm}$. 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total width}    &= 30 \ \text{cm} + 1.5 \ \text{m} + 150 \ \text{mm} \\\\
                      &= 30 \ \text{cm} + 1.5 \times 10 \ \text{cm} + \dfrac{150}{10}\ \text{cm} \\\\
                      &= 30 + 15 + \dfrac{15 \times 2 \times 5}{2 \times 5} \\\\
                      &= 30 + 15 + \dfrac{15 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5}{\cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
                      &= 60 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$60 \ \text{cm}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Kevin gets paid $\pounds 500$ for each match he plays plus $\pounds 100$ for each goal he scores. In a season he plays $20$ games and averages two goals per game.
How much does he earn over the season?  

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Kevin gets paid $\pounds 500$ for each match he plays plus $\pounds 100$ for each goal he scores. In a season he plays $20$ games and averages two goals per game.
How much does he earn over the season?  
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total earning}    &= \text {Number of matches} \times 500 + \text {Number of goals} \times 100 \\\\
                        &= 20 \times 500 + 2 \times 20 \times 100 \\\\
                        &= 10000 + 4000 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 14000
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 14000$

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If she started with $\pounds 120$ how much does she have left?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If she started with $\pounds 120$ how much does she have left?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Money left}         &= \text{Total money} - \text{Money spent on dress} - \text{Money spent on shoes} \\\\
                          &= 120 - \left( \dfrac {1}{3} \times \dfrac{1}{2} \times 120 \right) - \left( \dfrac{1}{2} \times 120 \right) \\\\
                          &= 120 - \left( \dfrac {1}{3} \times \dfrac{1}{2} \times 3 \times 2 \times 20 \right) - \left( \dfrac{1}{2} \times 2 \times 60 \right) \\\\
                          &= 120 - \left( \dfrac {1}{\cancel 3} \times \dfrac{1}{\cancel 2} \times \cancel 3 \times \cancel 2 \times 20 \right) - \left( \dfrac{1}{\cancel 2} \times \cancel 2 \times 60 \right) \\\\
                          &= 120 - (60 + 20) \\\\
                          &= 120 - 80 \\\\
                          &= \pounds 40
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A box contains $220$ matches and weighs 
$45 \ \text{grams}$. 

The empty box weighs $12 \ \text{grams}$.

Calculate the weight of one match.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A box contains $220$ matches and weighs 
$45 \ \text{grams}$. 
<emptyline>
The empty box weighs $12 \ \text{grams}$.
<emptyline>
Calculate the weight of one match.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Weight of one match}      &= \dfrac {45 - 12} {220} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {33} {220} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {3 \times 11} {2 \times 10 \times 11} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {3 \times \cancel{11}} {2 \times 10 \times \cancel{11}} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {3} {2 \times 10} \\\\
                                 &= \dfrac {3} {20} \\\\
                                 &= 0.15 \ \text{grams} 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$0.15 \ \text{grams}$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

Alex has $9$ rangos and $4$ fangos. Barbara has $7$ rangos and $3$ fangos. How many fangos do they both have in total?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Alex has $9$ rangos and $4$ fangos. Barbara has $7$ rangos and $3$ fangos. How many fangos do they both have in total?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Total fangos} &= 9 \ \text{rangos} + 4 \ \text{fangos} + 7 \ \text{rangos} + 3 \ \text{fangos} \\\\
                     &= 9 \times 6 \ \text{fangos} + 4 \ \text{fangos} + 7 \times 6 \ \text{fangos} + 3 \ \text{fangos} \\\\
                     &= 9 \times 6 + 4 + 7 \times 6 + 3 \\\\
                     &= 54 + 4 + 42 + 3 \\\\
                     &= 103 \ \text{fangos}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

What fraction of a bango do $12$ fangos represent?

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

&= \dfrac {2 \times \cancel 6} {\cancel 6 \times 15} \\\\
&= \dfrac {2} {15} \ \text{bangos}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

\end{aligned}

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Mary, Jess and Jo run a race. 

Jess's time is $18 \ \text{seconds}$. 

Jo finishes $6 \ \text{seconds}$ before Jess. 

Mary finishes $4 \ \text{seconds}$ after Jo. 

What is **Mary's time** in seconds?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Mary, Jess and Jo run a race. 
<emptyline>
Jess's time is $18 \ \text{seconds}$. 
<emptyline>
Jo finishes $6 \ \text{seconds}$ before Jess. 
<emptyline>
Mary finishes $4 \ \text{seconds}$ after Jo. 
<emptyline>
What is **Mary's time** in seconds?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Jess's time}  &= 18 \ \text {seconds} \\\\
\text {Jo's time}    &= 18 - 6 \\\\
                            &= 12 \ \text {seconds} \\\\
\text {Mary's time}  &= 12 + 4 \\\\
                            &= 16 \ \text {seconds}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$16 \ \text {seconds}$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$70$ children need $3$ pens each.

Pens are sold in packs of $8$.

How many packs of pens need to be bought?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$70$ children need $3$ pens each.
<emptyline>
Pens are sold in packs of $8$.
<emptyline>
How many packs of pens need to be bought?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Pack of pens need to be bought}         &= \dfrac {3 \times 70} {8} \\\\
                                              &= \dfrac {3 \times 35 \times 2} {4 \times 2} \\\\
                                              &= \dfrac {3 \times 35 \times \cancel{2}} {4 \times \cancel{2}} \\\\
                                              &= \dfrac {3 \times 35} {4} \\\\
                                              &= \dfrac {105} {4} \\\\
                                              &= 26 \text{ remainder } 1 \\\\
                                              &\approx 27
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$27$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The cost for using a minibus is $\pounds 2.42$ for each kilometre.

$11$ friends go on a $32 \ \text{kilometre}$ journey using $1$ minibus.

They share the cost equally.

How much does each person pay?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The cost for using a minibus is $\pounds 2.42$ for each kilometre.
<emptyline>
$11$ friends go on a $32 \ \text{kilometre}$ journey using $1$ minibus.
<emptyline>
They share the cost equally.
<emptyline>
How much does each person pay?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Cost per person}      &= \dfrac {2.42 \times 32} {11} \\\\
                             &= \dfrac {2.42 \times 100 \times 32} {11 \times 100} \\\\
                             &= \dfrac {242 \times 32} {11 \times 100} \\\\
                             &= \dfrac {11 \times \cancel {11} \times 2 \times 32} {\cancel {11} \times 100} \\\\
                             &= \dfrac {11 \times 2 \times 32} {100} \\\\
                             &= \dfrac {704} {100} \\\\
                             &= \pounds 7.04
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 7.04$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Sarah won a large jar of sweets in a Christmas raffle. If there are $486$ sweets in the jar and she shares them equally with her $17$ classmates, how many do they each get?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Sarah won a large jar of sweets in a Christmas raffle. If there are $486$ sweets in the jar and she shares them equally with her $17$ classmates, how many do they each get?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
