$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Sweets per person}       &= \dfrac {486} {18} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {27 \times 18}{18} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {27 \times 2 \times 3 \times 3}{2 \times 3 \times 3} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {27 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 3 \times \cancel 3}{\cancel 2 \times \cancel 3 \times \cancel 3} \\\\
                                &= 27
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$27$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many bags of crisps at $16 \ \text{p}$ each can I buy for $\pounds 2 \text{?}$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many bags of crisps at $16 \ \text{p}$ each can I buy for $\pounds 2 \text{?}$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Number of crisp bags}    &= \dfrac {\text {Total money}} {\text {Money per bag}} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {\pounds 2} {16 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {2 \times 100 \ \text{p}} {16 \ \text{p}} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {200} {16} \\\\
                                &= 12 \ \text {remainder} \ 8 \\\\
                                &= 12
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Benjamin walks dogs to earn some money. The formula below can be used to work out his pay.

$\text{Pay} = \pounds 12$ per day $+ \pounds 1.50$ for each dog walked

Benjamin worked all day on Monday. He walked $13$ dogs before lunch and $15$ dogs afterwards.

Work out Benjamin's pay on Monday.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Benjamin walks dogs to earn some money. The formula below can be used to work out his pay.
<emptyline>
$\text{Pay} = \pounds 12$ per day $+ \pounds 1.50$ for each dog walked
<emptyline>
Benjamin worked all day on Monday. He walked $13$ dogs before lunch and $15$ dogs afterwards.
<emptyline>
Work out Benjamin's pay on Monday.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total dogs walked} &= 13 + 15 \\\\
                         &= 28 \\\\
\text{Pay}               &= 12 + 1.50 \times 28 \\\\
                         &= 12 + 42 \\\\
                         &= \pounds 54
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 54$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

How many Gammas in $5$ Alphas, $6$ Betas and $3$ Gammas?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many Gammas in $5$ Alphas, $6$ Betas and $3$ Gammas?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total Gammas}     &= 5 \ \text{Alphas} + 6 \ \text{Betas} + 3 \ \text{Gammas} \\\\
                        &= 5 \times 20 \times 5 \ \text{Gammas} + 6 \times 3 \ \text{Gammas} + 3 \ \text{Gammas} \\\\
                        &= 5 \times 20 \times 5 + 6 \times 3 + 3 \\\\
                        &= 500 + 18 + 3 \\\\
                        &= 521 \ \text{Gammas}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Using as many alphas as you can, and then betas, then gammas, how would you pay for something that costs $789$ Gammas?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Using as many alphas as you can, and then betas, then gammas, how would you pay for something that costs $789$ Gammas?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of alphas}     &= \dfrac {789} {20 \times 5} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {789} {100} \\\\
                            &= 7 \text{ remainder } 89 \\\\
                            &\approx 7 \\\\
\text{Remaining gammas}     &= 789 - 7 \times 5 \times 20 \\\\
                            &= 789 - 700 \\\\
                            &= 89 \\\\
\text{Number of betas}      &= \dfrac {89} {5} \\\\
                            &= 17 \text{ remainder } 4 \\\\
                            &\approx 17 \\\\
\text{Remaining gammas}     &= 89 - 17 \times 5 \\\\
                            &= 89 - 85 \\\\
                            &= 4
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A box of biscuits contains $36$ biscuits. $20$ biscuits have foil wrappers. $15$ are chocolate biscuits with foil wrappers.

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Find the distance from her school to her home in $\text{km}$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find the distance from her school to her home in $\text{km}$.
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$\begin{aligned}
\text{Home to 1st pole} &= \dfrac{30}{2}  \\\\
&= 15 \ \text{m} \\\\
\text{Distance betweeen poles} &= 39 \times 30 \\\\
&= 1170 \ \text{m} \\\\
\text{Last pole to school} &= \dfrac{30}{2} \\\\
&= 15 \ \text{m} \\\\
\text{Total distance} &= 15 + 1170 + 15 \\\\
&= 1200 \ \text{m} \\\\
&= 1.2 \ \text{km}
\end{aligned}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If she walks at a speed of $8 \ \text{km/h}$, how long does it take her to get to school from home?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If she walks at a speed of $8 \ \text{km/h}$, how long does it take her to get to school from home?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
- ABBR: $\text {Distance} = \text{Speed} \times \text{Time}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$\begin{aligned}
\text {Time taken}  &= \dfrac{1.2}{8} \ \text{hours} \\\\
&= \dfrac{1.2 \times 10}{8 \times 10} \ \text{hours} \\\\
&= \dfrac{12 \times 60}{8 \times 10} \ \text{minutes} \\\\
&= \dfrac{4 \times 3 \times 2 \times 3 \times 10}{4 \times 2 \times 10} \\\\
&= \dfrac{\cancel{4} \times 3 \times \cancel{2} \times 3 \times \cancel{10}}{\cancel{4} \times \cancel{2} \times \cancel{10}} \\\\
&= 3 \times 3 \\\\
&= 9 \ \text{minutes}
\end{aligned}$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$9 \ \text{minutes}$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

$75$ students need $3$ pens each. Pens are sold in packs of $6$. How many whole packs need to be bought?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$75$ students need $3$ pens each. Pens are sold in packs of $6$. How many whole packs need to be bought?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total packs needed}       &= \dfrac{\text{Total pens required}}{\text{Pens per pack}} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac{75 \times 3}{6} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac{75 \times 3}{2 \times 3} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac{75 \times \cancel{3}}{2 \times \cancel{3}} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac{75}{2} \\\\
                                &= 37 \ \text {remainder} \ 1 \\\\
                                &\approx 38
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$38$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Freya has $24$ badges. If she gives $\dfrac{3}{8}$ of them to her brother, how many does she have left?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Freya has $24$ badges. If she gives $\dfrac{3}{8}$ of them to her brother, how many does she have left?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

If Freya gives $\dfrac{3}{8}$ of her badges away, then she is left with $1- \dfrac{3}{8} = \dfrac{5}{8}$ of badges.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Badges left}      &= \dfrac{5}{8} \times 24 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{5 \times 24}{8} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{5 \times 3 \times 8}{8} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{5 \times 3 \times \cancel{8}}{\cancel{8}} \\\\
                        &= 15
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$15$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

You are told that $56\%$ of the pupils in a class are girls. 

What is the smallest number of pupils the class could contain?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">You are told that $56\%$ of the pupils in a class are girls. 
<emptyline>
What is the smallest number of pupils the class could contain?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

The smallest number of pupils the class could contain can be found by writing the fraction in its simplest form.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Percentage of girls}          &= 56 \ \% \\\\
\text{Percentage of boys}           &= 100 - 56 \\\\
                                    &= 44 \ \% \\\\
\text{Ratio}                        &= \dfrac {44} {56} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {4 \times 11} {4 \times 14} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 11} {\cancel 4 \times 14} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {11} {14} \\\\
\text{Smallest number of pupils}    &= 11 + 14 \\\\
                                    &= 25
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$25$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The smallest number of pupils the class could contain can be found by writing the fraction in its simplest form.
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Percentage of girls}          &= 56 \ \% \\\\
\text{Percentage of boys}           &= 100 - 56 \\\\
                                    &= 44 \ \% \\\\
\text{Ratio}                        &= \dfrac {44} {56} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {4 \times 11} {4 \times 14} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 11} {\cancel 4 \times 14} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {11} {14} \\\\
\text{Smallest number of pupils}    &= 11 + 14 \\\\
                                    &= 25
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>

**Question**

Find the total number of feet in $3 \ \text{furlongs}, 2 \ \text{chains}$ and $5 \ \text{yards}$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Find the total number of feet in $3 \ \text{furlongs}, 2 \ \text{chains}$ and $5 \ \text{yards}$.
</code></pre>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total feet}   &= 3 \ \text{furlongs} + 2 \ \text{chains} + 5 \ \text{yards} \\\\
                    &= 3 \times 10 \times 22 \times 3 \ \text{feet} + 2 \times 22 \times 3 \ \text{feet} + 5 \times 3 \ \text{feet} \\\\
                    &= 3 \times 10 \times 22 \times 3 + 2 \times 22 \times 3 + 5 \times 3 \\\\
                    &= 1980 + 132 + 15 \\\\
                    &= 2127 \ \text{feet}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of chains}     &= \dfrac {472} {22 \times 3} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {472} {66} \\\\
                            &= 7 \text{ remainder } 10 \\\\
                            &\approx 7 \\\\
\text{Remaining feet}       &= 472 - 7 \times 22 \times 3 \\\\
                            &= 472 - 462 \\\\
                            &= 10 \\\\
\text{Number of yards}      &= \dfrac {10} {3} \\\\
                            &= 3 \text{ remainder } 1 \\\\
                            &\approx 3 \\\\
\text{Remaining feet}       &= 10 - 3 \times 3 \\\\
                            &= 10 - 9 \\\\
                            &= 1
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Sam and Alice have baked a cake.

Sam eats $\dfrac{1}{4}$ of the cake.

Alice eats $\dfrac{2}{5}$ of the cake.

What fraction of the cake have they eaten altogether? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Sam and Alice have baked a cake.
<emptyline>
Sam eats $\dfrac{1}{4}$ of the cake.
<emptyline>
Alice eats $\dfrac{2}{5}$ of the cake.
<emptyline>
What fraction of the cake have they eaten altogether? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Fraction of cake eaten together}    &=  \dfrac{1}{4} + \dfrac{2}{5} \\\\
                                          &=  \dfrac{1 \times 5}{4  \times 5} + \dfrac{2 \times 4}{5 \times 4} \\\\
                                          &=  \dfrac{5}{20} + \dfrac{8}{20} \\\\
                                          &=  \dfrac{5 + 8} {20} \\\\
                                          &=  \dfrac{13}{20}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac{13}{20}$

</div>

**Question**

Lucy takes $2 \ \text{hours}$ and $25 \ \text{minutes}$ to walk up a mountain and 
$1 \ \text{hour}$ and $45 \ \text{minutes}$ to walk down.

For how long does she walk altogether? 

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In the number $267{,}865$ how many times bigger is the value of the first digit $6$ than the value of the second digit $6?$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In the number $267{,}865$ how many times bigger is the value of the first digit $6$ than the value of the second digit $6?$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
&= \dfrac{60,000}{60} \\\\
&= \dfrac{60 \times 1000} {60} \\\\
&= \dfrac{2 \times 2 \times 3 \times 5 \times 1000} {2 \times 2 \times 3 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac{\cancel 2 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 3 \times \cancel 5 \times 1000} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 3 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
&= 1000
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$1000$

</div>
</div>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$

&= \dfrac{60,000}{60} \\\\

&= \dfrac{2 \times 2 \times 3 \times 5 \times 1000} {2 \times 2 \times 3 \times 5} \\\\
&= \dfrac{\cancel 2 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 3 \times \cancel 5 \times 1000} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 3 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
&= 1000
\end{aligned}
$
</code></pre>

Work out how much string each kite would get, giving your answer 
to one decimal place.

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is the difference between the smallest $3$-digit number and the largest  $4$-digit number?

- $1$
- $900$
- $1001$
- $9998$
- $9899$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

- $9998$
- $9899$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Sixteen people, and no more, can sit evenly spaced around a large square table. 
Jas arranges six of these square tables in a row to make one long rectangular table. 
What is the maximum number of people that can sit evenly  spaced around this long table?

- $46$
- $76$
- $56$
- $96$
- $86$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Sixteen people, and no more, can sit evenly spaced around a large square table. 
Jas arranges six of these square tables in a row to make one long rectangular table. 
What is the maximum number of people that can sit evenly  spaced around this long table?
<emptyline>
- $46$
- $76$
- $56$
- $96$
- $86$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Number people one side of the square table}      &= \dfrac {\text {Total people}} {\text {Number of sides}} \\\\
                                                        &= \dfrac {16} {4} \\\\
                                                        &= 4 \\\\
\text {Maximum number of people in rectangular table}   &= \text {Total square tables} \times \text {People per table} - \text {Number of seats lost} \\\\
                                                        &= 6 \times 16 - 10 \times 4 \\\\
                                                        &= 96 - 40 \\\\
                                                        &= 56
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$56$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jan counted a total of $100$ cars parked in four rows of a departmental store car park. 
Five minutes later, $10$ cars had driven away from the first row, 
$8$ cars had driven away from the second row, 
$6$ cars had driven away from the third row and 
$4$ cars had driven away from the fourth row. 
She noticed that there was now the same number of cars in each row. 
How many cars were originally parked in the third row? 

- $24$
- $19$
- $25$
- $18$
- $23$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Jan counted a total of $100$ cars parked in four rows of a departmental store car park. 
Five minutes later, $10$ cars had driven away from the first row, 
$8$ cars had driven away from the second row, 
$6$ cars had driven away from the third row and 
$4$ cars had driven away from the fourth row. 
She noticed that there was now the same number of cars in each row. 
How many cars were originally parked in the third row? 
<emptyline>
- $24$
- $19$
- $25$
- $18$
- $23$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of cars parked in each row after the cars drived away $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
(a + 10) + (a + 8) + (a + 6) + (a + 4)          &= 100 \\\\
a + 10 + a + 8 + a + 6 + a + 4                  &= 100 \\\\
4a + 28                                         &= 100 \\\\
4a                                              &= 100 - 28 \\\\
4a                                              &= 72 \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {72} {4} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {4 \times 18} {4} \\\\
a                                               &= \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 18} {\cancel 4} \\\\
a                                               &= 18
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of cars parked in 3rd row originally}    &= a + 6 \\\\
                                                      &= 18 + 6 \\\\
                                                      &= 24
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="option" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Option**

<p>A</p>
</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$24$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The Crystal Palace bridge has carried $300 \ \text{million}$ cars since it was opened in $1964$. 
On average, roughly how many vehicles is this per month?

- $50000$
- $500000$
- $5000000$
- $6000000$
- $60000000$ 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The Crystal Palace bridge has carried $300 \ \text{million}$ cars since it was opened in $1964$. 
On average, roughly how many vehicles is this per month?
<emptyline>
- $50000$
- $500000$
- $5000000$
- $6000000$
- $60000000$ 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of vehicles per month}       &= \dfrac {300 \ \text{million}} {(2022 - 1964) \times 12} \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {300 \times 1000000} {58 \times 12} \\\\
                                          &= \dfrac {300000000} {696} \\\\
                                          &= 431034.4328 \\\\
                                          &\approx 500000
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="option" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$500000$

</div>
</div>

On this journey Anthony walked a certain distance, and turned right. 
Each time he turned right he walked $2 \ \text{metres}$ less than he did the time before.

![papers/streatham-and-clapham-high-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s02-q05-i00.png](/assets/papers/streatham-and-clapham-high-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s02-q05-i00.png "papers/streatham-and-clapham-high-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s02-q05-i00.png")

- $38$
- $14$
- $51$
- $45$
- $49$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A cube with sides $3 \ \text{cm}$ is made from smaller cubes of side $1 \ \text{cm}$ as shown.

![papers/streatham-and-clapham-high-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s02-q09-i00.png](/assets/papers/streatham-and-clapham-high-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s02-q09-i00.png "papers/streatham-and-clapham-high-school/sample/sample-paper-1/s02-q09-i00.png")

How many small cubes are used in making the bigger cube?

- $21$
- $27$
- $9$
- $18$
- $30$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A cube with sides $3 \ \text{cm}$ is made from smaller cubes of side $1 \ \text{cm}$ as shown.
<emptyline>
%image%
<emptyline>
How many small cubes are used in making the bigger cube?
<emptyline>
- $21$
- $27$
- $9$
- $18$
- $30$
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\text{Number of cubes} &= \dfrac {\text{Volume of bigger cube}} {\text{Volume of smaller cube}}  \\\\
                       &= \dfrac{3 \times 3 \times 3}{1 \times 1 \times 1} \\\\
                       &= 27
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

$27$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a Maths test Freddie gets $37$ more marks than George. If Freddie gets $61$, what mark does George get?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a Maths test Freddie gets $37$ more marks than George. If Freddie gets $61$, what mark does George get?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Freddie's marks}    &= 61 \\\\
\text{George's marks}  &= 61 - 37 \\\\
                       &= 24
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$24$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Rob works $40 \ \text{hours}$ a week and earns $\pounds 440$. What is his hourly rate of pay?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Rob works $40 \ \text{hours}$ a week and earns $\pounds 440$. What is his hourly rate of pay?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Rob's hourly pay}    &= \dfrac {440} {40} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {40 \times 11} {40} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {\cancel {40} \times 11} {\cancel {40}} \\\\
                            &= \pounds 11
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 11$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A bus has $35$ passengers on board. At the first stop two-fifths get off and then $7$ people get on. 
At the next stop a quarter of the people remaining on the bus get off and then $13$ get on. 
How many passengers are there on the bus now?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A bus has $35$ passengers on board. At the first stop two-fifths get off and then $7$ people get on. 
At the next stop a quarter of the people remaining on the bus get off and then $13$ get on. 
How many passengers are there on the bus now?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total passengers after 1st stop}          &= 35 - \bigg({\dfrac {2}{5}} \ \text {of} \ 35 \bigg) + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 35 - \bigg(\dfrac {2} {5} \times 35 \bigg) + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 35 - \bigg(\dfrac {2 \times 35} {5} \bigg) + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 35 - \bigg(\dfrac {2 \times 5 \times 7} {5} \bigg) + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 35 - \bigg(\dfrac {2 \times \cancel {5} \times 7} {\cancel {5}} \bigg) + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 35 - (2 \times 7) + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 35 - 14 + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 28 \ \text {passengers} \\\\
\text{Total passengers after 2nd stop}          &= 28 - \bigg({\dfrac {1}{4}} \ \text {of} \ 28 \bigg) + 13 \\\\
                                                &= 28 - \bigg(\dfrac {1} {4} \times 28 \bigg) + 13 \\\\
                                                &= 28 - \bigg(\dfrac {1} {4} \times 4 \times 7 \bigg) + 13 \\\\
                                                &= 28 - \bigg(\dfrac {4 \times 7} {4} \bigg) + 13 \\\\
                                                &= 28 - \bigg(\dfrac {\cancel {4} \times 7} {\cancel {4} } \bigg) + 13 \\\\
                                                &= 28 - 7 + 13 \\\\
                                                &= 34 \ \text {passengers}
\end{aligned}
$

There are $34$ passengers on the bus now.
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$34$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="formulacodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="formulacodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Formulas Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total passengers after 1st stop}          &= 35 - \bigg({\dfrac {2}{5}} \ \text {of} \ 35 \bigg) + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 35 - \bigg(\dfrac {2} {5} \times 35 \bigg) + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 35 - \bigg(\dfrac {2 \times 35} {5} \bigg) + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 35 - \bigg(\dfrac {2 \times 5 \times 7} {5} \bigg) + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 35 - \bigg(\dfrac {2 \times \cancel {5} \times 7} {\cancel {5}} \bigg) + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 35 - (2 \times 7) + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 35 - 14 + 7 \\\\
                                                &= 28 \ \text {passengers} \\\\
\text{Total passengers after 2nd stop}          &= 28 - \bigg({\dfrac {1}{4}} \ \text {of} \ 28 \bigg) + 13 \\\\
                                                &= 28 - \bigg(\dfrac {1} {4} \times 28 \bigg) + 13 \\\\
                                                &= 28 - \bigg(\dfrac {1} {4} \times 4 \times 7 \bigg) + 13 \\\\
                                                &= 28 - \bigg(\dfrac {4 \times 7} {4} \bigg) + 13 \\\\
                                                &= 28 - \bigg(\dfrac {\cancel {4} \times 7} {\cancel {4} } \bigg) + 13 \\\\
                                                &= 28 - 7 + 13 \\\\
                                                &= 34 \ \text {passengers}
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
There are $34$ passengers on the bus now.
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A large crate holds twelve cartons of milk whereas a small crate holds only four cartons. 
I have five large crates and twenty small crates available. 
What is the smallest number of crates in total that I could use to store $110$ cartons of milk?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A large crate holds twelve cartons of milk whereas a small crate holds only four cartons. 
I have five large crates and twenty small crates available. 
What is the smallest number of crates in total that I could use to store $110$ cartons of milk?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

To find the smallest number of crates in total, we should use as many large crates as possible.

$\begin{aligned}
\text{Capacity of large crate} &= 12 \\\\
\text{Capacity of small crate} &= 4 \\\\
\text{Total cartons} &= 110 \\\\
\text{Max large crates available} &= 5 \\\\
\text{Cartons in large crates} &= 5 \times 12 \\\\
&= 60 \\\\
\text{Remaining cartons} &= 110 - 60 \\\\
&= 50 \\\\
\text{Small crates needed} &= \dfrac{50}{4} \\\\
&= 12 \ \text{remainder } 2 \\\\
&\approx 13
\end{aligned}$

We need $1$ more small crate for the remaining $2$ cartons.

$\begin{aligned}
\text{Total crates} &= 5 + 13 \\\\
&= 18
\end{aligned}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$18$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

Josephine currently weighs $53 \ \text{kg}$. She has a $BMI$ of $16$ so is currently classified as underweight. 
What is the least extra weight that she needs to put on if she is to be re-classified as normal?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Josephine currently weighs $53 \ \text{kg}$. She has a $BMI$ of $16$ so is currently classified as underweight. 
What is the least extra weight that she needs to put on if she is to be re-classified as normal?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

As per the question,

$BMI$ $18.5$ or less is classified as $Underweight$. 

Refer to the calculations at the end of the question.

$\dfrac{53}{1.82^2} = 16$

and 

$\dfrac{61.6}{1.82^2} = 18.6$

$BMI$ between $18.6$ and $24.9$ is classified as $Normal$.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Lowest weight Josephine need to put on} &= 61.6 - 53 \\\\
                                               &= 8.6 \ \text{kg}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$8.6 \ \text{kg}$

</div>
</div>

If $161$ sweets are shared equally between $7$ people, how many sweets does each person receive?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If $161$ sweets are shared equally between $7$ people, how many sweets does each person receive?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Sweets each person get}      &= \dfrac {\text{Total sweets}} {\text{Total people}} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {161} {7} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {7 \times 23}{7} \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {\cancel 7 \times 23} {\cancel 7} \\\\
                                    &= 23
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$23$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If $9$ bananas cost $\pounds 1.23$ find the cost of $12$ bananas.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If $9$ bananas cost $\pounds 1.23$ find the cost of $12$ bananas.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total cost}       &= 12 \times \dfrac{1.23}{9} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{12 \times 1.23 }{9} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{3 \times 4 \times 0.41 \times 3}{3 \times 3} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{\cancel{3} \times 4 \times 0.41 \times \cancel {3}} {\cancel{3} \times \cancel{3}} \\\\
                        &= 4 \times 0.41 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 1.64
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 1.64$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

When a rope is cut equally into $8$ pieces it is discovered that each piece is a whole number of centimetres long. 
The same thing happens if this rope is cut into $6$ pieces. What is the shortest length that this rope could be?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">When a rope is cut equally into $8$ pieces it is discovered that each piece is a whole number of centimetres long. 
The same thing happens if this rope is cut into $6$ pieces. What is the shortest length that this rope could be?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

This can be solved by finding the LCM of $8$ and $6$

Let's first find the LCM of $8$ and $6$ by listing multiples. The smallest number that is a multiple of two numbers is the LCM

Multiple of $8 = 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, \ldots$

Multiple of $6 = 6, 12, 18, 24, 30, \ldots$

The LCM of $8$ and $6$ is the smallest number that is a multiple of both numbers $=24$.

The shortest length that this rope could be $= 24 \ \text{cm}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$24 \ \text{cm}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Four friends, Alwyn, Bax, Coates and Delius have lunch together. Although each eats a differently priced snack, 
they share the bill equally. Yesterday, this resulted in Alwyn paying $\pounds 1$ less than the cost of his snack, 
Bax paying $\pounds 3$ more, Coates $\pounds 4$ less and Delius paid $\pounds 4$. 
What was the actual price of the snack that each friend ordered?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Four friends, Alwyn, Bax, Coates and Delius have lunch together. Although each eats a differently priced snack, 
they share the bill equally. Yesterday, this resulted in Alwyn paying $\pounds 1$ less than the cost of his snack, 
Bax paying $\pounds 3$ more, Coates $\pounds 4$ less and Delius paid $\pounds 4$. 
What was the actual price of the snack that each friend ordered?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

All four friends shared the bill equally. 

Delius paid $\pounds 4$. So, each friend paid $\pounds 4$.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Alwyn's snack cost}      &= 4 + 1 \\\\
                      &= \pounds 5 \\\\
\text{Bax's snack cost}        &= 4 - 3 \\\\
                      &= \pounds 1 \\\\
\text{Coates's snack cost}     &= 4 + 4 \\\\
                      &= \pounds 8
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

Alwyn $=$ $\pounds 5$

</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

Bax $=$ $\pounds 1$

</div>
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

Coates $=$ $\pounds 8$

</div>

**Question**

 The table below shows the prices of a week's holiday at four
hotels in Orlando Florida during October this year. The prices are per person
and a reduction is offered for **children aged $2$ to $16 \ \text{years}$ old**. The
prices include the cost of the flight and accommodation. **Infants under $2 \ \text{years}$ old travel free**. There is an option to buy tickets to the theme
parks. Infants have free entry.

For example, if a family consisting of two adults and one child (aged $9$) 
stay for a week at the Little Rodent Hotel the total cost of the holiday, 
including a rover theme park ticket for everyone, would be:

$2 \times 1320 + 780 + 2 \times 320 + 240 = \pounds 4300$

|      Hotel     |  Cost per adult  |  Cost per child  |  Adult Rover Ticket | Child Rover Ticket |
|:--------------:|:----------------:|:----------------:|:-------------------:|:------------------:|
|  Little Rodent | $\pounds  1320 $ |  $\pounds  780 $ |   $\pounds  320 $   |   $\pounds  240 $  |
|   South Seas   | $\pounds  1450 $ |  $\pounds  850 $ |   $\pounds  320 $   |   $\pounds  240 $  |
|  Holiday Mill  | $\pounds  1550 $ |  $\pounds  900 $ |   $\pounds  320 $   |   $\pounds  240 $  |
| Portomento Bay | $\pounds  2050 $ | $\pounds  1040 $ |   $\pounds  320 $   |   $\pounds  240 $  |

the Holiday Mill for a week, including the cost of rover theme park tickets.

**Question**

A family consisting of just one adult and a child (aged $11$) decide to spend a week in Orlando. They are 
trying to choose between staying at the South Seas and Portomento Bay. How much more expensive will it be 
to stay at the Portomento Bay?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

trying to choose between staying at the South Seas and Portomento Bay. How much more expensive will it be 
to stay at the Portomento Bay?
</code></pre>
</div>

                        &= (2050 + 1040) - (1450 + 850) \\\\               
                        &= 3090 - 2300 \\\\
                        &= \pounds 790
\end{aligned}
$

The Portomento Bay will be $\pounds 790$ more expensive.
</div>

<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The Adams family consisting of two parents and their children aged $14$ and $17$ travel to Orlando for a week's 
theme park holiday. 
Before they leave the UK they buy their theme park tickets online using a special internet deal which 
provides a $25\%$ reduction on all rover tickets. How much money do they save by buying these tickets online?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Money saved}      &= 25 \% \ \text{of} \ (3 \times 320 + 240) \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{25}{100} \times (3 \times 320 + 240) \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {25} {100} \times (960 + 240) \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {25} {100} \times 1200 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {25 \times 1200} {100} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {25 \times 4 \times 300} {25 \times 4} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {\cancel {25} \times \cancel 4 \times 300} {\cancel {25} \times \cancel 4} \\\\
                        &= \pounds 300
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 300$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

How much do the couple earn altogether?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A box holds $4$ cakes. How many boxes are needed to store $75$ cakes?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</code></pre>

                      &= 18 \ \text {remainder} 3 \\\\

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The safety notice in a lift reads:

Maximum $6$ persons $580 \ \text{kilograms}$

The weights of the first five people to enter the lift are $90 \ \text{kg}$, 
$80 \ \text{kg}$, $95 \ \text{kg}$, $115 \ \text{kg}$ and $89 \ \text{kg}$.

What is the maximum weight of the sixth person in the lift if they all travel together safely?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The safety notice in a lift reads:
<emptyline>
Maximum $6$ persons $580 \ \text{kilograms}$
<emptyline>
The weights of the first five people to enter the lift are $90 \ \text{kg}$, 
$80 \ \text{kg}$, $95 \ \text{kg}$, $115 \ \text{kg}$ and $89 \ \text{kg}$.
<emptyline>
What is the maximum weight of the sixth person in the lift if they all travel together safely?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the maximum weight of the sixth person $= a$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned} 
90 + 80 + 95 + 115 + 89 + a   &= 580 \\\\
a + 469                       &= 580 \\\\
a                             &= 580 - 469 \\\\
a                             &= 111 \ \text{kg}
\end{aligned}
$

Maximum weight of the sixth person $= 111 \ \text{kg}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$111 \text{ kg}$

</div>

**Question**

Each branch of the flowering shrub, *Mathematicus arithmetica* has $5$ stems. Each stem has $8$ flowers and each flower has $11$ 
petals. If a shrub has $3$ branches, how many petals does it have?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

petals. If a shrub has $3$ branches, how many petals does it have?
</code></pre>

                                    &= 1320

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

If $1590$ sweets are shared equally between $122$ children, how many sweets do they each get and how many are left over?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If $1590$ sweets are shared equally between $122$ children, how many sweets do they each get and how many are left over?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Sweets each child got}             &= \dfrac {1590} {122} \\\\
                                          &= 13 \ \text {remainder} 4 \\\\
                                          &\approx 13 \\\\
\text {Sweets left}                       &= 1590 - 122 \times 13 \\\\
                                          &= 1590 - 1586 \\\\
                                          &= 4
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$13, 4$

</div>
</div>

                                          &\approx 13 \\\\

                                          &= 1590 - 1586 \\\\

**Question**

If it takes $90 \ \text{minutes}$ for two identical towels to dry on a washing line, how long would three of these towels have taken to dry?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">If it takes $90 \ \text{minutes}$ for two identical towels to dry on a washing line, how long would three of these towels have taken to dry?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

The towels are identical and we assume there is enough space on the line.

The drying time does not depend on the number of towels if they can all hang freely.

So $3$ towels would still take $90 \ \text{minutes}$ to dry.

Answer $= 90 \ \text{minutes}$
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In the winter, I try and climb up an icy slope starting at the bottom. Each time 
I make a move I find that I go up four metres but then slide back down two metres. 
How many moves do I need to get to the top which is $8 \ \text{metres}$ up the slope from the bottom?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In the winter, I try and climb up an icy slope starting at the bottom. Each time 
I make a move I find that I go up four metres but then slide back down two metres. 
How many moves do I need to get to the top which is $8 \ \text{metres}$ up the slope from the bottom?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$\begin{aligned}
\text{Move 1 before sliding} &= 4 \ \text{m} \\\\
\text{After sliding} &= 4 - 2  \\\\
                            &= 2 \ \text{m} \\\\
\text{Move 2 before sliding} &= 2 + 4 \ \text{m} \\\\
&= 6 \ \text{m} \\\\
\text{After sliding} &= 6 - 2  \\\\
                            &= 4 \ \text{m} \\\\
\text{Move 3} &= 4 + 4 \\\\
                            &= 8 \ \text{m}
\end{aligned}$

Number of moves $= 3$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$3$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

The area of mould growing on my bathroom wall doubles every day. After $13$ days the area covered is $2880 \ \text{cm}^2$. 
After how days did the area first exceed $300 \ \text{cm}^2?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">The area of mould growing on my bathroom wall doubles every day. After $13$ days the area covered is $2880 \ \text{cm}^2$. 
After how days did the area first exceed $300 \ \text{cm}^2?$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let's work backwards to find the area on previous days.

$\begin{aligned}
\text{Area after 13 days} &= 2880  \\\\
\text{Area after 12 days} &= \dfrac{2880}{2} \\\\
                          &= 1440 \ \text{cm}^2 \\\\
\text{Area after 11 days} &= \dfrac{1440}{2} \\\\
                          &= 720 \ \text{cm}^2 \\\\
\text{Area after 10 days} &= \dfrac{720}{2} \\\\
                          &= 360 \ \text{cm}^2 \\\\
\text{Area after 9 days} &= \dfrac{360}{2} \\\\
                         &= 180 \ \text{cm}^2
\end{aligned}$

The area first exceeds $300 \ \text{cm}^2$ after 10 days.

Answer $= 10$ days
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$10$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

An aircraft takes off from London Heathrow with $120000 \ \text{litres}$ of fuel on board. 
It flies at an average speed of $800 \ \text{kilometres}$ per hour and uses fuel at a rate of $10 \ \text{litres}$ per kilometre.

How much fuel is left in the tank when it lands in Miami $9 \ \text{hours}$ later?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">An aircraft takes off from London Heathrow with $120000 \ \text{litres}$ of fuel on board. 
It flies at an average speed of $800 \ \text{kilometres}$ per hour and uses fuel at a rate of $10 \ \text{litres}$ per kilometre.
<emptyline>
How much fuel is left in the tank when it lands in Miami $9 \ \text{hours}$ later?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Distance}                    &= 800 \times 9 \\\\
                                    &= 7200 \ \text{kilometres} \\\\
\text{Fuel used}                    &= 7200 \times 10 \\\\
                                    &= 72000 \ \text{litres} \\\\
\text{Fuel left}                    &= 120000 - 72000 \\\\
                                    &= 48000 \ \text{litres}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$48000 \ \text{litres}$

</div>

**Question**

Rinesh started painting his house two years ago. During that year, Rinesh painted one-third of his house.

Last year, Rinesh painted another five-twelfths of his house.

What fraction of his house does Rinesh need to paint this year, in order to finish completely painting his house?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Rinesh started painting his house two years ago. During that year, Rinesh painted one-third of his house.
<emptyline>
Last year, Rinesh painted another five-twelfths of his house.
<emptyline>
What fraction of his house does Rinesh need to paint this year, in order to finish completely painting his house?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Fraction painted so far} &= \dfrac{1}{3} + \dfrac{5}{12} \\\\
                               &= \dfrac{1 \times 4}{3 \times 4} + \dfrac{5}{12} \\\\
                               &= \dfrac{4}{12} + \dfrac{5}{12} \\\\
                               &= \dfrac{9}{12} \\\\
                               &= \dfrac{3 \times 3}{3 \times 4} \\\\
                               &= \dfrac{\cancel{3} \times 3}{\cancel{3} \times 4} \\\\
                               &= \dfrac{3}{4} \\\\
\text{Fraction needed}         &= 1 - \dfrac{3}{4} \\\\
                               &= \dfrac{4}{4} - \dfrac{3}{4} \\\\
                               &= \dfrac{1}{4} \\\\
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac{1}{4}$

**Question**

Bijal started weeding her garden two weeks ago. During that week, she weeded one-fifth of her garden.

Last week, Bijal weeded two and a half times as much of her garden as she weeded two weeks ago.

What fraction of her garden does Bijal need to weed this week, in order to finish completely weeding her garden?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Bijal started weeding her garden two weeks ago. During that week, she weeded one-fifth of her garden.
<emptyline>
Last week, Bijal weeded two and a half times as much of her garden as she weeded two weeks ago.
<emptyline>
What fraction of her garden does Bijal need to weed this week, in order to finish completely weeding her garden?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Weeded two weeks ago} &= \dfrac{1}{5} \\\\
\text{Weeded last week}     &= 2.5 \times \dfrac{1}{5} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{5}{2} \times \dfrac{1}{5} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{\cancel{5} \times 1}{2 \times \cancel{5}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{1}{2} \\\\
\text{Total weeded}         &= \dfrac{1}{5} + \dfrac{1}{2} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{2}{5 \times 2} + \dfrac{5}{2 \times 5} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{2}{10} + \dfrac{5}{10} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{7}{10} \\\\
\text{Fraction needed}      &= 1 - \dfrac{7}{10} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{10}{10} - \dfrac{7}{10} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac{3}{10} \\\\
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\dfrac{3}{10}$

</div>

<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Nina is painting garden gnomes. She has four-fifths of a litre of paint. Each garden gnome needs one-twentieth of a litre of paint. How many garden gnomes can she paint?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: Dividing fractions is the same as multiplying by the reciprocal (inverse) of the second fraction.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of gnomes} &= \dfrac{4}{5} \div \dfrac{1}{20} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{4}{5} \times \dfrac{20}{1} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{4 \times 20}{5} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{4 \times 4 \times 5}{5} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{4 \times 4 \times \cancel{5}}{\cancel{5}} \\\\
                        &= 16
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$16$

**Question**

Pat arranges her $144$ British stamps in an album. Each page holds $6$ stamps.

How many pages does she use?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Pat arranges her $144$ British stamps in an album. Each page holds $6$ stamps.
<emptyline>
How many pages does she use?

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Pages used}  &= \dfrac {144} {6} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {24 \times 2 \times 3} {2 \times 3} \\\\
                    &= \dfrac {24 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 3} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 3} \\\\
                    &= 24
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

**Question**

How many minutes does he spend eating lunch?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
