\begin{aligned}
\text{Time spends on eating lunch}   &= \dfrac {1} {3} \ \text {of} \ 60 \\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {60} {3} \\\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {20 \times 3} {3} \\\\\
                                    &= \dfrac {20 \times \cancel 3} {\cancel 3} \\\\\
                                    &= 20 \ \text{mins}
\end{aligned}
$

How long does he spend playing with his friends?

<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

                                    &= 30 \ \text{min}
\end{aligned}

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A sunflower is $150 \ \text{cm}$ tall.

How tall will it be if its height increases by $10\%$? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A sunflower is $150 \ \text{cm}$ tall.
<emptyline>
How tall will it be if its height increases by $10\%$? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>

<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Height after an increase of 10\%}&= 150 + 10 \% \ \text {of} \ 150 \\\\
&= 150 + \dfrac {10} {100} \times 150 \\\\
&= 150 + \dfrac {10 \times 150} {100} \\\\
&= 150 + \dfrac {2 \times 5 \times 15 \times 2 \times 5} {2 \times 5 \times 2 \times 5} \\\\
&= 150 + \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times 15 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 5} \\\\
&= 150 + 15 \\\\
&= 165
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$165$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a box of $24$ pens, one eighth are green, $25\%$ are red and the rest are blue.

What fraction of the pens is blue? 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a box of $24$ pens, one eighth are green, $25\%$ are red and the rest are blue.
<emptyline>
What fraction of the pens is blue? 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Number of blue pens} &= 24 - (\dfrac {1} {8} \times 24 + \dfrac {25} {100} \times 24) \\\\
&= 24 - (\dfrac {24} {8} + \dfrac {25 \times 24} {100}) \\\\
&= 24 - (\dfrac {2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 3} {2 \times 2 \times 2} + \dfrac {5 \times 5 \times 2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 3} {5 \times 5 \times 2 \times 2}) \\\\
&= 24 - (\dfrac {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 2 \times 3} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 2} + \dfrac {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 2 \times 2 \times 3} {\cancel 5 \times \cancel 5 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 2}) \\\\
&= 24 - (3 + 6) \\\\
&= 24 - 9 \\\\
&= 15 \\\\
\text {Blue pens} &= \dfrac {15} {24} \\\\
 &= \dfrac {\cancel {3} \times 5} {\cancel {3} \times 8} \\\\
 &= \dfrac {5} {8}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$\dfrac {5}{8}$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A website advertises that, as a special offer, a new mobile phone game 
will cost $40 \%$ less to download next week.

If the game costs $80 \ \text{p}$ this week, how much will it cost next week?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A website advertises that, as a special offer, a new mobile phone game 
will cost $40 \%$ less to download next week.
<emptyline>
If the game costs $80 \ \text{p}$ this week, how much will it cost next week?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of the game next week}   &= 80 - 40 \% \ \text{of} \ 80 \\\\
                                    &= 80 - \dfrac {40} {100} \times 80 \\\\
                                    &= 80 - \dfrac {40 \times 80} {100} \\\\
                                    &= 80 - \dfrac {4 \cancel 0 \times 8 \cancel 0} {1 \cancel 0 \cancel 0} \\\\
                                    &= 80 - 4 \times 8 \\\\
                                    &= 80 - 32 \\\\
                                    &= 48 \ \text{p}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$48 \ \text{p}$

</div>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

How many grams of ingredients other than lemons, flour and sugar are there?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">How many grams of ingredients other than lemons, flour and sugar are there?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$\begin{aligned}
\text{Amount of sugar}  &= 225 \ \text{grams} \\\\
\text{Amount of flour}  &= \dfrac{1}{2} \times 900 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{900}{2} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{450 \times 2}{2} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{450 \times \cancel{2}}{\cancel{2}} \\\\
                        &= 450 \ \text{grams} \\\\
\text{Amount of lemons} &= \dfrac{1}{12} \times 900 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{900}{12} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{75 \times 12}{12} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac{75 \times \cancel{12}}{\cancel{12}} \\\\
                        &= 75 \ \text{grams} \\\\\
\text{Others}  &= 900 - 225 - 450 - 75 \\\\
                        &= 150 \ \text{grams}
\end{aligned}$ 
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$150 \text{ gm}$ 

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Nikita pays $\pounds 9.50$ a month for her mobile phone and an extra $17 \ \text{p}$ for each call that she makes. 
How much does she pay in a month when she makes $50$ calls?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Nikita pays $\pounds 9.50$ a month for her mobile phone and an extra $17 \ \text{p}$ for each call that she makes. 
How much does she pay in a month when she makes $50$ calls?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Money paid by Nikita in a month}    &= \pounds 9.50 + 50 \times 17 \ \text{p} \\\\
                                          &= \pounds 9.50 + \pounds \dfrac {50 \times 17} {100} \\\\
                                          &= 9.50 + \dfrac {850} {100} \\\\
                                          &= 9.50 + 8.50 \\\\
                                          &= \pounds 18
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 18$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In the last year a library bought $237$ new books and removed $67$ books. 

There were $5745$ books in the library at the end of the year.

How many books were in the library at the start of the year?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In the last year a library bought $237$ new books and removed $67$ books. 
<emptyline>
There were $5745$ books in the library at the end of the year.
<emptyline>
How many books were in the library at the start of the year?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Book at start of the year} &= 5745 - 237 + 67 \\\\
												&= 5575 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$5575$

**Question**

The return journey starts at $1950$ from Shrewsbury. If each part of the journey (including the wait at Ludlow) takes the same time as in the morning, complete the timetable for the return journey.

| Shrewsbury | depart | $1950$ |
|:----------:|:------:|:------:|
|   Ludlow   | arrive |        |
|   Ludlow   | depart |        |
|  Hereford  | arrive |        |

<emptyline>
| Shrewsbury | depart | $1950$ |
|:----------:|:------:|:------:|
|   Ludlow   | arrive |        |
|   Ludlow   | depart |        |
|  Hereford  | arrive |        |
</code></pre>
</div>

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Arriving time at Ludlow}      &= 19{:}50 + (9{:}30 - 8{:}45) \\\\
                                    &= 19{:}50 + 45 \ \text{mins} \\\\
                                    &= 20{:}35 \\\\
\text{Departure time at Ludlow}     &= 20{:}35 + (8{:}45 - 8{:}43) \\\\
                                    &= 20{:}35 + 2 \ \text{min} \\\\
                                    &= 20{:}37 \\\\
\text{Arriving time at Hereford}    &= 20{:}37 + (8{:}43 - 8{:}20) \\\\
                                    &= 20{:}37 + 23 \ \text{min} \\\\
                                    &= 21{:}00
\end{aligned}
$

**Question**

A chocolate bar costs $36 \ \text{p}$. How many can Nikita buy for $\pounds 3.00?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

There are $24$ children in Alfie's class. Five eighths of the class have school lunch. How many children have school lunch?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">There are $24$ children in Alfie's class. Five eighths of the class have school lunch. How many children have school lunch?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Number of children who took Lunch}   &= \dfrac {5} {8} \times 24 \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {5 \times 24} {8} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {5 \times 3 \times 2 \times 2 \times 2} {2 \times 2 \times 2} \\\\
                                            &= \dfrac {5 \times 3 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 2} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 2 \times \cancel 2} \\\\
                                            &= 5 \times 3 \\\\
                                            &= 15
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$15$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Jamie got seven questions wrong in a test out of $25$ questions. What percentage of the questions did he get wrong?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Jamie got seven questions wrong in a test out of $25$ questions. What percentage of the questions did he get wrong?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Percentage of wrong questions} &= \dfrac {7} {25} \times 100 \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac {7 \times 100} {25} \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac {7 \times 5 \times 5 \times 4} {25} \\\\
                                      &= \dfrac {7 \times \cancel {5}\times \cancel {5} \times 4} {\cancel {5} \times \cancel{5}} \\\\
                                      &= 7 \times 4 \\\\
                                      &= 28 \%
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$28 \%$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A box contains $48$ pieces of fruit. Five eighths of them are apples and the rest of them are pears. How many pears are there?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A box contains $48$ pieces of fruit. Five eighths of them are apples and the rest of them are pears. How many pears are there?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of apples} &= \dfrac {5} {8} \times 48 \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {5 \times 48} {8} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {5 \times 6 \times 8} {8} \\\\
                        &= \dfrac {5 \times 6 \times \cancel {8}} {\cancel {8}} \\\\
                        &= 5 \times 6 \\\\
                        &= 30
\end{aligned}
$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of pears}  &= 48 - 30 \\\\
                        &= 18
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$18$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question_envelope rag_not_found subquestion">
<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What is the largest number of balloons she can hang with a $4 \ \text{metre}$ ball of string?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What is the largest number of balloons she can hang with a $4 \ \text{metre}$ ball of string?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the largest number of balloons $= a$

Lets convert all the lengths into cm.

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of balloons} 	&= \dfrac{\text{Total string}}{\text{String per balloon}} \\\\
                       		&= \dfrac{4 \ \text{m}}{35 \ \text{cm}} \\\\
                       		&= \dfrac{400 \ \text{cm}}{35 \ \text{cm}} \\\\
							&= \dfrac{400}{35} \\\\
							&= 11 \ \text{ remainder } 15 \\\\
							&= 11
\end{aligned}
$

Largest number of balloons $= 11$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$11$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

What length of string would be left over? Give your answer in centimetres.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What length of string would be left over? Give your answer in centimetres.
</code></pre>

<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

\text{String left over} &= 400 - 11 \times 35 \\\\
						&= 400 - 385 \\\\
						&= 15 \ \text{cm} \\\\
&= 15 \ \text{cm}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

**Question**

He is paid $\pounds 3.60$ per hour. How much does he earn in one week?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">He is paid $\pounds 3.60$ per hour. How much does he earn in one week?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total hours} &= \dfrac{330}{60} \\\\
\text{Total earnings} &= 3.6 \times \dfrac{330}{60} \\\\
                   &= \dfrac{3.6 \times 330}{60} \\\\
				   &= \dfrac{36 \times 33}{6 \times 10} \\\\
				   &= \dfrac{6 \times 6 \times 33}{6 \times 10} \\\\
					&= \dfrac{\cancel{6} \times 6 \times 33}{\cancel{6} \times 10} \\\\
					&= \dfrac{6 \times 33}{10} \\\\
					  &= \pounds 19.80
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 19.80$

</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Mr. and Mrs. Green and their four children went on a 
holiday. The accomodation costs $\pounds 320$ per 
adult and $\pounds 220$ per child. The travelling expenses
were $\pounds 222$ per adult and $\pounds 168$ per child. 

How much did their total holiday cost in total?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

</div>

adult and $\pounds 220$ per child. The travelling expenses
were $\pounds 222$ per adult and $\pounds 168$ per child. 
<emptyline>
How much did their total holiday cost in total?
</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

                            &= 640 + 880 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 1520 \\\\

                            &= 444 + 672 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 1116 \\\\
\text{Total cost}       &= 1116 + 1520 \\\\
                            &= \pounds 2636                                                       
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A pizza is divided in $12$ equal slices. Matthew eats $\dfrac{1}{4}$ of 
the pizza and Katie eats another $\dfrac{1}{6}$.

How many slices are left?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A pizza is divided in $12$ equal slices. Matthew eats $\dfrac{1}{4}$ of 
the pizza and Katie eats another $\dfrac{1}{6}$.
<emptyline>
How many slices are left?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of slices left}       &= 12 - \dfrac {1} {4} \ \text{of} \ 12 - \dfrac {1} {6} \ \text{of} \ 12 \\\\
                                   &= 12 - \dfrac {1} {4} \times 12 - \dfrac {1} {6} \times 12 \\\\
                                   &= 12 - \dfrac {12} {4} - \dfrac {12} {6} \\\\
                                   &= 12 - \dfrac {4 \times 3} {4} - \dfrac {6 \times 2} {6} \\\\
                                   &= 12 - \dfrac {\cancel 4 \times 3} {\cancel 4} - \dfrac {\cancel 6 \times 2} {\cancel 6} \\\\
                                   &= 12 - 3 - 2 \\\\
                                   &= 12 - 5 \\\\
                                   &= 7
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$7$

</div>
</div>

                                   &= 12 - \dfrac {12} {4} - \dfrac {12} {6} \\\\

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Four $4$s can be used to make the numbers
$1, 2, 3$ and $4$ using only $+, -, \times, \div$ and brackets. This 
is shown below.

$
\begin{aligned}
4 \div 4 + 4 - 4             &= 1 \\\\
4 \times 4 \div (4 + 4)      &= 2 \\\\
(4 + 4 + 4) \div 4           &= 3 \\\\
(4 - 4) \div 4 + 4           &= 4
\end{aligned}
$

Write the numbers $17, 7$ and $5$ using all four $4$s and only $+, -, \times, \div$ and brackets.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Four $4$s can be used to make the numbers
$1, 2, 3$ and $4$ using only $+, -, \times, \div$ and brackets. This 
is shown below.
<emptyline>
$
\begin{aligned}
4 \div 4 + 4 - 4             &= 1 \\\\
4 \times 4 \div (4 + 4)      &= 2 \\\\
(4 + 4 + 4) \div 4           &= 3 \\\\
(4 - 4) \div 4 + 4           &= 4
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Write the numbers $17, 7$ and $5$ using all four $4$s and only $+, -, \times, \div$ and brackets.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
4 \times 4 + 4 \div 4        &= 17 \\\\
4 + 4 - 4 \div 4             &= 7 \\\\
(4 \times 4 + 4) \div 4      &= 5
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$4 \times 4 + 4 \div 4$

$4 + 4 - 4 \div 4$

$(4 \times 4 + 4) \div 4$

</div>

**Question**

How many coaches will the school need to book?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Some fairy cakes are delivered for Janey's party.

Janey can use big plates or small plates to put the cakes on.

If she uses big plates she can put seven cakes on each plate with five left over.

If she uses small plates she can put five cakes on each plate with three left over.

![papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2011/group-2/s01-q32-i00.png](/assets/papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2011/group-2/s01-q32-i00.png "papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2011/group-2/s01-q32-i00.png")

What is the smallest number of cakes that were delivered for Janey's party?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Some fairy cakes are delivered for Janey's party.
<emptyline>
Janey can use big plates or small plates to put the cakes on.
<emptyline>
If she uses big plates she can put seven cakes on each plate with five left over.
<emptyline>
If she uses small plates she can put five cakes on each plate with three left over.
<emptyline>
%image%
<emptyline>
What is the smallest number of cakes that were delivered for Janey's party?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Let the number of big plates $= a$

Let the number of small plates $= b$

As per the question,

$
\begin{aligned}
5b + 3         &= 7a + 5 \\\\
5b             &= 7a + 5 - 3 \\\\
5b             &= 7a + 2 \\\\
5b - 7a        &= 2
\end{aligned}
$

We can easily infer the value using trial and error. Lets find out the value of a and b that satisfies the above equation.

| $a$  | $b$ |                   $5b - 7a$                  |
|:----:|:---:|:--------------------------------------------:|
| $0$  | $1$ |    $5 \times 1 - 7 \times 0 = 5 - 0 = 5$     |
| $1$  | $2$ |    $5 \times 2 - 7 \times 1 = 10 - 7 = 3$    |
| $2$  | $3$ |    $5 \times 3 - 7 \times 2 = 15 - 14 = 1$   |
| $2$  | $4$ |    $5 \times 4 - 7 \times 2 = 20 - 14 = 6$   |
| $3$  | $5$ |    $5 \times 5 - 7 \times 3 = 25 - 21 = 4$   |
| $4$  | $6$ |    $5 \times 6 - 7 \times 4 = 30 - 28 = 2$   |

A quick check shows that $a = 4$ and $b = 6$ meets all the criteria above.

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Smallest number of cakes delivered}         &= 7 \times a + 5 \\\\
                                                  &= 7 \times 4 + 5 \\\\
                                                  &= 28 + 5 \\\\
                                                  &= 33
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$33$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A factory recycles paper cups for use in its canteen. Seven used cups 
are needed to make each new cup. From $721$ used cups, how many new cups 
can be made in total, if all the used cups get recycled?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A factory recycles paper cups for use in its canteen. Seven used cups 
are needed to make each new cup. From $721$ used cups, how many new cups 
can be made in total, if all the used cups get recycled?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total new cups} &= \dfrac {721} {7} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {103 \times 7} {7} \\\\
                      &= \dfrac {103 \times \cancel {7}} {\cancel {7}} \\\\
                      &= 103
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$103$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">%empty%
</code></pre>

<div class="question subquestion" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

What fraction of $36$ letters does Mark eat?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">What fraction of $36$ letters does Mark eat?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>

<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Fraction of letters eaten}        &= \dfrac {\text{Number of letters eaten}} {\text{Total letters}} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {36 - (7 + 5)} {36} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {36 - 12} {36} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {24} {36} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {12 \times 2} {12 \times 3} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {\cancel {12} \times 2} {\cancel {12} \times 3} \\\\
                                        &= \dfrac {2} {3}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Freda Frog always does jumps of $25 \ \text{centimetres}$.

Teddy Toad always does jumps of $40 \ \text{centimetres}$.

Freda and Teddy both do $30$ jumps in a straight line in the same direction.

How much further has Teddy jumped than Freda? (Give your answer in metres.) 

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Freda Frog always does jumps of $25 \ \text{centimetres}$.
<emptyline>
Teddy Toad always does jumps of $40 \ \text{centimetres}$.
<emptyline>
Freda and Teddy both do $30$ jumps in a straight line in the same direction.
<emptyline>
How much further has Teddy jumped than Freda? (Give your answer in metres.) 
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$\begin{aligned}
\text{Distance jumped by Freda} &= 30 \times 25  \\\\
&= 750 \ \text{cm} \\\\
\text{Distance jumped by Teddy} &= 30 \times 40  \\\\
&= 1200 \ \text{cm} \\\\
\text{Difference } &= 1200  - 750 \\\\
&= 450 \ \text{cm} \\\\
&= 4.5 \ \text{m}
\end{aligned}$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$4.5 \text{ m}$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Charlie enjoys eating Nickel bars.

![papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2012/group-1/s01-q41-i00.png](/assets/papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2012/group-1/s01-q41-i00.png "papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2012/group-1/s01-q41-i00.png")

His local store has a special promotion on Nickel bars.

Charlie can exchange $3$ empty Nickel bar wrappers for a new Nickel bar.

Charlie buys $20$ Nickel bars.

Assuming that Charlie always eats any Nickel bars he has and exchanges 
the used wrappers for new bars, how many bars will he be able to eat in total?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Charlie enjoys eating Nickel bars.
<emptyline>
%image%
<emptyline>
His local store has a special promotion on Nickel bars.
<emptyline>
Charlie can exchange $3$ empty Nickel bar wrappers for a new Nickel bar.
<emptyline>
Charlie buys $20$ Nickel bars.
<emptyline>
Assuming that Charlie always eats any Nickel bars he has and exchanges 
the used wrappers for new bars, how many bars will he be able to eat in total?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

Total nickel bars charlie bought $= 20$

$
\begin{aligned}
\text {Number of Nickel bars charlie gets after exchanging for the first time}  &= \dfrac {20} {3} \\\\
                                                                                &= 6 \text{ remainder } 2 \\\\
                                                                                &\approx 6 \\\\
\text {Number of Nickel bars charlie gets after exchanging next time}           &= \dfrac {6} {3} \\\\
                                                                                &= 2 \\\\
\text {Number of Nickel bars charlie gets after exchanging third time}          &= \dfrac {2 + 2} {3} \\\\
                                                                                &= \dfrac {4} {3} \\\\
                                                                                &= 1 \text { remainder } 1 \\\\                                                                          
                                                                                &\approx 1 \\\\                                                                          
\text {Total Nickel bars charlie ate}                                           &= 20 + 6 + 2 + 1 \\\\
                                                                                &= 29
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$29$

</div>
</div>

                                                                                &\approx 6 \\\\

                                                                                &= \dfrac {4} {3} \\\\

**Question**

At the end of $2011$, there were $1234$ members of Feel Fit Gym.

During the year, $167$ members had joined the gym and $38$ had left.

How many members were there at the start of $2011?$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<emptyline>
How many members were there at the start of $2011?$
</code></pre>
</div>

&= 1105
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Kate originally had $1 \ \text{litre}$ of water in a jug. 

She poured out some water and the diagram shows how much water is left in the jug.

![papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2012/group-2/s01-q24-i00.png](/assets/papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2012/group-2/s01-q24-i00.png "papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2012/group-2/s01-q24-i00.png")

How much water has Kate poured out from the jug?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>

<emptyline>
She poured out some water and the diagram shows how much water is left in the jug.
<emptyline>
%image%
<emptyline>

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Water taken}            &= 1 \ \text{litre} - 400 \ \text{ml} \\\\
                              &= 1 \times 1000 \ \text{ml} - 400 \ \text{ml} \\\\
                              &= 1000 - 400 \\\\
                              &= 600 \ \text{ml}
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$600 \ \text{ml}$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A large barrel contains $3.25 \ \text{litres}$ of water.

Mel fills three $500 \ \text{ml}$ bottles from the barrel.

She uses all of the rest of the water to fill as many $150 \ \text{ml}$ cups as she can.

What is the largest number of cups which Mel can completely fill?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A large barrel contains $3.25 \ \text{litres}$ of water.
<emptyline>
Mel fills three $500 \ \text{ml}$ bottles from the barrel.
<emptyline>
She uses all of the rest of the water to fill as many $150 \ \text{ml}$ cups as she can.
<emptyline>
What is the largest number of cups which Mel can completely fill?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
_no_dot
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total water} &= 3.25 \ \text{litres} \\\\
&= 3.25 \times 1000 \\\\
&= 3250 \ \text{ml} \\\\
\text{Water used for bottles} &= 3 \times 500 \\\\
&= 1500 \ \text{ml} \\\\
\text{Remaining water} &= 3250 - 1500 \\\\
&= 1750 \ \text{ml} \\\\
\text{Number of cups} &= \dfrac{1750}{150} \\\\
&= \dfrac{35 \times 50}{3 \times 50} \\\\
&= \dfrac{35 \times \cancel{50}}{3 \times \cancel{50}} \\\\
&= \dfrac{35}{3} \\\\
&= 11  \text{ remainder } 2 \\\\
&\approx 11
\end{aligned}
$

Number of cups $= 11$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$11$

</div>
</div>

</code></pre>
</div>

<div class="formulacodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Formulas Raw</strong>
</div>

</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workingcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="workingcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Working Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total water} &= 3.25 \ \text{litres} \\\\
&= 3.25 \times 1000 \\\\
&= 3250 \ \text{ml} \\\\
\text{Water used for bottles} &= 3 \times 500 \\\\
&= 1500 \ \text{ml} \\\\
\text{Remaining water} &= 3250 - 1500 \\\\
&= 1750 \ \text{ml} \\\\
\text{Number of cups} &= \dfrac{1750}{150} \\\\
&= \dfrac{35 \times 50}{3 \times 50} \\\\
&= \dfrac{35 \times \cancel{50}}{3 \times \cancel{50}} \\\\
&= \dfrac{35}{3} \\\\
&= 11  \text{ remainder } 2 \\\\
&\approx 11
\end{aligned}
$
<emptyline>
Number of cups $= 11$
</code></pre>
</div>

**Question**

A $280 \ \text{g}$ packet of mouse food costs $\pounds 2.50$

Work out the cost of feeding Squeak for $2 \ \text{years}$.

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A $280 \ \text{g}$ packet of mouse food costs $\pounds 2.50$
<emptyline>
Work out the cost of feeding Squeak for $2 \ \text{years}$.
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of weeks in 2 years}  &= 2 \times 52 \\\\
\text{Cost of 1 week}           &= \dfrac {2.50} {8} \\\\
\text{Cost of 2 years}          &= 2 \times 52 \times \dfrac {2.50} {8} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {2 \times 52 \times 2.50} {8} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {2 \times 4 \times 13 \times 2.50} {2 \times 4} \\\\
                                &= \dfrac {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 4 \times 13 \times 2.50} {\cancel 2 \times \cancel 4} \\\\
                                &= 13 \times 2.50 \\\\
                                &= \pounds 32.50
\end{aligned}
$
</div>

**Question**

Squeak 'squeaks' once every $15 \ \text{seconds}$.

He squeaks once at $07{:}30$

How many times will Squeak 'squeak' between $07{:}30$ when Morag gets up,and $21{:}30$ when she goes to bed?

*Give your answer to the nearest $500$*

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Squeak 'squeaks' once every $15 \ \text{seconds}$.
<emptyline>
He squeaks once at $07{:}30$
<emptyline>
How many times will Squeak 'squeak' between $07{:}30$ when Morag gets up,and $21{:}30$ when she goes to bed?
<emptyline>
*Give your answer to the nearest $500$*
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Total time }          &= 21{:}30 - 7{:}30 \\\\
                            &= 14 \ \text{hours} \\\\
\text{Number of squeaks}    &= \dfrac {14 \ \text{hours}} {15 \ \text{seconds}} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {14 \times 60 \times 60} {15} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {14 \times 60 \times 15 \times 4} {15} \\\\
                            &= \dfrac {14 \times 60 \times \cancel {15} \times 4} {\cancel {15}} \\\\
                            &= 14 \times 60 \times 4 \\\\
                            &= 3360 
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>

<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

$3360$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Farmer Andrew's chickens lay a total of $314$ eggs.

Each egg box holds only $6$ eggs.

How many egg boxes will Farmer Andrew be able to completely fill with these eggs?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Farmer Andrew's chickens lay a total of $314$ eggs.
<emptyline>
Each egg box holds only $6$ eggs.
<emptyline>
How many egg boxes will Farmer Andrew be able to completely fill with these eggs?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of boxes} &= \dfrac{\text{Total eggs}}{\text{Capacity of one box}} \\\\
                       &= \dfrac{314}{6} \\\\
                       &= 52 \ \text{remainder} \ 2
\end{aligned}$

Number of boxes $= 52$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$52$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

When two of the numbers below are added together, the answer is also a square number.

Write down the calculation.

$16 \quad 25 \quad 36 \quad 49 \quad 64$

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">When two of the numbers below are added together, the answer is also a square number.
<emptyline>
Write down the calculation.
<emptyline>
$16 \quad 25 \quad 36 \quad 49 \quad 64$
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

We can easily infer the value using trial and error.

| First number | Second Number |        Sum         | Is square |
|:------------:|:-------------:|:------------------:|:---------:|
|     $16$     |      $25$     |   $16 + 25 = 41$   |     No    |
|     $16$     |      $36$     |   $16 + 36 = 52$   |     No    |
|     $16$     |      $49$     |   $16 + 49 = 60$   |     No    |
|     $25$     |      $64$     |   $25 + 64 = 89$   |     No    |
|     $25$     |      $49$     |   $25 + 49 = 74$   |     No    |
|     $36$     |      $64$     |   $36 + 64 = 100$  |    Yes    |

The two required numbers are $= 36, 64$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$36+64=100$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

David wants to buy $1 \ \text{kilogram}$ of Ethiopian coffee.

He usually buys $250 \ \text{g}$ bags, which cost $\pounds 3.90$ each.

However, he notices that the shop has a special offer on $100 \ \text{g}$ bags. Each bag costs $\pounds 1.85$, 
but for every two bags you buy, you get a third bag free.

How much does David save by buying $1 \ \text{kilogram}$ of coffee in $100 \ \text{g}$ bags rather than in $250 \ \text{g}$ bags?

![papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2015/group-1/s01-q20-i00.png](/assets/papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2015/group-1/s01-q20-i00.png "papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2015/group-1/s01-q20-i00.png")

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">David wants to buy $1 \ \text{kilogram}$ of Ethiopian coffee.
<emptyline>
He usually buys $250 \ \text{g}$ bags, which cost $\pounds 3.90$ each.
<emptyline>
However, he notices that the shop has a special offer on $100 \ \text{g}$ bags. Each bag costs $\pounds 1.85$, 
but for every two bags you buy, you get a third bag free.
<emptyline>
How much does David save by buying $1 \ \text{kilogram}$ of coffee in $100 \ \text{g}$ bags rather than in $250 \ \text{g}$ bags?
<emptyline>
%image%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
- ABBR: It is really important to use the right units in calculations and convert where required.
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of 250 g bags David will have to buy}                 &= \dfrac {1 \ \text{kg}} {250 \ \text{g}} \\\\
                                                                   &= \dfrac {1 \times 1000 \ \text{g}} {250 \ \text{g}} \\\\
                                                                   &= \dfrac {1000} {250} \\\\
                                                                   &= \dfrac {250 \times 4} {250} \\\\
                                                                   &= \dfrac {\cancel {250} \times 4}{\cancel {250}} \\\\
                                                                   &= 4 \\\\
\text{Total cost of buying 250g bags}                              &= 4 \times 3.90 \\\\
                                                                   &= \pounds 15.6 \\\\
\text{Number of 100 g bags David needs}                            &= \dfrac {1 \ \text{kg}} {100 \ \text{g}} \\\\
                                                                   &= \dfrac {1 \times 1000 \ \text{g}} {100 \ \text{g}} \\\\
                                                                   &= \dfrac {1000} {100} \\\\
                                                                   &= \dfrac {100 \times 10} {100} \\\\
                                                                   &= \dfrac {\cancel {100} \times 10}{\cancel {100}} \\\\
                                                                   &= 10 \\\\
\text {Number of 100 g bags David will have to buy after discount} &=7 \\\\
\text{Total cost of buying 100 g bags}                             &= 7 \times 1.85 \\\\
                                                                   &= \pounds 12.95 \\\\
\text{Total Savings}                                               &= 15.6 - 12.95 \\\\
                                                                   &= \pounds 2.65
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 2.65$

</div>
</div>
<div class="workingscodeblock">
<div class="tipcodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="tipcodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Tips Raw</strong>
</div>

<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of 250 g bags David will have to buy}                 &= \dfrac {1 \ \text{kg}} {250 \ \text{g}} \\\\
                                                                   &= \dfrac {1 \times 1000 \ \text{g}} {250 \ \text{g}} \\\\
                                                                   &= \dfrac {1000} {250} \\\\
                                                                   &= \dfrac {250 \times 4} {250} \\\\
                                                                   &= \dfrac {\cancel {250} \times 4}{\cancel {250}} \\\\
                                                                   &= 4 \\\\
\text{Total cost of buying 250g bags}                              &= 4 \times 3.90 \\\\
                                                                   &= \pounds 15.6 \\\\
\text{Number of 100 g bags David needs}                            &= \dfrac {1 \ \text{kg}} {100 \ \text{g}} \\\\
                                                                   &= \dfrac {1 \times 1000 \ \text{g}} {100 \ \text{g}} \\\\
                                                                   &= \dfrac {1000} {100} \\\\
                                                                   &= \dfrac {100 \times 10} {100} \\\\
                                                                   &= \dfrac {\cancel {100} \times 10}{\cancel {100}} \\\\
                                                                   &= 10 \\\\
\text {Number of 100 g bags David will have to buy after discount} &=7 \\\\
\text{Total cost of buying 100 g bags}                             &= 7 \times 1.85 \\\\
                                                                   &= \pounds 12.95 \\\\
\text{Total Savings}                                               &= 15.6 - 12.95 \\\\
                                                                   &= \pounds 2.65
\end{aligned}

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

A shop sells coffee from Ethiopia.

The prices for coffee beans and ground coffee are shown below.

|coffee beans |ground coffee|
|:-------:|:----------:|
|$\pounds 9.40 \ \text{per kg}$| $\pounds 2.10 \ \text{per} \ 100\text{g}$|

How much more does it cost to buy $250 \text{g}$ of ground coffee than $250 \text{g}$ of coffee beans?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">A shop sells coffee from Ethiopia.
<emptyline>
The prices for coffee beans and ground coffee are shown below.
<emptyline>
|coffee beans |ground coffee|
|:-------:|:----------:|
|$\pounds 9.40 \ \text{per kg}$| $\pounds 2.10 \ \text{per} \ 100\text{g}$|
<emptyline>
How much more does it cost to buy $250 \text{g}$ of ground coffee than $250 \text{g}$ of coffee beans?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Cost of ground coffee} &= \dfrac{250}{100} \times 2.10 \\\\
&= 2.5 \times 2.10 \\\\
&= \pounds 5.25 \\\\
\text{Cost of coffee beans} &= \dfrac{250}{1000} \times 9.40 \\\\
&= 0.25 \times 9.40 \\\\
&= \pounds 2.35 \\\\
\text{Difference} &= 5.25 - 2.35 \\\\
&= \pounds 2.90
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 2.90$

</div>
</div>

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

Callum buys a new laptop costing $\pounds 572.50$.

He makes an initial payment of $\pounds 136$, and then pays the remainder in $6$ equal monthly amounts.

How much is each monthly amount?

![papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2015/group-2/s01-q21-i00.png](/assets/papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2015/group-2/s01-q21-i00.png "papers/the-london-independent-girls-schools-consortium/2015/group-2/s01-q21-i00.png")

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">Callum buys a new laptop costing $\pounds 572.50$.
<emptyline>
He makes an initial payment of $\pounds 136$, and then pays the remainder in $6$ equal monthly amounts.
<emptyline>
How much is each monthly amount?
<emptyline>
%image%
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Monthly amount} &= \dfrac {\text{Total cost} - \text{Initial payment}} {\text{Number of months}} \\\\
&= \dfrac {572.50 - 136} {6} \\\\
&= \dfrac {436.50} {6} \\\\
&= \pounds 72.75
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$\pounds 72.75$

</div>
</div>

**Question**

A tea bag contains $250$ tea leaves.

The tissue covering weighs $0.5 \ \text{g}$.

How many tea bags will there be in a $250 \text{g}$ packet of tea bags?

(The $250 \text{g}$ includes the mass of the bags and not just the tea leaves.)

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">

\end{aligned}
$

                                                       &= 23 - 13 \\\\

\text{Children in class 6B who play tennis}            &= \text{Total children in class 6B} - \text{Children in class 6B who do not play tennis} \\\\
                                                       &= 25 - 15 \\\\
                                                       &= 10 \\\\
\text{Number of children who play tennis}              &= \text{Total number of children} - \text{Number of children who do not play tennis} \\\\
                                                       &= 48 - 25 \\\\
                                                       &= 23
\end{aligned}
$

<div class="question" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Question**

In a box of shapes there are three times as many squares as there are circles.

There are twice as many triangles as squares.


If there are $45$ squares, how many shapes are there altogether?

</div>
<div class="questioncodeblock" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">
<div class="questioncodeblock_title">
<strong style="display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Question Raw</strong>
</div>
<pre class="language-latex"><code class="language-latex">In a box of shapes there are three times as many squares as there are circles.
<emptyline>
There are twice as many triangles as squares.
<emptyline>

If there are $45$ squares, how many shapes are there altogether?
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="workings">
<div class="tips placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Tips**

<div class="tip">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="formulas placeholder" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Formulas**

<div class="formula">
%empty%
</div>
</div>
<div class="working" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Working**

$
\begin{aligned}
\text{Number of squares} &= 45 \\\\
\text{Number of triangles} &= 2 \times 45 \\\\
&= 90 \\\\
\text{Number of circles} &= \dfrac{1}{3} \times 45 \\\\
&= \dfrac{45}{3} \\\\
&= \dfrac{15 \times 3}{3} \\\\
&= \dfrac{15 \times \cancel{3}}{\cancel{3}} \\\\
&= 15 \\\\
\text{Total number of shapes} &= 45 + 15 + 90 \\\\
&= 150
\end{aligned}
$
</div>
</div>
<div class="answers">
<div class="answer" style="margin: 1rem 0; padding: 0.85rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #9ea7b3; border-radius: 6px;">

**Answer**

$150$

</div>
</div>
